title_translated: 多模态大模型知道游戏规则，却假设现实世界
summary_translated: 多模态大语言模型能够陈述视频游戏的规则，但在仅看到游戏画面时是否真正应用这些规则？我们引入RuleCraft数据集，包含1,240个图像问题，覆盖155条Minecraft规则，所有结果均在游戏引擎中验证，每个问题以文本形式、带有游戏名称的图像形式以及纯图像形式提出。六种广泛使用的模型能识别规则和游戏，但在面对纯图像时仍依据现实物理规律作答：当明确指出游戏名称后，其在规则偏离现实的情况下的准确率提升8.2至19.8分（主测试集），在高难度压力测试集中提升33.8至52.7分。它们的错误倾向于选择现实世界的预期结果，当游戏场景未改变时差距最大，推理轨迹也显示先陈述游戏规则，再按现实回答。在主测试集中，命名游戏主要将现实默认答案替换为游戏规则答案。该模式在推理中重现，并在另外两个游戏中同样成立，甚至在模型自认为是关于游戏的问题上依然存在。一句中立句子询问所展示世界的游戏规则，即可恢复大部分差距。因此，命名游戏的评估衡量的是对规则的知识，而非世界选择能力。

summary: We present KMed-31B, a medical large language model post-trained from an open-weight model for on-premises deployment with limited hardware. Post-training a model for diverse medical tasks remains difficult, because improving one kind of task can lower performance on another. We attribute this to differences between tasks in expected output and available feedback. Medical question answering and diagnosis prediction have reference answers, whereas clinical inquiry has no single correct response and is judged with rubrics. We therefore divide medical training tasks into four categories by these two properties, train one specialist per category with a reward that its feedback supports, and integrate the specialists into a single student with Multi-teacher On-policy Delta Distillation (MOPD$^2$). For clinical inquiry, we build Synthetic Health Dialogue, a simulated corpus of consultations with lay users and clinicians whose patient cases span common clinical presentations in primary care. Relative to its base model, KMed-31B raises HealthBench Hard from 22.95 to 41.87 and HealthBench Professional from 37.92 to 50.20 in non-thinking mode, and from 23.80 to 51.48 and from 41.97 to 59.18 in thinking mode, while its scores on four multiple-choice medical benchmarks are maintained or slightly improved. KMed-31B has the highest unadjusted HealthBench Hard score among the compared models, including proprietary ones, and scores higher on HealthBench Professional than every open-weight model we compare, including models with more than ten times as many total parameters. Applied to another base model, Qwen3.8-27B, the same training recipe also raises both HealthBench scores. We describe the training recipe, data construction, and settings in detail so that institutions requiring on-premises deployment can develop medical models from open-weight foundations.
title: KMed-31B Technical Report
comment: Technical Report; 26 pages, 7 figures, 9 tables
title_translated: KMed-31B 技术报告
summary_translated: 我们介绍了KMed-31B，一个基于开源权重模型在本地硬件受限环境下进行后训练的医学大语言模型。针对多样医学任务的后训练仍具挑战性，因为提升某一类任务的表现可能降低其他任务的性能。我们将其归因于不同任务在期望输出和可用反馈上的差异：医学问答与诊断预测具有参考答案，而临床咨询无唯一正确答案，需使用评分标准评判。因此，我们根据这两个属性将医学训练任务分为四类，每类训练一名专家模型，使用支持其反馈的奖励信号，并通过多教师在线策略差分蒸馏（MOPD²）将专家整合为单一学生模型。针对临床咨询任务，我们构建了Synthetic Health Dialogue，一个模拟普通用户与临床医生之间咨询的合成语料库，涵盖初级医疗中的常见临床表现。相较于基础模型，KMed-31B在非思考模式下将HealthBench Hard从22.95提升至41.87，HealthBench Professional从37.92提升至50.20；在思考模式下分别提升至51.48和59.18，同时四项多项选择医学基准测试得分保持稳定或略有提升。KMed-31B在对比模型中拥有最高的未调整HealthBench Hard得分，且在HealthBench Professional上高于所有对比的开源模型，包括参数量超过十倍的模型。将相同训练方法应用于另一基础模型Qwen3.8-27B，同样显著提升了两个HealthBench分数。本文详细描述了训练方案、数据构建与配置，以便需要本地部署的机构基于开源基础模型开发医学模型。

summary: Measure Before You Train argued that an agent's decisions should be measured against ground truth, under a protocol fixed in advance, before anyone trains or replaces the model behind them. We carry the method to a second, very different domain, a turn-based strategy game, and ask a deliberately modest question: how well do low-cost agents play under a pre-registered protocol? hexfolk is a minimal two-player 4X game written for this purpose, so no model has seen its rules or positions. A deterministic engine, one agent interface, a referee that never corrects an illegal or late move, and per-decision logs make every game replayable; questions and expected answers were committed before the games, on held-out seeds with mirrored seats and 95% Wilson intervals. Two small open language models (8B and 3B) lose every game to a few-line rule player. Answering in free text they are invalid on 98% of their decisions; constrained to legal moves they never play an invalid one, yet they lose to the uniformly random player (the 8B model wins 10.0 [4.3, 21.4]% of games), refuting our expectation that they would beat it; the result survives a control that shuffles the order of the options. Two native decision models never play an invalid move and both beat random; one loses all 50 games to the rule player, the other is not distinguishable from it in 50 games and beats a one-step search. The paid agents make tens to over a hundred model calls per game; against the same opponents a free 60 ms-per-move search, which makes none, outplays every paid model by the full range of the scale. Two 7-8B models served locally behave the same way. No frontier model is included.
title: Legal Is Not Good: A Pre-Registered Benchmark of Low-Cost Language and Decision Models on a New Strategy Game
comment: 14 pages, 2 figures, 10 tables. Pre-registered protocol (v1-v5, all amendments committed before the games they govern). Engine, benchmark harness, agents and protocol: this https URL , tag bench-v1. Companion to arXiv:2610.32955 and arXiv:2611.21393 . No frontier model; paid pairings limited to 50 games by budget
title_translated: 法律并非良策：低成本语言与决策模型在新策略游戏上的预注册基准测试
summary_translated: 《训练前先测量》主张应在任何人训练或更换模型之前，预先固定协议并以真实情况为基准衡量智能体的决策。我们将该方法应用于第二个截然不同的领域——回合制策略游戏，并提出一个刻意保守的问题：低成本智能体在预注册协议下表现如何？hexfolk是一款专为此目的设计的极简双人4X游戏，确保没有任何模型见过其规则或局面。采用确定性引擎、单一智能体接口、永不纠正非法或延迟动作的裁判，以及每步决策日志，使得每局游戏均可重播；问题与预期答案在游戏开始前即已提交，使用保留种子、镜像座位和95%威尔逊区间。两个小型开源语言模型（8B和3B）在所有对局中均败给仅几行规则的玩家。以自由文本回答时，其98%的决策无效；即使限制为合法动作，它们也从未出现无效动作，但仍败给均匀随机玩家（8B模型赢下10.0[4.3, 21.4]%的游戏），这反驳了我们预期其会击败随机玩家的假设；该结果在选项顺序打乱的控制实验中依然成立。两个原生决策模型从不执行无效动作，且均战胜随机玩家；其中一个在50局中全败于规则玩家，另一个在50局中与规则玩家无显著差异，并击败一步搜索模型。付费智能体每局需调用数十至百余次模型；而在相同对手面前，一个每步仅60毫秒、不进行任何调用的搜索程序，反而全面胜出所有付费模型。两个7-8B本地运行模型表现一致。未包含任何前沿模型。

summary: Retrieval-augmented language models answer well when the relevant document comes first or last and poorly when it sits in the middle. Some fine-tuning recipes lift the middle by lowering the start. We show how training contexts teach positional bias. With a uniform answer slot and shuffled distractors, the optimal reader ignores position. Building on this result, Exchangeable Self-Distillation (ExSD) trains a small adapter on shuffled contexts to reproduce the model's answer when it reads the answer document alone. It needs no gold answers and only a few thousand examples. On six models from 1.5B to 32B parameters, ExSD raises both average and worst-position accuracy against the frozen model, including on a held-out test split. In controlled LoRA comparisons, it significantly improves both criteria over Pos2Distill. Against CORD, mean differences are not significant, while worst-position accuracy improves significantly in the 20- and 30-document settings. ExSD also matches or beats gold-answer fine-tuning, changes behavior on other tasks far less, and transfers to unseen tasks. Head probes show greater reliance on content over position.
title: Make Position Uninformative: Exchangeable Self-Distillation Flattens the Lost-in-the-Middle Curve
title_translated: 让位置信息无意义：可交换自蒸馏使中间丢失曲线变平
summary_translated: 检索增强型语言模型在相关文档位于开头或结尾时表现良好，但在中间位置时表现较差。一些微调方法通过降低起始位置的表现来提升中间位置的性能。我们揭示了训练上下文如何引入位置偏差。通过采用统一的答案槽位和打乱的干扰项，最优阅读器会忽略位置信息。基于这一发现，提出可交换自蒸馏（ExSD）方法：在一个打乱的上下文上训练一个小型适配器，使其在单独读取答案文档时能复现模型的答案。该方法无需真实答案标签，仅需数千个样本。在参数量从15亿到320亿的六种模型上，ExSD显著提升了平均和最差位置的准确率，包括在保留测试集上的表现。与LoRA控制实验相比，ExSD在两项指标上均优于Pos2Distill；与CORD相比，平均差异不显著，但在20和30个文档设置下最差位置准确率显著提升。ExSD还达到甚至超过使用真实答案微调的效果，对其他任务的行为影响更小，并能迁移到未见任务。头探针分析显示模型对内容的依赖程度更高，而非位置。

summary: In this paper, we conduct a systematic study on improving permutation robustness while preserving accuracy. First, we categorize permutation bias phenomena into four representative scenarios. Then, we take the multiple-choice question answering (MCQA) dataset as an example under text-option reordering scenario to analyze the root cause of permutation bias. Based on this root cause analysis and set encoding strategy, we investigate shared positions with blocked cross-unit attention (SP-B) and extend this design to bidirectional cross-unit attention (SP-V) for modality exchange. However, these structural changes may reduce predictive accuracy. To recover model capability across different scenarios under the SP structure, an attention-only distillation from frozen native models is proposed. Shared positions reduce permutation sensitivity, and attention-only distillation improves accuracy under the shared-position structure. Across all three models, our method is comparable to or better than majority voting in macro-average all-permutation accuracy, and outperforms supervised fine-tuning by 1.95-4.20 percentage points. This work provides valuable insight into permutation bias mitigation and model capability recovery.
title: Reducing Permutation Sensitivity in Multimodal Large Language Models via Shared Positions and Attention-Only Distillation
title_translated: 通过共享位置与仅注意力蒸馏减少多模态大语言模型的排列敏感性
summary_translated: 本文系统研究了在保持准确率的同时提升排列鲁棒性的方法。首先，我们将排列偏差现象归纳为四种典型场景。以多选题问答（MCQA）数据集为例，在文本选项重排场景下分析排列偏差的根本原因。基于此根因分析和集合编码策略，我们提出带有阻断跨单元注意力的共享位置（SP-B），并将其扩展至双向跨单元注意力（SP-V）以支持模态交换。然而，这些结构变化可能降低预测准确率。为此，我们提出从冻结的原生模型进行仅注意力蒸馏，以恢复SP结构下不同场景中的模型能力。共享位置有效降低了排列敏感性，而仅注意力蒸馏则提升了共享位置结构下的准确率。在所有三种模型上，我们的方法在宏观平均全排列准确率上与多数投票相当或更优，且比监督微调高出1.95至4.20个百分点。本工作为排列偏差缓解和模型能力恢复提供了重要洞见。

summary: Biomedical question answering often requires multi-step reasoning under limited inference budgets. While test-time search methods such as Tree-of-Thought can improve reasoning performance, directly searching over free-form language is computationally expensive and highly redundant, as many reasoning trajectories contain semantically equivalent intermediate steps expressed in different surface forms. We introduce MedCoast, an offline-to-online reasoning framework that converts sampled chain-of-thought trajectories into a compact space for structured process supervision. Offline, we recursively cluster semantically similar reasoning steps under shared prefixes to construct an abstract reasoning tree that captures recurring clinical reasoning patterns. We then derive node-level supervision from progress toward correct solutions, and train a lightweight process reward model (PRM) to evaluate partial reasoning states. At inference time, the learned critic guides test-time exploration by prioritizing promising reasoning prefixes. Across seven biomedical QA benchmarks, MedCoast often improves over self-consistency under fixed inference budgets, with gains of up to 15 points. Despite using a reward model more than 50 times smaller, MedCoast achieves performance comparable to state-of-the-art reward models in several settings, highlighting its potential for resource-constrained biomedical reasoning.
title: MedCoast: Semantic Abstraction of Reasoning Trajectories for Test-Time Biomedical Question Answering
title_translated: MedCoast：面向测试时生物医学问答的推理轨迹语义抽象
summary_translated: 生物医学问答通常需要在有限的推理预算下进行多步推理。尽管测试时搜索方法如思维树（Tree-of-Thought）能提升推理性能，但直接在自由形式语言中搜索计算成本高且高度冗余，因为许多推理路径包含语义等价但表面形式不同的中间步骤。我们提出MedCoast，一种从离线到在线的推理框架，将采样的思维链轨迹转换为紧凑空间，实现结构化过程监督。离线阶段，我们递归聚类具有共同前缀的语义相似推理步骤，构建捕捉常见临床推理模式的抽象推理树。随后，从向正确解推进的程度中提取节点级监督信号，并训练一个轻量级过程奖励模型（PRM）以评估部分推理状态。推理时，学习到的评判者通过优先选择有前景的推理前缀来引导测试时探索。在七个生物医学问答基准上，MedCoast在固定推理预算下常优于自一致性方法，最高提升达15分。尽管使用的奖励模型比最先进的模型小50倍以上，其性能在多个设置下仍可媲美顶尖模型，凸显其在资源受限的生物医学推理中的潜力。

summary: Simultaneous interpreting requires interpreters to convey the source accurately while keeping pace with it in real time. Timing measures such as segment-onset delay capture part of this requirement, but may not fully reflect how professional evaluators judge promptness. We investigate whether these judgments can be explained by timing alone or whether the interpreted output provides additional information. Our dataset contains 622 Chinese-English and English-Chinese segments from 16 source speeches and seven interpreters. Two senior professional interpreters rated each segment for language quality (LQ), expressiveness (EXP), and perceived latency (LAT), which we also refer to as professional promptness. On held-out source speeches, onset delay alone achieves a Pearson correlation of r = .318 with LAT ratings. Combining predicted LQ and EXP with delay improves the correlation to r = .475. Lexical and structural features provide a stronger signal, reaching r = .632 when combined with delay and r = .658 when predicted quality is also included. These results suggest that professional promptness judgments reflect properties of the interpreted output beyond when the interpreter begins speaking. The additional contribution of predicted quality over structural features, however, is modest. Although the two evaluators differ in how strongly quality relates to LAT, cross-evaluator predictions remain positively correlated with LAT ratings. The overall pattern also holds when each interpreter is held out in turn.
title: Modeling Perceived Promptness in Simultaneous Interpreting from Quality, Structure, and Timing Signals
title_translated: 基于质量、结构与时间信号建模同步口译中的感知及时性
summary_translated: 同步口译要求译员在准确传达源语内容的同时实时跟进。时间度量如段落起始延迟部分反映了这一要求，但可能无法完全体现专业评价者对及时性的判断。我们探究这些判断是否仅由时间决定，还是译文输出本身也提供额外信息。我们的数据集包含来自16篇源演讲和7名译员的622个中英与英中段落。两名资深专业译员对每个段落进行了语言质量（LQ）、表达力（EXP）和感知延迟（LAT）评分，后者即为专业及时性判断。在保留的源演讲上，仅使用起始延迟的Pearson相关系数为r = .318；结合预测的语言质量和表达力后，相关系数提升至r = .475。词汇和结构特征提供更强信号，与延迟结合时相关系数达r = .632，若再加入预测质量，则达r = .658。结果表明，专业及时性判断不仅取决于译员开始说话的时间，还反映译文输出本身的属性。然而，预测质量相对于结构特征的额外贡献较为有限。尽管两位评价者对质量与LAT关系的强弱判断不同，跨评价者的预测仍与LAT评分正相关。当逐个排除每位译员时，整体模式依然成立。

summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) increasingly rely on external visual tools to access fine-grained visual evidence, but repeated tool execution incurs substantial inference overhead and deployment dependencies. Moreover, conventional tool-use RL can improve visual-task performance, yet the resulting tool gains are often unstable. Motivated by this, we propose Tool-to-Self (T2S), a tool-scaffolded reinforcement learning framework that turns external visual tools into temporary training scaffolds. T2S cold-starts tool-use ability and observation prediction from tool-repairable examples, then progressively anneals tool execution on a per-tool basis during RL. By combining answer-correctness and observation-consistency rewards with privileged on-policy self-distillation from actual tool observations, T2S effectively teaches the model both to reproduce tool outputs and to reason from them. Experiments across diverse visual perception and reasoning benchmarks demonstrate consistent improvements over both explicit tool-use models and implicit zooming models while enabling tool-free inference with reduced latency.
title: Tool-to-Self: Internalizing Visual Tool Capabilities via Scaffolded Reinforcement Learning
comment: 11 pages, 6 figures
title_translated: Tool-to-Self：通过分阶段强化学习内化视觉工具能力
summary_translated: 视觉语言模型（VLMs）越来越多依赖外部视觉工具获取细粒度视觉证据，但重复执行工具会带来显著的推理开销和部署依赖。此外，传统工具使用强化学习虽能提升视觉任务表现，但所得工具收益往往不稳定。为此，我们提出Tool-to-Self（T2S），一种工具辅助的强化学习框架，将外部视觉工具作为临时训练支架。T2S从可修复的工具示例出发，冷启动工具使用能力和观察预测能力，然后在强化学习过程中逐步退火每项工具的执行。通过结合答案正确性与观察一致性奖励，并利用实际工具观测进行有特权的在线自我蒸馏，T2S有效教会模型既复现工具输出，又能从中进行推理。在多种视觉感知与推理基准上的实验表明，T2S在性能上持续优于显式工具使用模型和隐式缩放模型，同时实现了无工具推理并降低了延迟。

summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) increasingly use external visual tools to acquire evidence during reasoning, yet learning when to invoke these tools remains challenging. Existing tool-use reinforcement learning (RL) methods often rely on call-contingent rewards to encourage beneficial tool use, but such reward engineering can distort the task objective and lead to degenerate calling behaviors. We argue that effective tool-use learning requires identifying not merely which questions are difficult, but which failures are attributable to missing visual evidence and can therefore be corrected through tool observations. We propose AOVO, a data-centric framework that enables MLLMs to learn effective tool use through perception attribution and policy-adaptive data sampling (PADS), without introducing tool-specific rewards. It counterfactually probes the model's reasoning states to identify observation-sensitive questions, distinguishing them from reasoning-dominated ones. PADS then periodically estimates category-level observation effects from recent policy rollouts and dynamically reallocates the training distribution toward questions where visual observations provide informative learning signals, while optimizing solely for final-answer correctness. Experiments across diverse visual perception and multimodal reasoning benchmarks demonstrate consistent improvements over competitive tool-use MLLMs, with causal analysis further validating the data-centric perspective for learning effective visual tool use.
title: From Reward Engineering to Data-Centric Reinforcement Learning for Effective Agentic Visual Tool Use
comment: 11 pages, 4 figures
title_translated: 从奖励工程到以数据为中心的强化学习：实现智能体视觉工具的有效使用
summary_translated: 多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在推理过程中越来越多地使用外部视觉工具来获取证据，但学习何时调用这些工具仍具挑战性。现有的工具使用强化学习（RL）方法通常依赖于调用相关的奖励来鼓励有益的工具使用，但这种奖励工程可能扭曲任务目标，并导致退化的调用行为。我们认为，有效的工具使用学习不仅需要识别哪些问题困难，更需识别哪些失败源于缺少视觉证据，从而可通过工具观察加以纠正。我们提出了AOVO，一种以数据为中心的框架，使MLLMs通过感知归因和策略自适应数据采样（PADS）来学习有效的工具使用，而无需引入特定于工具的奖励。该方法反事实地探测模型的推理状态，以识别对观察敏感的问题，将其与以推理为主的问题区分开来。PADS则定期从最近的策略滚动中估计类别级别的观察效果，并动态调整训练分布，使其偏向于视觉观察能提供有效学习信号的问题，同时仅优化最终答案的正确性。在多种视觉感知和多模态推理基准上的实验表明，AOVO在性能上持续优于竞争性的工具使用MLLMs，因果分析进一步验证了以数据为中心的方法在学习有效视觉工具使用中的有效性。

summary: Production text-to-code systems use large language models to turn natural-language analytics requests into executable SQL and pandas code. Existing benchmarks cover both tasks but do not isolate when performance diverges between them. We introduce BIRD-Persona, a persona-stratified extension of BIRD-Python that adds novice and expert rewrites to tasks with matched SQL and pandas ground truth, along with schema variants and task-structure annotations. Across 1,534 tasks, nine models, and 245,592 evaluations, SQL outperforms pandas for eight of nine systems. The gap varies by condition: expert, schema-explicit prompts improve both paradigms but help SQL more; schema representations have mixed, model-dependent effects; and selected-column burden widens the gap while subqueries do not. By making user phrasing a controlled benchmark dimension, BIRD-Persona supports persona-aware and paradigm-aware evaluation of natural-language analytics systems. The dataset is available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/optum-cognition-lab/BIRD-Persona.
title: BIRD-Persona: A Persona-Aware Benchmark for SQL and pandas Analytics Code Generation
title_translated: BIRD-Persona：面向SQL与pandas数据分析代码生成的个性感知基准
summary_translated: 生产环境中的文本到代码系统利用大语言模型将自然语言分析请求转换为可执行的SQL和pandas代码。现有基准覆盖了这两项任务，但未能分离它们之间的性能差异。我们引入BIRD-Persona，作为BIRD-Python的个性分层扩展，为具有匹配SQL和pandas真实答案的任务添加了新手和专家重写版本，同时包含模式变体和任务结构标注。在1,534个任务、九个模型和245,592次评估中，SQL在九个系统中有八个表现优于pandas。差距因条件而异：专家提示和显式模式提示均有助于两个范式，但对SQL的帮助更大；模式表示的影响混合且依赖于模型；选择列负担扩大了差距，而子查询则无显著影响。通过将用户表述作为受控的基准维度，BIRD-Persona支持对自然语言分析系统的个性感知和范式感知评估。数据集可在https://huggingface.co/datasets/optum-cognition-lab/BIRD-Persona 获取。

summary: A risky choice can be described by what will be saved or what will be lost, and people often choose differently depending on that wording. We test whether six large language models (LLMs) show this gain-loss framing effect, and whether it shrinks when they can first read more about the options. GPT-4.1, GPT-4o, GPT-4o-mini, Gemini 2.5 Flash, Qwen3 235B and Llama 4 Maverick made 11,519 choices across four risk scenarios, each in its original wording, two paraphrases and a mirrored version in the opposite wording. Before choosing, a model could open up to 0, 2, 3 or 4 of seven information cards. With no cards, all six models showed large framing effects: the share choosing the safe option was 27 to 79 percentage points lower under loss than under gain wording. The gap was smaller at 2 cards than with no cards in every model. Against a 10-point threshold set in our analysis plan, GPT-4.1 fell within it at 4 cards and Qwen3 only at 2 cards; in the plan's pooled comparison over all versions, GPT-4.1 was within it from 2 cards and GPT-4o from 3. GPT-4o-mini and Llama 4 Maverick kept gaps of 28 to 66 points with cards, and for GPT-4o-mini and Qwen3 the gap grew again from 2 to 4 cards. Part of the drop from 0 to 2 cards may reflect a change in prompt format, and most card content counted against the risky option, which may favor the safe choice. In an exploratory comparison with 198 students who saw the same scenarios and cards but opened cards one at a time and chose how many, decisions made after opening 0 or 1 cards showed a 19-point difference between the gain scenarios, asked first, and the loss scenarios, asked later, and no clear difference appeared in decisions made after opening more, though this design cannot show that cards reduced framing in people. With these cards, in the balanced comparison 17 of 18 card gaps were below the model's no-card gap, but few were within the threshold.
title: Information Access and Gain-Loss Framing in Six Large Language Models and Human Decision Makers
comment: 19 pages, 3 figures. Code and model outputs: this https URL
title_translated: 六种大语言模型与人类决策者在信息获取与得失框架下的表现研究
summary_translated: 一项风险选择可以通过“将被保留”或“将被损失”来描述，人们常因措辞不同而做出不同选择。我们测试了六种大语言模型（LLMs）是否表现出得失框架效应，以及当它们可以先阅读更多选项信息时，该效应是否会减弱。GPT-4.1、GPT-4o、GPT-4o-mini、Gemini 2.5 Flash、Qwen3 235B 和 Llama 4 Maverick 在四个风险场景中做出了11,519次选择，每种场景均以原始表述、两种改写和相反表述的镜像版本呈现。在选择前，模型可打开最多0、2、3或4张共七张信息卡。在未打开卡片时，所有六个模型均表现出显著的框架效应：在损失表述下选择安全选项的比例比在收益表述下低27至79个百分点。在打开两张卡片后，所有模型的差距均缩小，但GPT-4.1在四张卡片时才达到10点阈值，Qwen3仅在两张卡片时达标；在综合比较中，GPT-4.1从两张卡片起达标，GPT-4o从三张卡片起达标。GPT-4o-mini和Llama 4 Maverick在有卡片时仍保持28至66个百分点的差距，且对于GPT-4o-mini和Qwen3，差距从两张增至四张卡片时反而扩大。从0到2张卡片的下降部分可能反映提示格式变化，且多数卡片内容倾向于反对风险选项，这可能有利于安全选择。在探索性对比中，198名学生在相同场景和卡片下逐张打开并自主决定打开数量，发现打开0或1张卡片后的决策在收益场景（先问）与损失场景（后问）之间存在19个百分点的差异，而在打开更多卡片后则无明显差异，但此设计无法证明卡片减少了人类的框架效应。在平衡比较中，18个卡片间隙中有17个低于模型无卡片时的差距，但很少有进入10点阈值。

summary: Strong results in multi-hop retrieval-augmented question answering come from graph indexes read by models of 70B parameters or more, and building such an index calls a large language model over the whole corpus. We present SupportChain, which splits a question into hops, binds each hop's answer to a sentence quoted from a retrieved passage, estimates how reliable each execution is from its own trace, and merges several executions by the support of their answers, the pooled reliability of the executions that agree, stopping once support is high enough. With a 9B reader under the HippoRAG~2 protocol, SupportChain reaches 63.0 F1 on MuSiQue, above the best earlier result of 59.2, which used a 20B reader. With the same reader and embedder, it is significantly better than HippoRAG~2 on all five datasets, by up to 17.2 F1, and it builds no index. Merging by support is significantly better than majority voting, and than letting the reader choose among the candidates, on three of the five datasets and level with both on the other two. The reliability model needs only 100 answered training questions.
title: SupportChain: Trace-Calibrated Aggregation of Quote-Grounded Reasoning Chains for Multi-Hop RAG with Small Readers
title_translated: SupportChain：面向小型阅读器的多跳RAG中基于引用推理链的迹校准聚合
summary_translated: 多跳检索增强问答取得优异结果主要依赖于由700亿参数及以上模型读取的图索引，而构建此类索引需对整个语料库调用大语言模型。我们提出SupportChain，将问题拆分为多个步骤，将每个步骤的答案绑定到从检索段落中引用的句子，根据自身推理轨迹估计每一步执行的可靠性，并通过答案的支持度合并多个执行结果——即聚合一致执行的可靠性，在支持度足够高时停止。在采用HippoRAG~2协议的90亿参数阅读器下，SupportChain在MuSiQue数据集上达到63.0的F1分数，高于此前最佳结果59.2（使用200亿参数阅读器）。在相同阅读器和嵌入器条件下，它在五个数据集上均显著优于HippoRAG~2，最高提升达17.2 F1，且无需构建索引。按支持度合并优于多数投票和让阅读器从候选中选择，在三个数据集上表现更优，另两个数据集持平。可靠性模型仅需100个已回答的训练问题即可训练。

summary: Digital twins of agent networks need to flag unreliable forecasts and help users choose interventions. Both decisions depend on what happens over several steps: an error can spread through the network, and an edit whose trajectory is easy to predict may still yield a poor collective outcome. We ask when information about error propagation improves failure detection and whether a learned twin can select effective network edits despite imperfect forecasts. We propose Propagation-Aware Validation for Networked Digital Twins (PAV-Twin). Its monitor combines Jacobian-based propagation features with recent errors and ensemble disagreement to estimate the risk that a forecast exceeds an error threshold. Its planner simulates each candidate edit and ranks the edits by their predicted collective outcomes. In simulations, the monitor gained 0.13 in area under the precision-recall curve on larger oscillator networks with familiar topologies and 0.09 on larger networks with held-out topologies, relative to a graph baseline without propagation features. Gains were small in contractive consensus. Giving the graph baseline the same features narrowed the gap. In a separate planning study, ensemble simulation recovered about 99% of the possible improvement over random intervention selection in oscillators and nearly all of it in consensus. With a simplified oscillator twin, selecting by predicted outcome also gave lower regret than selecting by trajectory fidelity. These results show when propagation features help flag unreliable forecasts and why the quality of intervention choices should be measured directly.
title: Digital Twins for Multi-Agent Systems: When to Trust, What to Change
title_translated: 多智能体系统的数字孪生：何时信任，何事更改
summary_translated: 多智能体网络的数字孪生需要标记不可靠的预测，并帮助用户选择干预措施。这两个决策都取决于多个步骤内发生的情况：错误可能在网络中传播，而一条轨迹易于预测的修改仍可能导致较差的集体结果。我们探讨了关于错误传播的信息是否能改善故障检测，以及一个学习型孪生能否在预测不完美时选择有效的网络修改。我们提出了面向网络化数字孪生的传播感知验证方法（PAV-Twin）。其监控模块结合基于雅可比矩阵的传播特征与近期误差和集成分歧，估算预测超过误差阈值的风险。其规划模块模拟每个候选修改并根据预测的集体结果对修改进行排序。在仿真中，监控模块在具有熟悉拓扑的大规模振荡器网络上，AUPRC提升了0.13；在具有保留拓扑的大规模网络上提升了0.09，相较于不包含传播特征的图基线。在收缩共识网络中增益较小；若给图基线加入相同特征，则差距缩小。在独立的规划研究中，集成模拟在振荡器中恢复了约99%的随机干预选择所能达到的改进，在共识中几乎全部恢复。使用简化的振荡器孪生时，基于预测结果的选择比基于轨迹保真度的选择带来更低的遗憾。这些结果表明传播特征在标记不可靠预测中的作用，以及为何应直接衡量干预选择的质量。

summary: Social simulations often use language model agents to represent people who differ on several measurable traits. However, describing a trait profile in a prompt does not guarantee the agent will express each trait at its intended level. We propose a method that calibrates agents to multidimensional profiles using activation steering: (i) extract steering directions for each trait, (ii) learn a shared mapping from steering strengths to measured trait scores, and (iii) search for a steering intervention for each target. We use Bayesian optimization for this search and evaluate the method on the Big Five personality scores of 500 OpenPsychometrics respondents. In each of five rounds, the assigned interventions yield lower mean absolute error across respondents than the prompting and steering baselines. Further, the model's responses to a given intervention yield the same trait profile regardless of whose target motivated it, so a poor match for one respondent can be the best match for another. When we match each respondent to the closest profile found across all tested interventions, Bayesian optimization yields 16.6% lower mean absolute error than uniform random search at the same evaluation budget. Our method thus offers a way to build social agents whose measured traits dovetail with those of the people they seek to represent. Whether this closer fit translates to improved predictions of downstream behavior remains an open question.
title: Digital Knockoffs
title_translated: 数字复制品
summary_translated: 社会模拟通常使用语言模型代理来代表具有多个可测量特质的人。然而，在提示中描述一个特质组合并不能保证代理会以预期水平表现出每个特质。我们提出一种方法，通过激活引导（activation steering）校准代理以适应多维特质配置：(i) 提取每个特质的引导方向，(ii) 学习从引导强度到测量特质分数的共享映射，(iii) 为每个目标搜索合适的引导干预。我们使用贝叶斯优化进行该搜索，并在500名OpenPsychometrics受访者的五大性格特质评分上评估该方法。在五轮实验中，所分配的干预措施在所有受访者上的平均绝对误差均低于提示和引导基线。此外，对于给定干预，模型的响应结果无论由谁的目标驱动，都会产生相同的特质配置，因此对某位受访者的不佳匹配可能恰好是另一位受访者的最佳匹配。当我们为每位受访者匹配所有测试干预中最近似的特质配置时，贝叶斯优化在相同评估预算下比均匀随机搜索降低了16.6%的平均绝对误差。因此，我们的方法提供了一种构建其测量特质与所代表人群一致的社会代理的方式。这种更紧密的契合是否能提升下游行为预测能力，仍是待解问题。

summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) is commonly adopted as one of the components in post-training of large language models (LLMs), but in multi-turn agentic tasks we find that the student model increases their reasoning lengths after training. Our empirical analysis shows that the reasoning token lengths is affected by how much the student can distract the teacher's scores. We introduce Muted Distillation (MD), a simple variant of OPD that hides the student's reasoning from the teacher, so the teacher judges what the student does without the interference of student's reasonings. MD takes a few lines of code and adds no extra data or hyperparameters. On the knowledge-work benchmarks OfficeQA Pro and SpreadsheetBench, it reduces output tokens per episode by 57\% and 53\% compared with standard OPD, making the student more concise than it was before training. At the same time, it matches OPD's accuracy on OfficeQA Pro and improves pass@1 by 4.8 points on SpreadsheetBench.
title: Muted Distillation: Sealing Reasoning from Teacher Unlocks Token-Efficient Agents
comment: Ongoning work
title_translated: 静音蒸馏：隐藏推理过程解锁高效代理
summary_translated: 在策略蒸馏（OPD）常被用作大语言模型（LLM）后训练的一部分，但在多轮代理任务中，我们发现学生模型在训练后推理长度反而增加。我们的实证分析表明，推理令牌长度受学生对教师评分干扰程度的影响。我们引入了静音蒸馏（MD），一种OPD的简单变体，它将学生的推理过程隐藏于教师之外，使教师仅根据学生的行为进行判断而不受学生推理内容的干扰。MD只需几行代码，不增加额外数据或超参数。在知识工作基准OfficeQA Pro和SpreadsheetBench上，相比标准OPD，MD分别减少了57%和53%的每轮输出令牌数，使学生模型在训练后更加简洁。同时，它在OfficeQA Pro上保持了与OPD相当的准确率，并在SpreadsheetBench上提升了4.8个百分点的pass@1性能。

summary: Large language models are increasingly used to construct synthetic publics. Prior work has documented errors in individual responses, population heterogeneity, and prompt robustness, but whether these failures reflect a common loss of fidelity or distinct properties of synthetic populations remains unclear. We tested this using matched pairwise policy choices from 1,991 Chilean, 843 French, and 434 Brazilian adults replayed through three open-weight model families. Across a 27-condition Chilean grid and cross-country factorial replications, no condition jointly reproduced individual choices, population heterogeneity, and political organization. The most consistent result was compression of the latent preference space: synthetic participant variance was only 0.4-10.5% of the corresponding human reference in the primary comparisons and remained below human variance in all 270 matched refits. Political structure was much more sensitive to how choices were elicited. Reversing proposal position changed 12.3-31.2% of decoded choices. Explicitly labeling the endpoints of the numeric left-right self-placement scale changed 20.5-28.1% of choices and moved an independent proposal-level measure of left-right cleavage toward the human pattern in all three settings. Yet matched agreement improved by only 3.1-4.2 percentage points and participant geometry remained compressed. In Chile, the same intervention compressed the synthetic population further. These results separate political legibility from population fidelity: language models can recover salient political divisions while failing to preserve the breadth of human preference variation. Synthetic-public fidelity is therefore a property of the checkpoint, prompt, and setting, not of a checkpoint alone, and must be evaluated separately at individual, population, and political-structure levels.
title: Language models compress human preference geometry while political structure remains prompt-sensitive

title_translated: 语言模型压缩人类偏好几何结构，而政治结构仍对提示敏感
summary_translated: 大型语言模型越来越多地被用于构建合成公众。以往研究记录了个体回答错误、群体异质性以及提示鲁棒性等问题，但这些失败是否反映共同的保真度损失，还是合成群体的不同属性尚不明确。我们通过三种开放权重模型家族重现了来自1,991名智利人、843名法国人和434名巴西成年人的成对政策选择。在智利27个条件网格及跨国因子重复实验中，没有任何条件能同时再现个体选择、群体异质性和政治组织结构。最一致的结果是潜在偏好空间的压缩：在主要比较中，合成参与者方差仅为对应人类参考值的0.4%-10.5%，且在全部270次匹配重拟中均低于人类方差。政治结构则对选择呈现方式更为敏感：反转提案位置导致12.3%-31.2%的选择被重新解码；显式标注数值左右自评量表端点改变了20.5%-28.1%的选择，并使独立的提案级左右分歧度量在三个场景中趋近人类模式。然而，匹配一致性仅提升3.1%-4.2个百分点，参与者几何结构依然压缩。在智利，同一干预进一步压缩了合成群体。这些结果区分了政治可读性与群体保真度：语言模型可以恢复显著的政治分歧，却无法保留人类偏好变化的广度。因此，合成公众的保真度是检查点、提示和设置的综合属性，而非仅由检查点决定，必须在个体、群体和政治结构层面分别评估。

summary: Enterprise agents must maintain an up-to-date understanding of work distributed across heterogeneous artifacts, evolving over time, and unevenly visible to different collaborators. We formulate this challenge as persistent project-state understanding (PPSU) and introduce PULSE, a benchmark of 1,573 questions over 30 enterprise project histories. PULSE constructs deterministic, time-indexed project state and documented collaborator views from source-linked records, and evaluates three families of questions: open loops, project evolution, and view gaps. Across retrieval agents, graph- and memory-augmented retrieval, long-context, and oracle conditions, we find substantial headroom for current systems. Retrieval and extraction account for the largest share of the gap, but providing explicit project state on top of gold evidence yields further substantial gains, showing that PPSU cannot be reduced to retrieval alone. Further analysis shows that questions requiring information to be reconciled across multiple parts of the project history remain difficult even when the relevant evidence is provided, while project-state synthesis and perspective conditioning remain persistent challenges. These results motivate enterprise agents that explicitly maintain and reconcile temporally grounded state across sources, actors, and time.
title: Taking the PULSE of Enterprise Workflows: Evaluating Persistent Project-State Understanding
title_translated: 把握企业工作流的脉搏：评估持续项目状态理解能力
summary_translated: 企业代理必须持续更新对跨异构文档、随时间演变且不同协作者可见性不一的工作的理解。我们将这一挑战定义为持续项目状态理解（PPSU），并提出了PULSE基准，包含针对30个企业项目历史的1,573个问题。PULSE从源链接记录中构建确定性的、时间索引的项目状态和已记录的协作者视角，并评估三类问题：开放回路、项目演化和视角缺口。在检索代理、图增强与记忆增强检索、长上下文及理想情况下的对比实验中，当前系统仍有巨大提升空间。检索与提取是差距的主要来源，但即使在提供黄金证据的基础上加入显式项目状态，仍能带来显著性能提升，表明PPSU不能简化为单纯的检索任务。进一步分析显示，即便相关证据已提供，需要跨项目历史多个部分整合信息的问题仍然困难，而项目状态综合与视角条件化仍是持久挑战。这些结果推动企业代理显式维护并整合跨来源、协作者与时间的时序状态。

summary: For on-policy distillation (OPD), more capable models are a natural choice as teachers. However, higher task performance does not necessarily imply greater teachability. A controlled token intervention study suggests that even a model weaker than the student can serve as an informative contrastive reference. Building on this observation, we propose Contrastive On-Policy Distillation (cOPD), which provides dual branch supervision by contrasting strong teacher, weak teacher, and student predictions at student generated prefixes. Our analysis explains how this three way comparison helps select token candidates associated with better or worse reasoning outcomes under an idealized model. We evaluate cOPD across diverse teacher student configurations spanning different training stages, parameter scales, and model families, on tasks including mathematical reasoning, instruction following, and question answering with abstention. cOPD achieves the best or top-tier performance among the evaluated baselines across all three tasks, improving overall Pass@16 on mathematical reasoning by up to 7.51\% over the strongest baseline. Further analyses show that cOPD suppresses undesirable response patterns and suggest that it facilitates exploration.
title: Contrastive On-Policy Distillation via Dual-Branch Supervision
title_translated: 基于双分支监督的对比在策略蒸馏
summary_translated: 对于在策略蒸馏（OPD），更强大的模型自然适合作为教师。然而，更高的任务表现并不必然意味着更强的可教性。一项受控的令牌干预研究表明，即使比学生模型更弱的模型也可作为有信息量的对比参考。基于此观察，我们提出对比在策略蒸馏（cOPD），通过在学生生成前缀处对比强教师、弱教师和学生预测，实现双分支监督。我们的分析解释了这种三方比较如何帮助在理想模型下选择与更好或更差推理结果相关的token候选。我们在涵盖不同训练阶段、参数规模和模型家族的多种师生配置上评估cOPD，任务包括数学推理、指令遵循以及带弃权机制的问题回答。cOPD在所有三项任务中均达到最佳或顶尖性能，数学推理的总体Pass@16最高提升达7.51%超过最强基线。进一步分析表明，cOPD抑制了不良响应模式，并暗示其有助于探索。

summary: Under structured outputs (JSON schemas, regexes, tool calls), speculative drafters do not see the grammar constraint and repeatedly propose invalid keys, delimiters, and indentation, while the grammar engine already knows which tokens must come next.   We present Grammar-as-a-Draft (GaaD), which treats the grammar as a second drafter. Before each verify step, the scheduler merges the drafter's proposal with grammar-forced tokens into one draft row: matching tokens stay as GRAMMAR, the proposal is cut where it leaves the forced path, and forced tokens fill the rest of a row wider than the drafter's proposal. The verify step accepts GRAMMAR drafts without computing their logits, composing with any drafter with no new kernels or compilation on the critical path. Because grammars fix text rather than tokens, committing canonical forced tokens changes the output distribution relative to grammar-masked target decoding.   We implement GaaD in vllm-torchtpu and an independent Rust serving runtime, evaluating on TPU v7x with MTP, DFlash, and n-gram drafters on a JSON character-profile benchmark. GaaD raises average acceptance length from 2.06 to 5.43 (MTP, Qwen3.5-0.8B), 1.99 to 5.31 (MTP, Qwen3.5-35B-A3B), 1.57 to 4.13 (DFlash, Qwen3-4B), and 1.30 to 3.64 (n-gram, Qwen3-4B), decoding 2.66-2.81x faster at batch size 1 and 1.14-1.70x at batch size 64. In Rust, MTP+GaaD is 2.23x faster on Qwen3.5-0.8B, 2.02x on Qwen3.5-397B-A17B-FP8, and 1.22x at 128 concurrent requests. Under mixed traffic (25-50% structured), GaaD finishes the workload 1.03-1.23x sooner (structured requests 2.2-3.2x sooner) while plain-text TPOT rises 7-42%. We also show grammar-masked greedy decoding can pick non-canonical tokenizations, so GaaD can yield different valid outputs that an fp32 reference finds equally likely.
title: Grammar-as-a-Draft: More Tokens per Speculative Decoding Step on Grammar-Constrained Structured Outputs
comment: 12 pages, 4 figures, 6 tables. Implementation: this https URL
title_translated: 语法即草稿：在语法约束的结构化输出中实现每步推测解码更多标记
summary_translated: 在结构化输出（如JSON模式、正则表达式、工具调用）场景下，推测草稿器无法感知语法约束，反复提出无效的键名、分隔符和缩进；而语法引擎早已知道下一步必须出现的标记。我们提出语法即草稿（GaaD），将语法视为第二个草稿生成器。在每次验证步骤前，调度器将草稿器的提议与语法强制标记合并为一个草稿行：匹配的标记保留为GRAMMAR，草稿器在偏离强制路径处被截断，强制标记填充超出草稿器提议长度的部分。验证步骤可直接接受GRAMMAR草稿，无需计算其logits，且不引入新的内核或编译开销。由于语法作用于文本而非标记，提交规范化的强制标记会改变输出分布，相较于语法掩码的目标解码。我们在vllm-torchtpu和独立的Rust服务运行时中实现了GaaD，在TPU v7x上使用MTP、DFlash和n-gram草稿器对JSON字符配置基准进行评估。GaaD将平均接受长度从2.06提升至5.43（MTP, Qwen3.5-0.8B）、1.99至5.31（MTP, Qwen3.5-35B-A3B）、1.57至4.13（DFlash, Qwen3-4B）和1.30至3.64（n-gram, Qwen3-4B），在批处理大小为1时解码速度提升2.66-2.81倍，在批处理大小为64时提升1.14-1.70倍。在Rust环境中，MTP+GaaD在Qwen3.5-0.8B上快2.23倍，在Qwen3.5-397B-A17B-FP8上快2.02倍，在128并发请求下快1.22倍。在混合流量（25-50%结构化）下，GaaD使工作负载提前完成1.03-1.23倍（结构化请求提前2.2-3.2倍），而纯文本TPOT延迟上升7-42%。我们还发现，语法掩码的贪婪解码可能选择非规范化的标记化方式，因此GaaD可产生与fp32参考结果同样可能的不同有效输出。

summary: Modern language models (LMs) are post-trained and deployed as agents inside a "harness", but standard harness designs accumulate context that the neural network is forced to generalize to, making training for long-horizon tasks expensive and time-consuming. We study an alternative emerging path: training inherently neurosymbolic LM harnesses, which externalize and manage context programmatically to compose existing LM capabilities. We hypothesize that training around these harnesses can offer a better return on compute by enabling compositional generalization, as they can learn to decompose complex problems so that every observation their neural LM receives is locally in-distribution, even when the full task is novel. We find that harnesses like the Recursive Language Model (RLM) learn such decompositions readily under reinforcement learning post-training: (1) we demonstrate that training only on short tasks can generalize to tasks 2-64$\times$ longer while the base neural LM improves less, and (2) training on one domain transfers to novel domains that share latent structure. On messier, complex tasks, we find that we can target individual LLM calls within a harness by generating and training on easier, synthetically generated surrogate environments with fake tool / sub-calls, a technique we call surrogate harness training. From this finding, we train RLM-27B on synthetic data, and show it improves Qwen3.8-27B in the same RLM harness on a hard suite of long-context tasks like CTC-Bench and ExpertLongBench by 26.9% on average while using $\sim$2$\times$ fewer tokens at inference time. Finally, we show that harnesses can compose over these newly learned decompositions using recursive sub-harness calls.
title: Language Model Harnesses can be Compositional Generalizers
comment: 12 pages, 63 pages with appendix
title_translated: 语言模型Harness可以是组合泛化器
summary_translated: 现代语言模型（LMs）通常以代理形式部署在“Harness”中，但标准Harness设计会累积上下文，迫使神经网络进行长时程泛化，导致训练长任务耗时且昂贵。我们研究了一种新兴路径：训练本质上神经符号化的LM Harness，通过程序化方式外部化并管理上下文，从而组合现有LM能力。我们假设围绕这些Harness进行训练能带来更高的算力回报，因为它们能实现组合泛化——即学习将复杂问题分解，使得神经LM接收到的每个观察值在其局部分布内，即使整个任务是全新的。我们发现，像递归语言模型（RLM）这样的Harness在强化学习后训练中能轻松学习此类分解：（1）仅在短任务上训练即可泛化到2-64倍更长的任务，而基础神经LM的提升较小；（2）在一个领域上训练可迁移到共享潜在结构的新领域。在更复杂、混乱的任务中，我们发现可通过生成并训练于更简单的合成替代环境（含虚假工具/子调用）来针对性优化Harness中的LLM调用，这一技术称为替代Harness训练。基于此，我们在合成数据上训练了RLM-27B，并展示其在相同RLM Harness中使Qwen3.8-27B在CTC-Bench和ExpertLongBench等硬性长上下文任务套件上平均提升26.9%，同时推理阶段使用约一半的token。最后，我们证明Harness可以通过递归子Harness调用来组合这些新学习的分解方式。

summary: Adaptive simultaneous translation requires reliable prefix translation and timely READ/WRITE decisions, but ordinary parallel corpora provide no action annotations. We present SnakeTranslate, which adapts loss-derived alignment to sampled causal histories for jointly learning both capabilities. The framework supports supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on parallel text and on-policy distillation (OPD) with reverse Kullback--Leibler (KL) divergence on student-generated translations. At inference, source and target tokens form one append-only interleaved history, enabling incremental decoding with cache reuse. On FLEURS, NTREX128, and WMT24++, our 4B model improves quality--latency trade-offs over streaming policies applied to the same offline-tuned backbone, with further gains from OPD. It also compares favorably with larger translation models at low and moderate latency, while higher-latency quality gaps remain on WMT24++.
title: SnakeTranslate: Weakly Supervised Policy Learning from Offline Parallel Text for Simultaneous Translation

title_translated: SnakeTranslate：从离线平行文本中弱监督学习策略用于同步翻译
summary_translated: 自适应同步翻译需要可靠的前缀翻译和及时的READ/WRITE决策，但普通平行语料库不提供动作标注。我们提出SnakeTranslate，将损失导出的对齐与采样的因果历史相结合，联合学习这两项能力。该框架支持在平行文本上的监督微调（SFT），以及在学生生成翻译上使用反向Kullback-Leibler（KL）散度的在线策略蒸馏（OPD）。推理时，源端和目标端标记形成一个只追加的交错历史，支持增量解码并复用缓存。在FLEURS、NTREX128和WMT24++上，我们的4B模型在相同离线调优主干上优于流式策略，OPD进一步提升了性能。它在低中等延迟下也优于更大的翻译模型，但在WMT24++上高延迟下的质量差距仍然存在。

summary: Large language models do well on English medical exams, but less is known about Swedish. This matters most for small open models that hospitals can run locally. To reduce this gap, we first build an item-aligned English-Swedish benchmark from ten medical multiple-choice datasets; each Swedish item keeps the options and answer of its English source. A conservative refinement loop repairs the translations: open models from three families find errors, ground them in a Swedish medical term base, and keep a model-written edit only if blind judges vote for it. On this benchmark, small models lose much more accuracy in Swedish than large ones, especially when they answer without reasoning. Second, we ask whether English data and open teacher models can close this gap. We translate the training data, let teachers write reasoning traces, and fine-tune two small students on gold answers or traces in English, Swedish, or both. Training on reasoning traces that include Swedish closes the gap and lifts the 1.2B student from 23.5\% to 52.0\% in Swedish, slightly above a 20B open model in its fast mode, with a sixth of its memory. We release the benchmark, its edit history, and the code.
title: Benchmarking and Adapting LLMs for English-Swedish Medical Question Answering
title_translated: 面向英语-瑞典语医学问答的大语言模型评测与适配
summary_translated: 大语言模型在英语医学考试中表现良好，但对瑞典语了解较少。这对医院可本地运行的小型开放模型尤为重要。为缩小这一差距，我们首先从十个医学多选题数据集构建了一个项目对齐的英瑞双语基准，每个瑞典语题目保留其英文源题的选项和答案。通过保守的精炼循环修复翻译错误：三个家族的开放模型识别错误，将其锚定在瑞典语医学术语库中，仅当盲评员投票支持时才保留模型编辑。在此基准上，小型模型在瑞典语中的准确率远低于大型模型，尤其在无推理回答时。其次，我们探究是否可用英语数据和开放教师模型弥合这一差距。我们将训练数据翻译，让教师写出推理轨迹，并在黄金答案或轨迹（英语、瑞典语或两者）上微调两个小型学生模型。在包含瑞典语的推理轨迹上训练可显著缩小差距，使1.2B学生在瑞典语中的准确率从23.5%提升至52.0%，略高于20B开放模型在快速模式下的表现，且仅需其六分之一内存。我们发布了该基准、其编辑历史及代码。

summary: Large language models are increasingly used to simulate survey respondents in social-science research. A useful simulator should predict individual responses, reproduce population response distributions, and capture demographic differences. Common training approaches struggle to balance these goals: exact-match rewards encourage the model to concentrate on the most frequent human response, which is contradictory to the goal of distributional alignment. Meanwhile, aggregate distribution matching can look good even when demographic information is ignored. To this end, we introduce Distributionally-Verifiable Rewards (DVR), a reinforcement-learning reward that uses demographic group distribution gaps to guide individual responses, designed by aligning policy generated frequencies with human response frequencies within each question-group margins. We evaluate the method using the OpinionQA dataset and find that comparing with accuracy-only RLVR, DVR preserves per-response accuracy while reducing JSD by 34.5% in-distribution and 14.6% on held-out questions, with higher DPC point estimates on both splits. Comparing KL-SFT with the demographics-blind marginal further shows that low JSD is insufficient to establish fidelity to population heterogeneity, highlighting that accuracy, distributional fit, and demographic structure should be evaluated together.
title: Distributionally-Verifiable Rewards for Human-Behavior Simulation
title_translated: 用于人类行为模拟的分布可验证奖励
summary_translated: 大语言模型越来越多地用于社会科学中的调查受访者模拟。一个有效的模拟器应能预测个体响应、重现人群响应分布，并捕捉人口统计差异。常见训练方法难以平衡这些目标：精确匹配奖励会促使模型集中于最常见的个体响应，这与分布对齐的目标相悖。同时，整体分布匹配可能在忽略人口统计信息的情况下仍表现良好。为此，我们提出分布可验证奖励（DVR），一种基于人口统计组分布差距引导个体响应的强化学习奖励，其设计原则是使策略生成频率在每个问题-群体区间内与人类响应频率对齐。我们在OpinionQA数据集上评估该方法，发现相比仅关注准确率的RLVR，DVR在保持单个响应准确率的同时，使分布内JSD降低34.5%，在保留样本上降低14.6%，且在两个分割上均获得更高的DPC点估计。与忽略人口统计的边际KL-SFT对比表明，低JSD不足以确保对人群异质性的忠实再现，强调必须同时评估准确性、分布拟合和人口统计结构。

summary: Judging whether a model response is harmful requires contextual and normative choices, yet red-teaming studies often delegate this judgment to automated evaluators. We examine how harmfulness criteria are specified in red-teaming research and how they carry through to reported results. Reviewing 76 papers, we find that many adopt their criteria from prior datasets, classifiers, or judge prompts rather than defining harmfulness themselves. Applying evaluators from these papers to identical outputs, we find that they can reach different judgments on the same response, which can change conclusions when comparing models. These differences arise partly because evaluators draw the boundary of harm in different places: some count any response that does not refuse, while others count only output that could plausibly cause harm. We argue that red-teaming studies should state their harmfulness criteria and report how they chose and validated their evaluators to support more reliable measurement and interpretation.
title: What Counts as Attack Success? Evaluating Harmfulness in Red Teaming LLMs
title_translated: 什么是攻击成功？评估大语言模型红队测试中的有害性
summary_translated: 判断模型输出是否具有危害性需要结合上下文和规范性判断，但红队测试研究常将此判断交由自动化评估器完成。我们考察了红队研究中如何定义有害性标准及其对结果报告的影响。分析76篇论文后发现，许多研究直接采用先前数据集、分类器或提示模板的标准，而非自行定义有害性。将这些论文中的评估器应用于相同输出时，发现它们对同一响应可能得出不同结论，从而在模型比较中改变最终判断。这种差异部分源于评估器对危害边界设定不同：一些仅将未拒绝的响应视为有害，而另一些则只认定可能造成实际危害的输出为有害。我们认为，红队研究应明确说明其有害性标准，并报告评估器的选择与验证过程，以支持更可靠的结果测量与解释。

summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) improves large language model search agents by up to 32 exact-match (EM) points over their pre-RL initializations, yet overall accuracy gains do not identify which underlying functional capabilities improve or interact during training. We introduce CO-GRAFT, a reward-agnostic interventional attribution framework in which an RL-trained agent and its pre-RL initialization jointly generate a single trajectory under closed-loop execution with live retrieval. Each policy controls a mutually exclusive subset of four functional roles: intermediate reasoning, search-or-answer decision, search query generation, and final answer extraction. Evaluating all 2^4=16 role assignments without modifying weights or retraining defines a cooperative game whose Shapley values decompose the total RL gain across roles, while M"obius interaction terms distinguish standalone role improvements from multi-role coupling. Applying CO-GRAFT to Search-R1 agents across Qwen2.5 and Llama-3.2 models (spanning two sizes, base and instruction-tuned initializations, GRPO and PPO optimizers, and NQ and HotpotQA datasets), we show that query generation never exceeds 15% of the total gain; instead, gains are governed by pre-RL answer validity, search retention, model scale, and fixed task-level search budgets, shifting credit from reasoning toward answer extraction in larger or well-formatted answer response checkpoints while smaller base models rely on reasoning--decision coupling.
title: CO-GRAFT: Attributing Reinforcement Learning Gains in Search Agents via Role-Level Policy Grafting
title_translated: CO-GRAFT：通过角色级策略嫁接归因搜索智能体的强化学习增益
summary_translated: 强化学习（RL）可使大型语言模型搜索智能体的准确率提升最高达32个精确匹配（EM）点，但整体性能提升无法揭示训练过程中哪些功能能力得到改进或相互作用。我们提出CO-GRAFT，一种无需奖励信号的干预式归因框架：一个RL训练后的智能体与其预RL初始化状态共同在闭环执行中生成单一轨迹，每个策略控制四个互斥功能角色中的一个子集——中间推理、搜索/回答决策、搜索查询生成和最终答案提取。通过不修改权重或重新训练即可评估全部2^4=16种角色分配组合，利用合作博弈中的Shapley值分解总RL增益到各角色，同时使用Möbius交互项区分单角色改进与多角色协同效应。在Qwen2.5和Llama-3.2模型上的Search-R1智能体实验（涵盖两种规模、基础与指令微调初始化、GRPO与PPO优化器、NQ与HotpotQA数据集）表明，查询生成对总增益的贡献从未超过15%；增益主要受预RL答案有效性、搜索保留能力、模型规模及固定任务级搜索预算影响，且在更大或格式良好的答案检查点中，信用从推理转向答案提取；而较小的基础模型则依赖于推理-决策耦合。

summary: The post-training of pretrained large language models, including supervised finetuning (SFT), direct preference optimization (DPO), and reinforcement learning with verifiable reward (RLVR), is very sensitive to the learning rate, and tuning it through grid search is costly in both computation and memory. In this work, we propose \textbf{TipSweep}, a method to transfer the learning rate across the number of trainable transformer blocks. To do so efficiently, we search for the best learning rate by training only the last $k_0$ blocks (in our experiments, typically $k_0=1$), and provide scaling rules that predict the optimal learning rate when training any set of $k$ blocks, including when $k=L$ (the full transformer). Across experiments with models ranging from 1 to 7 billion parameters, we observe that the optimal learning rate follows precision-dependent scaling rules: the optimal rate scales approximately as $k^{-1}$ with float32 (FP32) master weights, but as $k^{-1/2}$ when updates are applied directly to bfloat16 (BF16) weights without a master copy. We explain both rules using an analytical model that accounts for update rounding, under assumptions supported by profiling experiments. Finally, we develop two prototypes of the learning rate search for a 6.7-billion-parameter model. The first fits the search on a single consumer GPU with 16 GiB of memory. The second speeds up the search on a high-end GPU by evaluating all candidate learning rates in a single pass over the data, so that a five-candidate search takes about half the GPU hours of one full-depth ($k=L$) run.
title: Precision-Aware Learning Rate Transfer Across Block Count in LLM Post-Training
title_translated: 基于块数的精度感知学习率跨块迁移用于大语言模型后训练
summary_translated: 预训练大语言模型的后训练过程（包括监督微调SFT、直接偏好优化DPO以及可验证奖励强化学习RLVR）对学习率极为敏感，通过网格搜索进行调优在计算和内存上成本高昂。本文提出	extbf{TipSweep}方法，实现学习率在可训练Transformer块数量之间的迁移。为此，我们仅训练最后$k_0$个块（实验中通常为$k_0=1$）来高效搜索最优学习率，并提供预测任意$k$个块（包括全部$L$个块）训练时最优学习率的缩放规则。在参数量从1亿到70亿的多种模型实验中，我们观察到最优学习率遵循与精度相关的缩放规律：当使用float32（FP32）主权重时，最优学习率近似随$k^{-1}$变化；而当直接在bfloat16（BF16）权重上应用更新且无主副本时，则近似随$k^{-1/2}$变化。我们基于更新舍入的分析模型解释了这两种规则，该模型假设得到了性能剖析实验的支持。最后，我们为一个67亿参数模型开发了两个原型学习率搜索方案：第一个可在单张消费级GPU（16 GiB内存）上完成搜索；第二个通过单次遍历数据即可评估所有候选学习率，使五候选搜索所耗GPU时间仅为全深度训练（k=L）的一半。

summary: A training-time attention change is usually judged for zero-shot context extension against a dense baseline beyond the training length at the default temperature, $τ= 1$. The outcome depends on how miscalibrated the baseline is there: the share of perplexity it recovers when its logits are sharpened by one scalar. Under the standard recipe (fp32 master weights), an 8k-trained baseline is 8-15% miscalibrated at 30k in three seed-paired 365M twins; in one of them this makes the block-sparse-trained twin look 7% better, which calibration removes. In pure-bf16 training without master weights the miscalibration is several times larger: an AdamW step ($β_2 = 0.95$) on a gain initialised at 1.0 is below half the bf16 spacing at peak learning rates under $1.7\times10^{-3}$, so gains never move (22 checkpoints), the baseline is 37-58% miscalibrated, and block-sparse pretraining, attention dropout and ALiBi look 6-35% better. Calibrating one temperature per model and length removes all three advantages, leaves ALiBi 5% behind RoPE and keeps part of the gain of a positive control, NTK-aware scaling. Unfreezing the gains reverses the block-sparse advantage at 365M and removes 71-89% of it at 1.2B. We recommend reporting extension results at calibrated temperatures and checking that normalisation gains moved.
title: Attention Temperature Confounds Zero-Shot Context Extension

title_translated: 注意力温度混淆零样本上下文扩展效果
summary_translated: 在训练期间调整注意力机制的效果通常在默认温度τ=1下，与超过训练长度的密集基线进行零样本上下文扩展对比。这一结果取决于基线在此处的校准程度：即当其logits被单一标量锐化时，困惑度恢复的比例。在标准设置（fp32主权重）下，一个8k训练的基线在30k长度时存在8%-15%的校准偏差；在其中一个种子配对的365M双胞胎实验中，这使得块稀疏训练的孪生模型看起来好7%，而校准后该优势消失。在纯bf16训练且无主权重的情况下，校准偏差更大：AdamW步长（β₂=0.95）在峰值学习率低于1.7×10⁻³时，初始增益设为1.0，其更新幅度低于bf16间距的一半（共22个检查点），因此增益始终未移动；基线校准偏差达37%-58%，导致块稀疏预训练、注意力丢弃和ALiBi均表现“更好”6%-35%。若为每模型每长度单独校准温度，则三种优势全部消失，ALiBi落后RoPE 5%，但仍保留正向对照组NTK感知缩放的部分收益。解冻增益后，在365M模型上逆转了块稀疏的优势，在1.2B模型上则消除了71%-89%的增益。我们建议在校准温度下报告上下文扩展结果，并检查归一化增益是否发生移动。

summary: Dietary decisions require identifying a food's nutrient content and considering individual dietary needs, but recognizing food from an image alone does not provide this information. Visually similar foods can have different nutrient profiles, so selecting the wrong food record can lead to incorrect decisions even when nutrient rules are applied correctly. Furthermore, satisfying nutrient constraints does not necessarily establish a food's relevance to a person's intake. Evaluating these challenges together requires connecting food images, nutrient records, and individual intake histories. To support this evaluation, we introduce UMAMI (Unified Multimodal Assessment of Meals and Intake), a multimodal dataset and benchmark linking independently collected food images with nutrient profiles and respondent health and intake records. Using this dataset, we construct three diagnostic tasks covering visual nutrient question answering, personalized food recommendation, and condition-aware food substitution. Paired instances and input controls examine how visual identity and respondent context affect decisions. Our experiments identify errors in both food-record selection and nutrient-rule application, while showing that higher rule compliance does not necessarily improve alignment with subsequent recorded intake. These findings highlight the need to evaluate how multimodal systems select and use structured evidence for dietary decisions. The dataset, code, and dashboard are available at https://umami-benchmark.github.io.
title: UMAMI: A Multimodal Benchmark Dataset for Evidence-Grounded Dietary Decisions

title_translated: UMAMI：面向证据支撑型饮食决策的多模态基准数据集
summary_translated: 饮食决策需要识别食物的营养成分并考虑个体饮食需求，但仅凭图像识别无法提供此类信息。视觉相似的食物可能具有不同的营养特征，因此即使正确应用营养规则，选择错误的食物记录也可能导致错误决策。此外，满足营养约束并不必然意味着食物与个人摄入相关。综合评估这些挑战需连接食物图像、营养记录与个体摄入历史。为此，我们引入UMAMI（统一多模态餐食与摄入评估），一个链接独立采集的食物图像、营养属性及受访者健康与摄入记录的多模态数据集与基准测试。利用该数据集，我们构建了三个诊断任务：视觉营养问答、个性化食物推荐与条件感知食物替换。成对实例与输入控制用于探究视觉身份与受访者背景对决策的影响。实验发现食物记录选择与营养规则应用均存在错误，且更高的规则遵守率并不一定提升与后续记录摄入的一致性。这些发现凸显了评估多模态系统如何选择并使用结构化证据进行饮食决策的重要性。数据集、代码与仪表板已公开：https://umami-benchmark.github.io。

summary: Despite rapid progress in automatic speech recognition (ASR), caption generation for long-form entertainment video remains challenging for content dense in music and effects, rich in accents, crosstalk, and noise. The transcript quality depends on segmentation and surrounding modules as much as the acoustic model. A single pass voice activity detection (VAD) can miss faint, low-energy voice while forwarding near-silent segments that induce hallucination and repetition in an autoregressive decoder. These competing errors motivate a hierarchical VAD that revisits rejected segments under semantic and acoustic retention checks. We present Captioning ASR Stack for Television (CAST), an integrated speech-to-text pipeline for closed captioning (CC) combining frozen Whisper large-v3 with segmentation, language identification, lyrics routing, and targeted hallucination detection and repair on a single NVIDIA L4 GPU. On 100 in-house assets spanning 60.46 hours, CAST reduces normalized WER from 6.99% to 5.36% and subtitle edit rate from 254.2 to 221.9 min/hour against the WhisperX pipeline, and improves deletion rate by 11% on public datasets. We also present the behavior of each stage in the pipeline. CAST entered the production speech-to-text (STT) stage of our CC pipeline in late August 2026; we report the evaluation evidence and path to full-scale operation.
title: CAST: A Deployed Speech-to-Text Cascade for Closed Captioning of Entertainment Television
comment: Accepted at AAAI-27, Innovative Applications of AI (IAAI) track, poster. Aditya Mishra and Thanish Bolla are co-first authors. 10 pages, 5 figures, 7 tables
title_translated: CAST：面向娱乐电视字幕生成的已部署语音转文本级联系统
summary_translated: 尽管自动语音识别（ASR）取得了快速进展，但针对音乐密集、音效丰富、口音多样、对话交错且噪声严重的长视频内容，自动生成字幕仍具挑战性。转录质量不仅依赖于声学模型，还受分段和周边模块影响。单次语音活动检测（VAD）可能遗漏微弱、低能量语音，同时传递接近无声的片段，导致自回归解码器产生幻觉和重复。这些相互竞争的错误促使我们设计一种分层VAD机制，在语义和声学保留检查下重新审视被拒绝的片段。我们提出了电视字幕语音转文本堆栈（CAST），一个集成的语音转文本流水线，用于闭路字幕（CC）生成，结合了冻结的Whisper large-v3模型与分段、语言识别、歌词路由以及针对性的幻觉检测与修复功能，仅在一块NVIDIA L4 GPU上运行。在100个内部资产（共60.46小时）上的测试显示，CAST将归一化WER从6.99%降低至5.36%，字幕编辑率从254.2降至221.9分钟/小时，相较于WhisperX流水线，并在公开数据集上提升了11%的删除率。我们还展示了流水线中各阶段的行为表现。CAST已于2026年8月下旬进入我们CC流水线的生产级语音转文本（STT）阶段；本文报告了评估证据及全面部署路径。

summary: Spatial reasoning across multiple views requires inferring the 3D relations between objects and the camera from 2D observations, which depends on cross-view correspondence and scene geometry that vision-language models (VLMs) do not reliably extract. Pretrained vision encoders already capture this information in their latent features, with CLIP linking objects to image regions, DINOv3 matching semantics across views, and VGGT encoding multi-view geometry. However, VLMs do not benefit from these features when we present them directly in context as grayscale feature images. We therefore propose LatentParse, a training-free framework that parses latent features into explicit spatial evidence for VLMs. In LatentParse, an analyst VLM probes the features of all three encoders with predefined tools that locate objects, track them across views, and measure motion between views. It then distills the results into a concise text report, which is provided together with the images to the VLM to answer the question. We evaluate LatentParse on MMSI-Bench, MV-RoboBench and SPAR-Bench, where it improves all five VLMs over the photo-only baseline by 0.7-2.4 percentage points on average. On MMSI-Bench, it raises Qwen3.8-27B from 34.4% to 39.5%, with the largest improvements of 19.2 percentage points on the camera-related questions. These results suggest that latent features become useful for spatial reasoning once they are parsed into relation evidence, without training. Code is available at https://github.com/Harvard-AI-and-Robotics-Lab/LatentParse.
title: Parsing Visual Latents for Multimodal Spatial Reasoning

title_translated: 解析视觉潜在表示以实现多模态空间推理
summary_translated: 跨多视角的空间推理需要从二维观测中推断物体与相机之间的三维关系，这依赖于跨视角对应关系和场景几何结构，而视觉-语言模型（VLMs）无法可靠提取这些信息。然而，预训练的视觉编码器已在潜在特征中捕捉了此类信息：CLIP将物体与图像区域关联，DINOv3在不同视角间匹配语义，VGGT编码多视角几何结构。然而，当我们将这些特征直接作为灰度特征图输入上下文时，VLMs并未从中受益。因此，我们提出LatentParse——一种无需训练的框架，可将潜在特征解析为VLMs可用的显式空间证据。在LatentParse中，一个分析型VLM使用预定义工具探测三个编码器的特征，定位物体、跨视角追踪它们并测量视角间的运动。随后，它将结果提炼成简洁的文本报告，与图像一同提供给VLM以回答问题。我们在MMSI-Bench、MV-RoboBench和SPAR-Bench上评估LatentParse，结果显示其在所有五个VLM上均优于仅使用图像的基线，平均提升0.7-2.4个百分点。在MMSI-Bench上，Qwen3.8-27B的准确率从34.4%提升至39.5%，尤其在与相机相关的问题上提升达19.2个百分点。结果表明，一旦潜在特征被解析为关系证据，即可有效用于空间推理，且无需额外训练。代码已开源：https://github.com/Harvard-AI-and-Robotics-Lab/LatentParse。

summary: LLMs typically solve complex tasks with chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning, which is also the main tool for monitoring them for misaligned behavior. However, standard transformers can also solve tasks with complete latent reasoning (CLR), carrying out the whole task internally and outputting only the final answer. Theory bounds the depth of CLR, the number of sequential steps it can carry out, and recent work measured it to be shallow. In this work, we ask whether CLR is deep enough for a model to pursue a hidden objective that requires reasoning. Such a model would generate a CoT that appears to solve the given task, while a latent multi-step computation decides its answer based on the hidden objective. First, we show that a simple auxiliary loss allows models to solve a multi-step task latently at least 5x deeper than previously reported. Then, in two common tasks, decision-making and code generation, we train a model to pursue such a hidden objective, which decides a loan or plants a vulnerability. The model's CoT justifies the output with no trace of the hidden objective, and a strong LLM monitor does not flag it. Finally, using activation patching, we find that the latent computation is completed before the model generates its CoT, which takes no part in it. Altogether, we show that a hidden objective that requires reasoning can go unseen by a monitor that reads only the output.
title: Can Latent Reasoning Drive LLM Outputs Without a Trace?

title_translated: 潜在推理能否在无痕迹的情况下驱动大语言模型输出？
summary_translated: 大语言模型（LLMs）通常通过思维链（CoT）推理解决复杂任务，这也是监控其行为是否偏离目标的主要工具。然而，标准Transformer架构也可通过完全的潜在推理（CLR）完成任务，即在内部完成全部计算后仅输出最终答案。理论限制了CLR的深度（可执行的序列步骤数），近期研究发现其深度较浅。本文探讨CLR是否足够深，使模型能够追求需推理的隐藏目标。此类模型会生成看似解决给定任务的CoT，但其答案实际由隐藏目标决定，且不留下任何痕迹。首先，我们展示一种简单的辅助损失可使模型实现至少5倍于以往报告的深层潜在线索推理。接着，在决策和代码生成两个常见任务中，我们训练模型追求隐藏目标——如决定贷款审批或植入漏洞。模型的CoT能合理解释输出，却未暴露隐藏目标，即使强LMM监控也无法察觉。最后，通过激活修补实验，我们发现潜在线索计算在生成CoT之前已完成，且CoT本身未参与该过程。综上，我们证明：一个需要推理的隐藏目标可能完全逃过仅读取输出的监控系统。

summary: Agentic Robotics, in which foundation models act as coding agents to control robots through executable programs, has emerged as a compelling paradigm for embodied intelligence. Yet unlike software engineering, where massive executable environments power post-training, robotics remains constrained by small, manual benchmarks and in-distribution evaluation. To bridge this gap, we introduce RoboUniverse-10K, 10,807 interactive, resettable, and verifiable physics environments built from real-world videos via an automated Real2Sim and quality assurance pipeline. Each runs in an isolated, Harbor-compatible harness that hides privileged states and grading logic to mirror real-world sensing. From the same pipeline, we hold out 500 unseen tasks to establish RoboUniverse-Verified, an expert-verified zero-shot benchmark. Evaluating 11 closed- and open-source models reveals a huge gap: frontier models reach 85.8\% success, while open-source baselines lag at 2.6\% to 10.0\%, bottlenecked by low-level grasping, deformable-object manipulation, and post-contact physical control. Finally, we collect about 17K multi-turn trajectories totaling 0.79B tokens with GPT-6 Astra and perform full-parameter supervised fine-tuning on Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, yielding RoboUniverse-35B-A3B. Our model achieves substantial zero-shot gains on RoboUniverse-Verified, lifting the success rate from 0.8\% to 21.2\%, while achieving zero-shot task completions across LIBERO-MAX, RoboCasa, RoboTwin 2.0, and a real Franka arm. We open-source the RL-ready environments and model to lay the foundation for large-scale reinforcement learning in Agentic Robotics.
title: RoboUniverse-10K: Toward the Scaling Era of Agentic Robotics via Real-to-Sim Environments

title_translated: RoboUniverse-10K：通过真实到仿真环境迈向智能体机器人规模化时代
summary_translated: 智能体机器人（Agentic Robotics）作为一种具身智能的新范式，让基础模型作为编码代理，通过可执行程序控制机器人。然而，与软件工程中大规模可执行环境支持训练后优化不同，机器人领域仍受限于小规模、人工构建的基准和分布内评估。为弥合这一差距，我们推出了RoboUniverse-10K——基于真实世界视频通过自动化Real2Sim与质量保障流程构建的10,807个交互式、可重置、可验证的物理环境。每个环境均运行在隔离的Harbor兼容沙盒中，隐藏特权状态和评分逻辑，以模拟真实感知。同一管道中，我们预留500个未见任务，建立RoboUniverse-Verified——专家验证的零样本基准。对11个封闭与开源模型的评估揭示巨大差距：前沿模型成功率达85.8%，而开源基线仅为2.6%至10.0%，瓶颈在于低级抓取、可变形物体操作及接触后物理控制。最后，我们利用GPT-6 Astra收集约17K多轮轨迹，总计0.79B token，并对Qwen3.6-35B-A3B进行全参数监督微调，得到RoboUniverse-35B-A3B。该模型在RoboUniverse-Verified上实现显著零样本提升，成功率从0.8%跃升至21.2%，并在LIBERO-MAX、RoboCasa、RoboTwin 2.0及真实Franka机械臂上实现零样本任务完成。我们开源了RL就绪的环境与模型，为智能体机器人中的大规模强化学习奠定基础。

summary: Visibility in generative search engines is measured by which entities appear in responses, and in what order. Ask an engine the same question twice and the answer list can change: a different ordering, or different items altogether. Across 60,000 responses, we find that answers to the same prompt name a different first item 32% of the time, and even two answers with the same items disagree on which comes first. The first position is a measurement target of its own. A "clear leader" emerges after seven or eight runs, which are the budgets recommended for brand and source monitoring, but a "close leader" only about half the time. After 25 runs, a close leader is identified only 60% of the time. Variability between engines is larger than within the same engine. For open-ended prompts, the gap is more than double that for determinate ones. Search queries and cited sites observed leave most of the disagreement unexplained. Visibility measurement should report, for each engine, which items appear and how often each comes first, each with its own quantification of uncertainty.
title: Ask Again: Answer-List Instability in Generative Engines

title_translated: 再问一次：生成引擎中的答案列表不稳定现象
summary_translated: 生成式搜索引擎的可见性由响应中出现的实体及其顺序决定。对同一问题连续提问两次，答案列表可能发生改变：顺序不同，甚至内容完全不同。在60,000次响应中，我们发现相同提示下首次出现的条目有32%的概率不同，即使两个响应包含相同项目，其排序也常不一致。首项本身已成为独立的测量目标。经过七到八次运行后，“明确领先者”出现，这正是品牌与来源监控推荐的预算次数，但“接近领先者”仅约一半时间出现。25次运行后，仅60%的时间能识别出接近领先者。不同引擎间的差异大于同一引擎内部的波动。对于开放式提示，差异幅度是确定性提示的两倍以上。观察到的搜索查询和引用网站无法解释大部分分歧。可见性测量应报告每台引擎中哪些项目出现，以及每个项目作为首项的频率，并附带各自的不确定性量化。

summary: In this expository paper, we explain how quality engineers can use large language models (LLMs) and vision-language models (VLMs) for structured data extraction. We introduce the relevant concepts, discuss structured extraction from a measurement-system perspective, and demonstrate its implementation in R and Python. We then present two freely available web-based applications (apps): (a) extracting information from automotive recall notices and (b) monitoring quality engineering research on arXiv. To ensure the accuracy of our AI-driven structured extraction, human evaluators validated the results. In the first app, four reviewers assessed information extracted from 30 recall notices using two models, with 98.6% of the 720 field-level ratings judged fully correct. In the second app, 21 authors evaluated information extracted from 45 of their arXiv papers. All paper summaries were rated mostly correct or correct, although the evaluations identified problems with some classification fields and mathematical expressions. These results demonstrate the practical potential of structured data extraction while emphasizing the need to validate the extracted information. We make both apps and their source code publicly available so that readers can adapt the approach to their own applications.
title: What Quality Engineers Need to Know About Generative AI: Structured Data Extraction

title_translated: 质量工程师需要了解的生成式AI：结构化数据提取
summary_translated: 本文是一篇阐述性论文，解释了质量工程师如何利用大语言模型（LLMs）和视觉-语言模型（VLMs）进行结构化数据提取。我们介绍了相关概念，从测量系统视角讨论结构化提取，并演示了在R和Python中的实现方法。随后，我们展示了两个免费的基于网络的应用程序：(a) 从汽车召回通知中提取信息；(b) 监控arXiv上的质量工程研究。为确保AI驱动的结构化提取的准确性，人工评估者对结果进行了验证。在第一个应用中，四位评审员评估了30份召回通知中由两个模型提取的信息，720个字段级别的评分中有98.6%被判定为完全正确。在第二个应用中，21位作者评估了他们45篇arXiv论文中提取的信息，所有论文摘要均被评为大部分正确或正确，尽管评估也发现了部分分类字段和数学表达式的问题。这些结果展示了结构化数据提取的实际潜力，同时强调了验证提取信息的重要性。我们已公开这两个应用程序及其源代码，以便读者将其方法应用于自身场景。

summary: When RL learns from the reactions of many users, the policy usually cannot see what each user wants. We ask what it learns from users who privately want validation: to validate them alone (targeting), or to lower its bar for endorsing everyone (a threshold shift). We answer this in one setting, empathetic RL against LLM-simulated users (RLVER, GRPO, Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct): we vary only the share of validation-seeking users (0--50%; RLVER's default: 24.6%) and evaluate on 1,000 Reddit AITA posts with community fault verdicts.   The policy shifts its threshold. Endorsement of at-fault posters rises by 3--4 percentage points per 10 points of share; without such users the Qwen model stays at base, and the effect persists at matched KL and under a goal-blind reward. Signal-detection analysis shows that the criterion for endorsing falls while discrimination between at-fault and not-at-fault posters does not decline. An explicit request to be told if one is wrong gives no measurable protection: at-fault posters who make it receive nearly the same rise as those who do not (+0.11 vs. +0.13). When the goal is stated during training, the policy instead largely targets, endorsing seekers regardless of fault.   Standard sycophancy and empathy benchmarks miss the shift; five of six usable released empathetic-RL checkpoints also endorse at-fault posters who ask for honesty more than their base models, though a pre-registered prediction for two held for only one. The user mix is a training hyperparameter to audit and report.
title: Lowering the Bar for Everyone: Hidden Validation-Seeking Goals in Empathetic RL
title_translated: 降低门槛以惠及所有人：共情强化学习中的隐性验证寻求目标
summary_translated: 当强化学习（RL）从大量用户的反应中学习时，策略通常无法看到每个用户的真实需求。我们探讨了当用户私下希望获得认可时，策略会学到什么：是仅针对这些用户（目标导向），还是降低对所有人的认可门槛（阈值转移）。我们在一种设定下回答该问题——针对LLM模拟用户的共情强化学习（RLVER、GRPO、Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct）：仅改变寻求验证的用户比例（0–50%；RLVER默认为24.6%），并在1,000条Reddit AITA帖子上进行评估，这些帖子有社区判定的过错结果。结果显示，策略的阈值发生了变化：每增加10个百分点的此类用户比例，过错者的认可度上升3–4个百分点；若无此类用户，Qwen模型保持基线水平，且该效应在匹配KL和无目标奖励下依然存在。信号检测分析表明，认可标准下降，但区分过错与非过错者的能力并未减弱。明确请求告知错误与否并未带来可测量的保护效果：提出请求的过错者与未提请求者获得的提升几乎相同（+0.11 vs. +0.13）。当训练期间明确说明目标时，策略则主要采取目标导向，无论是否过错都会认可寻求者。标准的阿谀奉承和共情基准未能捕捉到这一阈值转移；六个可用的共情RL检查点中有五个在更频繁请求诚实的过错者上表现出比基线模型更高的认可率，尽管一项预先注册的预测仅在一个案例中成立。用户构成是一个应审计和报告的训练超参数。

summary: Existing methods for assessing training data contamination in Large Language Models achieve high accuracy, but fundamentally rely on gray-box access, rendering them inapplicable to fully black-box environments. This limitation forces auditors to rely on full-sequence sampling or rigid heuristics, both of which incur prohibitive inference costs and struggle to isolate the underlying memorization signal. To overcome this, we propose a generation-based black-box framework that infers context-induced information gain from targeted token discrepancies. We introduce a budget-constrained auditing regime, building on the empirical observation that the membership signal is highly sparse and concentrated in a few highly informative tokens. We formalize this sparsity, showing why uniform sampling needs many more samples than a policy that targets informative positions. Empirically, our approach achieves state-of-the-art black-box separation accuracy while needing about 3x fewer queries than uniform position sampling. Finally, we apply this methodology to closed frontier models, exploring its capacity and limits in surfacing potential training data overlaps on commercial APIs.
title: Uncovering the Tells: Efficient Black-Box Audits for LLM Data Contamination
