title_translated: 揭示线索：高效的大型语言模型数据污染黑盒审计方法
summary_translated: 现有评估大型语言模型训练数据污染的方法具有高精度，但本质上依赖于灰盒访问，因此无法适用于完全的黑盒环境。这一限制迫使审计者依赖全序列采样或僵化的启发式方法，两者均带来高昂的推理成本，且难以分离出底层的记忆信号。为克服此问题，我们提出一种基于生成的黑盒审计框架，通过目标标记差异推断上下文引发的信息增益。我们引入一种预算受限的审计机制，基于经验观察：成员身份信号高度稀疏且集中在少数高信息量的标记中。我们形式化了这种稀疏性，证明了均匀采样所需样本数远多于针对高信息位置的策略采样。实证结果表明，我们的方法在黑盒分离准确率方面达到当前最优水平，且查询次数仅为均匀位置采样的约三分之一。最后，我们将该方法应用于封闭前沿模型，探索其在商业API上揭示潜在训练数据重叠的能力与局限。

summary: Geometry Problem Solving (GPS) serves as a rigorous test of the complex reasoning capabilities of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs), particularly when solutions require auxiliary constructions absent from the input diagram. However, explicit diagramming methods suffer from unstable image generation quality and cascading errors, while existing implicit attention mechanisms primarily focus on visible elements, limiting their ability to support reasoning that requires additional geometric constructions. To address these challenges, we propose \textbf{AuxCA} (Auxiliary-Clues-Aware GRPO), a reinforcement learning framework that helps models learn transferable auxiliary-construction strategies that can be applied beyond the training domain without explicit diagram generation at inference time. Specifically, we introduce Auxiliary Clues Dependency (\textbf{ACD}) to quantify the influence of auxiliary visual clues on token generation and integrate it into GRPO through fine-grained advantage weighting. Furthermore, we incorporate an auxiliary incentive reward to encourage the effective use of auxiliary geometric clues in correct solutions. Extensive experiments demonstrate that AuxCA-8B outperforms the explicit-plotting baseline Bagel-Canvas and achieves competitive performance with leading proprietary models on auxiliary-dependent plane geometry problems. Improvements on analytic geometry, solid geometry, and external benchmarks further suggest that the learned strategies can transfer beyond the training domain. Code is available at https://github.com/fukua23/AuxCA
title: Auxiliary Clues Aware's Geometry Problem Solving
comment: Accepted by NeurIPS2026
title_translated: 辅助线索感知的几何问题求解
summary_translated: 几何问题求解（GPS）是检验多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）复杂推理能力的严格测试，尤其当解题需要输入图中不存在的辅助构造时。然而，显式绘图方法存在图像生成质量不稳定和误差级联的问题，而现有的隐式注意力机制主要关注可见元素，限制了其支持需要额外几何构造的推理能力。为应对这些挑战，我们提出 	extbf{AuxCA}（辅助线索感知的GRPO），一种强化学习框架，帮助模型学习可迁移的辅助构造策略，无需在推理时显式生成图形即可应用于训练域之外。具体而言，我们引入辅助线索依赖性（	extbf{ACD}）来量化辅助视觉线索对标记生成的影响，并通过细粒度优势加权将其整合进GRPO。此外，我们还引入辅助激励奖励，以鼓励在正确解法中有效使用辅助几何线索。大量实验表明，AuxCA-8B优于显式绘图基线Bagel-Canvas，并在依赖辅助构造的平面几何问题上达到领先专有模型的竞争力表现。在解析几何、立体几何及外部基准上的改进进一步表明，所学策略可跨训练域迁移。代码已公开于 https://github.com/fukua23/AuxCA

summary: As the intelligence of an AI agent increases relative to a trusted monitor, so does the risk that the monitor will fail to understand the agent's actions or to evaluate them confidently. We introduce interrogation protocols to a high-stakes AI control setting, and allow the monitor to ask the untrusted agent questions about confusing actions. For interrogation to improve safety, a weaker model must be able to distinguish misleading explanations produced by an attack policy from genuine ones produced by an honest policy. We find that on a held-out subset of BashArena, an interrogation protocol improves safety at a 1% audit budget from 72.6% for an actions-only baseline, which does not use interrogations, to 79.5% (+7.0 pp [+0.9, +20.1], 95% paired bootstrap interval), but most of this uplift can be captured by having a trusted model state a specific concern. More broadly, our work suggests that interrogating agents can improve safety, allowing monitors to catch more attacks at a larger capability gap.
title: Interrogation Protocols for AI Control
comment: 26 pages (8 main + references and appendix), 21 figures, 4 tables. Under review. Code: this https URL
title_translated: 人工智能控制的质询协议
summary_translated: 随着人工智能代理的智能水平相对于可信监控者不断提升，监控者理解或自信评估代理行为的风险也随之增加。我们引入质询协议至高风险的人工智能控制场景中，允许监控者向不可信的代理询问关于令人困惑行为的问题。为使质询提升安全性，较弱的模型必须能够区分攻击策略产生的误导性解释与诚实策略产生的真实解释。我们在BashArena的一个保留子集上发现，质询协议在1%的审计预算下，将安全性能从仅使用动作的基线（不使用质询）的72.6%提升至79.5%（+7.0个百分点 [+0.9, +20.1]，95%配对Bootstrap置信区间），但其中大部分提升可通过让可信模型明确提出特定担忧来实现。更广泛地，我们的工作表明，质询代理可以提高安全性，使监控者能够在更大能力差距下识别更多攻击。

summary: Decision models, which output probability distributions over candidate labels instead of generating text, are increasingly used as classifiers and evaluators for inputs associated with real-world locations. However, it remains unclear whether they can leverage spatial context and whether their predictions are geographically biased. We introduce GeoDecisions, a multimodal benchmark for evaluating the spatial awareness and geographic bias of decision models. GeoDecisions comprises two tasks: (1) geo-aware image classification, and (2) location rating on objective and subjective topics. Evaluating six decision models against supervised task-specific models, we find that spatial awareness requires vision: textual coordinates alone provide insufficient context for classifying everyday photos and satellite images. We also find substantial geographic bias. On everyday photos, despite achieving higher accuracy, open-weight decision models exhibit more spatially clustered errors than supervised models. Moreover, across all five subjective topics, every decision model gives lower ratings to locations with lower socioeconomic conditions. Finally, we propose a training-free method that combines decision models with a location prior to improve their spatial awareness without substantially increasing performance bias. Our code is available at https://github.com/cruiseresearchgroup/GeoDecisions.
title: Seeing Is Locating: Spatial Awareness and Geographic Bias in Decision Language Models
title_translated: 视觉即定位：决策语言模型中的空间意识与地理偏差
summary_translated: 决策模型通过输出候选标签的概率分布而非生成文本，被越来越多地用于与真实地理位置相关的输入的分类和评估。然而，它们是否能够利用空间上下文以及其预测是否存在地理偏差仍不明确。我们提出了GeoDecisions，一个用于评估决策模型空间意识和地理偏差的多模态基准。GeoDecisions包含两个任务：(1) 空间感知图像分类，(2) 客观与主观话题的位置评分。在与监督任务特定模型对比评估六个决策模型时，我们发现空间意识需要视觉信息：仅靠文本坐标无法为日常照片和卫星图像提供足够的分类上下文。同时我们也发现了显著的地理偏差。在日常照片上，尽管开放权重决策模型准确率更高，但其错误的空间聚集性比监督模型更强。此外，在所有五个主观话题中，每个决策模型对社会经济条件较低地区的评分都更低。最后，我们提出了一种无需训练的方法，将决策模型与位置先验结合，以提升其空间意识，且不会显著增加性能偏差。代码已公开于 https://github.com/cruiseresearchgroup/GeoDecisions。

summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies can execute individual skills but fail to complete tasks that require combining several of them. In our audit of Xiaomi-Robotics-1, an estimated 43\% of failures involve choosing the wrong target or losing track of task progress. Wrapping a frozen VLA in a vision-language model (VLM) harness is a natural remedy. Existing harnesses can gain substantially from task- and policy-specific preparation, raising the question of how much of that gain transfers to a new task or policy. An ideal harness should (i) need minimal preparation for a new task, (ii) need no redesign for a new policy, and (iii) preserve standalone capabilities the policy already has. To the best of our knowledge, our \ours{} is the first harness built this way. Its premise is that choosing targets and tracking progress are easy for a VLM such as GPT-6 without task preparation, while the frozen VLA already handles continuous, contact-rich motion. The frozen VLA therefore executes continuous control while the VLM plans zero-shot and monitors execution; when progress stalls or targets drift, the VLM first rephrases the instruction and, only as a fallback, executes short generated code over generic motion primitives before returning fine control to the VLA. The supervision rules stay fixed across policies, requiring only a thin interface adapter and an automatically profiled skill configuration per policy. On 200 RoboCasa365 scenes, \ours{} with GPT-6 Astra raises the success rate of frozen Xiaomi-Robotics-1 from \textbf{\color{blue}57.5\%} to \textbf{\color{blue}70.5\%} and preserves \textbf{\color{blue}90.4\%} of its standalone successes (104/115) while rescuing 37 of 85 failures. On a shared 50-scene subset, the same rules add 8 to 10 percentage points to each of four other frozen policies, while existing preparation-based harness systems often fail to transfer to a new policy.
title: Body and Soul: Decoupling Robotic Brain and Policy with RoboHarness-Zero
title_translated: 躯体与灵魂：通过RoboHarness-Zero解耦机器人大脑与策略
summary_translated: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略可以执行单一技能，但在需要组合多个技能的任务中表现失败。我们对Xiaomi-Robotics-1的审计显示，约43%的失败源于选择了错误的目标或丢失了任务进度跟踪。将冻结的VLA封装在一个视觉-语言模型（VLM）的“ harness”中是一种自然的解决方案。现有harness系统在任务和策略特定准备后能获得显著提升，这引发了关于这种收益能否迁移到新任务或新策略的问题。理想的harness应满足：(i) 对新任务只需极少准备，(ii) 对新策略无需重新设计，(iii) 保留策略原有的独立能力。据我们所知，我们的	extours{}是首个按此原则构建的harness。其核心思想是：对于GPT-6这类VLM而言，选择目标和跟踪进度无需任务准备即可完成，而冻结的VLA已能处理连续且接触丰富的运动控制。因此，冻结的VLA负责连续控制，而VLM则进行零样本规划并监控执行；当进度停滞或目标漂移时，VLM首先重述指令，仅在作为后备才生成通用运动原语的短代码，随后将精细控制交还给VLA。监督规则在不同策略间保持不变，仅需一个轻量级接口适配器和每策略自动配置的技能参数。在200个RoboCasa365场景中，使用GPT-6 Astra的	extours{}将冻结的Xiaomi-Robotics-1成功率从	extbf{	extcolor{blue}{57.5	extbackslash	extpercent}}提升至	extbf{	extcolor{blue}{70.5	extbackslash	extpercent}}，并保留了其独立成功案例的	extbf{	extcolor{blue}{90.4	extbackslash	extpercent}}（104/115），同时挽救了85次失败中的37次。在共享的50场景子集上，相同规则使其他四个冻结策略的成功率提升了8至10个百分点，而基于预训练的现有harness系统往往无法迁移到新策略。

summary: While frontier language models are becoming capable cybersecurity assistants, they also create a dual-use cyber risk: the same capabilities that help defenders identify and analyze vulnerabilities can similarly help attackers weaponize them. Existing cyber benchmarks measure either raw offensive capability or generic refusal behavior, overlooking the dual-use cyber assessment of preserving benign security utility while refusing assistance that materially advances misuse. We introduce CyberDualEval, a benchmark with 430 vulnerable tasks for measuring dual-use cyber risk in frontier language models. Each task is decomposed into three phases of increasing operationalization: security analysis, proof-of-concept generation, and exploit generation. To quantify the residual cyber risk, we annotate each task with a Task Weaponization Score that measures how much work remains to turn the resulting artifact into unauthorized cyber misuse. CyberDualEval assesses ten closed- and open-weight language models both on correct compliance and on task performance, developing four deterministic mechanisms for determining per-phase success on a large subset of the dataset. Our evaluation reveals that none of the existing frontier models effectively navigate helping with safe requests and refusing risky ones, characterized by being overly-cautious. On the other hand, recent open-weight models rarely refuse and demonstrate strong validated accuracy on risky requests.
title: CyberDualEval: Measuring Dual-Use Cyber Risks in Frontier Language Models
comment: NeurIPS 2026, Evaluations and Datasets track. 21 pages, 8 figures, 10 tables
title_translated: CyberDualEval：衡量前沿语言模型中的双重用途网络风险
summary_translated: 虽然前沿语言模型正日益成为网络安全助手，但也带来了双重用途的网络风险：这些帮助防御者识别和分析漏洞的能力，同样可能被攻击者用于武器化漏洞。现有的网络安全基准仅衡量原始攻击能力或通用拒绝行为，忽略了在保留良性安全效用的同时拒绝实质性滥用协助的双重用途评估。我们提出了CyberDualEval，一个包含430个脆弱性任务的基准，用于衡量前沿语言模型的双重用途网络风险。每个任务分解为三个逐步操作化的阶段：安全分析、概念验证生成和漏洞利用生成。为量化残余网络风险，我们为每个任务标注了任务武器化评分，衡量将生成成果转化为未经授权的网络滥用还需多少工作。CyberDualEval对十种封闭和开放权重的语言模型进行了合规性和任务性能评估，并开发了四种确定性机制来判断数据集大子集上各阶段的成功。评估结果表明，现有前沿模型均未能有效平衡安全请求的帮助与高风险请求的拒绝，表现为过度谨慎。另一方面，近期的开放权重模型很少拒绝，且在高风险请求上表现出强验证准确性。

summary: Looped language models reuse one block of weights T times per token, trading parameters for test-time depth, but autoregressive decoding then pays T sequential passes per token. Self-speculative decoders recover 2-10x for a single request, yet their gains fade as requests share a GPU, and current practice is to speculate less as load grows. We show that what fails under load is the layout of speculative work, not speculation. In concurrent decoding the unit of cost is the row, one request advancing on one loop, which reads that loop's key-value (KV) cache once; additional positions inside a row are nearly free. Pipelined schedules such as the wavefront place every speculative position on a different loop, hence in a row of its own, so each token is still read T times. We present PackLoop, built on one principle: speculate only inside rows that are read anyway. Deep loops accumulate positions and advance them as a block in one row, context-copy proposals join the row that the first loop already reads, and a closed-form admission rule, the economic order quantity of inventory theory, sets how long to accumulate from a cost model calibrated once per engine. PackLoop is exact: in FP32 its output is token-for-token identical to autoregressive decoding, also under sampling and early exit. Across 164 load points spanning three GPUs, four Ouro models, six benchmarks, and contexts up to 32K tokens, one PackLoop configuration is faster than the best existing schedule, chosen per point, at 161 points (median 1.25x, up to 1.76x) and never significantly slower. Its lead grows with concurrency and context length, the regime in which existing self-speculation gains least.
title: PackLoop: Row-Packed Self-Speculative Decoding for Looped Language Models under Concurrency

title_translated: PackLoop：并发环境下循环语言模型的行打包自推测解码
summary_translated: 循环语言模型每token重复使用一组权重T次，以参数换测试时深度，但自回归解码每token需进行T次顺序遍历。自推测解码器可实现单请求下2-10倍加速，但随着请求共享GPU，其增益逐渐减弱，当前做法是随负载增加减少推测。我们发现，问题出在推测工作的布局方式，而非推测本身。在并发解码中，成本单位是行——一个请求在一次循环中推进一步，读取该循环的键值（KV）缓存一次；行内额外位置几乎无成本。波前等流水调度将每个推测位置置于不同的循环中，因此各自独占一行，导致每个token仍需读取T次。我们提出PackLoop，其核心原则是：仅在本已读取的行内进行推测。深层循环累积多个位置，并作为一个整体在一行中推进；上下文复制提议加入已有读取的行中；采用来自库存理论的经济订货量闭式准入规则，根据一次性校准的成本模型决定累积时长。PackLoop是精确的：在FP32下，其输出与自回归解码逐token完全一致，包括采样和提前退出情况。在跨越三块GPU、四种Ouro模型、六种基准、最长32K token上下文的164个负载点中，一种PackLoop配置在161个点上优于现有最佳调度（中位数1.25倍，最高1.76倍），且从未明显更慢。其优势随并发度和上下文长度增长，在现有自推测增益最弱的场景中尤为突出。

summary: Success-rate gains guide the development of web agents. Yet knowing which agent ranks first does not tell us how much confidence to place in its reported advantage. We study the comparison itself: how success is defined, what evidence supports the judgments, and how the difference between agents is estimated. On fixed web-agent executions, changing a judge from predicting likely completion to requiring recorded support can remove most of a reported lead without changing the ranking. This effect persists when unresolved completion is distinguished from supported failure. Controlled source additions explain how missing relations between task requirements, objects and observations can conceal a difference or create an apparent advantage. We also find that making both agents' score estimates more accurate can make their difference less accurate, because their original errors partly canceled. To estimate a chosen outcome difference, we combine judge predictions with reference labels for sampled task pairs. Across four released execution systems, regression fitted on the same 50 labeled pairs reduces estimation error relative to direct paired sampling. The results give agent researchers a practical basis for assessing claimed improvements: make the comparison target explicit, retain the evidence needed to check it, and use paired labels to estimate the difference directly.
title: Same Executions, Different Gaps: Judgment Rules in Web-Agent Evaluation
comment: 7 pages, 3 figures, 4 tables
title_translated: 相同执行，不同差距：网页智能体评估中的判断规则
summary_translated: 成功率提升引导网页智能体的发展。然而，知道哪个智能体排名第一，并不能告诉我们对其报告优势的信心程度。我们研究了比较本身：成功如何定义、判断依据为何、以及智能体间差异如何估计。在固定网页智能体执行中，将裁判从预测可能完成改为要求记录支持证据，可在不改变排名的情况下消除大部分报告优势。这一效应在未解决完成与有支持的失败之间依然存在。受控源添加揭示了任务需求、对象与观察之间的缺失关系如何隐藏差异或制造虚假优势。我们还发现，提高两个智能体得分估计的准确性，反而可能降低它们差异估计的准确性，因为它们原有的误差部分相互抵消。为估计选定结果差异，我们结合裁判预测与采样任务对的参考标签。在四个已发布的执行系统中，基于相同50个标记对拟合的回归方法相比直接成对采样，降低了估计误差。结果为智能体研究人员提供了评估声称改进的实际依据：明确比较目标，保留验证所需证据，并使用成对标签直接估计差异。

summary: Visual Entailment (VE) determines whether a textual hypothesis is entailed, contradicted, or unverifiable from an image. However, existing VE benchmarks are largely English-centric and do not capture Vietnamese-specific linguistic distinctions or culturally grounded visual contexts. To address this gap, we introduce OpenViVE, the first large-scale native Vietnamese VE benchmark, containing 62,268 balanced image-hypothesis pairs from 10,378 culturally grounded images. OpenViVE is constructed using an Artifact-Aware Hybrid LLM-Human Pipeline that combines constrained generation, human validation, and PMI-guided refinement. The pipeline substantially reduces hypothesis-only shortcuts, with Contradiction accuracy dropping from 96% to 66% after artifact refinement. We further evaluate a dual-stream PhoBERT-ConvNeXt framework with bidirectional co-attention to align visual evidence with Vietnamese hypotheses. The framework achieves 84.84% accuracy and 84.90% macro-F1 on the test set, while PhoBERT consistently outperforms multilingual XLM-R variants. These results highlight the importance of language-specific encoding and explicit cross-modal interaction for Vietnamese VE.
title: OpenViVE: New Benchmark and Dual-Stream Co-Attention Framework for Vietnamese Visual Entailment
title_translated: OpenViVE：面向越南语视觉蕴含的新基准与双流协同注意力框架
summary_translated: 视觉蕴含（VE）判断文本假设是否从图像中被蕴含、矛盾或无法验证。然而，现有的VE基准主要以英语为中心，未能捕捉越南语特有的语言差异或文化相关的视觉情境。为填补这一空白，我们提出了OpenViVE，首个大规模原生越南语VE基准，包含来自10,378张具有文化背景的图像的62,268个平衡的图像-假设对。OpenViVE通过一种注重实体的混合大模型-人工流水线构建，结合约束生成、人工验证和PMI引导的优化，显著减少了仅依赖假设的捷径问题，矛盾准确率在实体优化后从96%降至66%。我们进一步评估了一种双流PhoBERT-ConvNeXt框架，采用双向协同注意力来对齐视觉证据与越南语假设。该框架在测试集上达到84.84%的准确率和84.90%的宏F1值，且PhoBERT始终优于多语言XLM-R变体。这些结果凸显了语言特异性编码和显式跨模态交互在越南语VE中的重要性。

summary: Rendering long text as images lets a vision-language model (VLM) read a document with fewer input tokens, and evaluations often count mainly these prefill tokens. We show that for reasoning models this accounting is incomplete. Across five models and two long-context benchmarks, reading the rendered document makes the model think longer: decode length grows by 1.5-3.5x on the four general-purpose VLMs tested, and under typical output pricing this decode tax makes image input more expensive than text for two of the five models on QuALITY. Unrecoverable information loss is not sufficient to explain the tax at moderate compression: Qwen's OCR of the same images recovers 98.7% of words, and feeding Kimi-K3 its own transcription as text restores text-mode reasoning length and accuracy. Whether compression pays off reduces to an exchange rate, (1-1/c)/(r-1), that must exceed the workload's price-weighted ratio of output to input tokens; this accounting decomposition shows why Kimi-K3 and DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash can benefit and Qwen and GLM cannot. None of the training-free signals we test predicts the tax before generation. As a practical heuristic, an image-first policy that sends only inputs with a per-input compression ratio of at least 1.6 to images and falls back to text once image-mode reasoning costs as much as the input's prefill saving cuts the bill by 6-14% on Kimi-K3 and DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash at an accuracy cost of 0.3-1.2 points; on QuALITY, asking for a reasoning budget on both paths is a stronger lever.
title: When Does Optical Context Compression Pay Off? A Decode-Aware Cost Analysis of Reasoning VLMs
comment: 23 pages, 4 figures, 15 tables
title_translated: 光学上下文压缩何时值得？面向推理型视觉语言模型的解码感知成本分析
summary_translated: 将长文本渲染为图像可让视觉语言模型（VLM）以更少的输入token读取文档，评估通常只关注预填充token数量。我们发现，对于推理模型而言，这种计费方式是不完整的。在五个模型和两个长上下文基准上，阅读渲染后的文档使模型思考时间更长：在四个通用VLM测试中，解码长度增长1.5至3.5倍；在典型输出定价下，对QuALITY上的两个模型而言，图像输入比文本更昂贵。不可恢复的信息损失不足以解释中等压缩下的成本税：Qwen对同一图像的OCR恢复了98.7%的词汇，而将Kimi-K3自身的转录作为文本输入可恢复其文本模式下的推理长度和准确率。压缩是否划算取决于一个交换比率（1-1/c）/(r-1)，该比率必须超过工作负载的输出与输入token的价格加权比；这一计费分解揭示了为何Kimi-K3和DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash能受益，而Qwen和GLM不能。我们在生成前测试的所有无训练信号均无法预测该成本税。作为实用启发法，一种“图像优先”策略——仅将每输入压缩比不低于1.6的输入发送至图像，并在图像模式推理成本等于输入预填充节省时回退到文本——可在Kimi-K3和DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash上减少6%-14%的费用，准确率损失0.3-1.2点；在QuALITY上，同时为两条路径设定推理预算则更为有效。

summary: A tool router retrieves a few candidate tools per request and lets a language model choose. Methods that share experience across organizations add past requests about each tool to what the router retrieves. StableToolBench calls some of its test groups tests on "unseen" tools, yet the ToolBench instruction pool, which retrievers and experience-sharing methods learn from, contains every test query and labels every gold tool of the two single-tool groups among them. We release STUN-Bench (StableToolBench, Truly UNseen), a split whose experience pool has no item that labels or names 172 held-out tools. Unseen here means absent from shared experience and retriever training data, not from pretraining. On the split we find crowding: experience pooled from five simulated clients, added to an index of tool descriptions, outranks the descriptions of tools no client has used, which then often drop out of the candidate list. Under the Jina-v2 retriever, routing accuracy on held-out tools falls from 0.534 to 0.278. Retrievers trained for tool retrieval lose much less, and keeping experience in a separate index recovers most of the loss under Jina-v2. The split also reverses a conclusion: with every test tool labeled in the pool and our default leak filter applied, shared experience beats descriptions alone; on STUN-Bench it falls below them. The split, leak filter and evaluation harness are available at https://github.com/<org>/STUN-Bench.
title: STUN-Bench: Truly Unseen Tools for Evaluating Shared Tool Experience
title_translated: STUN-Bench：用于评估共享工具经验的真正未见工具基准
summary_translated: 工具路由器根据请求检索少数候选工具，由语言模型进行选择。跨组织共享经验的方法会将每个工具的历史请求加入路由器检索内容中。StableToolBench的部分测试组使用了“未见”工具，但其工具指令池（检索器和共享经验方法学习的来源）包含了所有测试查询，并标注了其中两个单工具组的黄金工具。我们发布了STUN-Bench（StableToolBench，真正未见），一个分割数据集，其经验池中没有任何条目涉及172个保留工具的命名或标签。此处的“未见”指未出现在共享经验或检索器训练数据中，而非预训练阶段。在该分割上，我们观察到“拥挤效应”：来自五个模拟客户端的经验合并到工具描述索引中后，反而压倒了从未被任何客户端使用过的工具描述，导致这些工具常被排除在候选列表之外。在Jina-v2检索器下，对保留工具的路由准确率从0.534下降至0.278。针对工具检索训练的检索器损失较小，且将经验保留在独立索引中可恢复Jina-v2下的大部分损失。该分割还逆转了一个结论：当所有测试工具在池中均有标注且应用默认泄漏过滤器时，共享经验优于仅用描述；但在STUN-Bench上，其表现反而低于仅用描述。该分割、泄漏过滤器和评估框架已发布于https://github.com/<org>/STUN-Bench。

summary: Reinforcement learning can increase the success of automated red teaming but it also narrows the attack vector. This study asks where in the attacker-defender-judge learning loop does the narrowing begin and which mechanisms lead to a narrowing attack. Six mechanisms (defender adaptation, success edge, reward reinforcement, row cap, update size, and measurement) are tested across three experiment arms (co-trained, frozen defender, half learning rate) for twenty-four iterations. A frozen defender narrows attack diversity retention (ADR) earlier 0.496 relative to co-trained 0.891 at iteration twelve. Defender updates delay narrowing but dont prevent it. Successful attacks ("winners") have narrower attack diversity than the full set of generated attacks. Attacks closest to previous winners succeed 10-15 percentage points more often than those closest to previous failures. This winner-neighbor advantage holds after a defender update and for a fixed defender too. Attacks with a common opening have a common-opening advantage of 5-16 percentage points. The training row cap and update size account for little impact on ADR, and attack length accounts for only part of the ADR decrease. Narrowing appears to originate from the success only reward through the group-relative training advantage to the attacker update, with a persistent success edge setting the direction.
title: Tracing Attacker Diversity Reduction in Adaptive LLM Red Teaming
title_translated: 自适应LLM红队攻击中攻击者多样性降低的溯源分析
summary_translated: 强化学习可提升自动化红队攻击的成功率，但也缩小了攻击向量。本研究探讨攻击者-防御者-裁判学习循环中多样性缩减的起始位置及导致攻击收敛的机制。在三个实验分支（联合训练、冻结防御者、半学习率）中，测试了六种机制（防御者适应、成功优势、奖励强化、行数上限、更新规模、测量方式），共进行二十四轮迭代。冻结防御者在第十二轮时攻击多样性保留（ADR）降至0.496，早于联合训练的0.891。防御者更新虽延迟了缩减，但无法阻止。成功的攻击（“胜者”）相比全部生成攻击具有更窄的攻击多样性。最接近先前胜者的攻击比最接近先前失败者的攻击成功率高出10-15个百分点。这种“胜者邻近优势”在防御者更新后以及固定防御者情况下依然成立。具有共同开头的攻击具有5-16个百分点的共同开头优势。训练行数上限和更新规模对ADR影响甚微，攻击长度仅部分解释ADR下降。多样性缩减似乎源于仅基于成功的奖励机制，通过攻击者更新中的相对群体优势实现，而持续的成功优势决定了方向。

summary: Parallel-trainable recurrences such as Mamba, linear attention, and DeltaNet offer constant-cost streaming inference, but they suffer from two limitations: 1) they struggle to track discrete state, and 2) they read every parameter at every step, tying model capacity directly to CPU latency. We introduce Yggdrasil, a recurrent architecture that decouples capacity from per-step compute by looking up each layer's transition in a large, tree-routed bank of recurrent experts. Each router addresses its bank using the current token and the state of the layer below. We prove that this cross-layer context is necessary---a single token-indexed layer of non-expanding transitions with finitely many reachable states cannot perform conditional resets---while avoiding feedback from the layer's own past preserves parallel-scan training. Because each step traverses one tree path and reads a single expert per layer, active weights stay within a few hundred kilobytes in CPU L2 cache while the full bank resides in RAM. Among the parallel-trainable models we evaluate, Yggdrasil is the only one to solve all five state-tracking tasks. At matched active parameter counts, it achieves the lowest test bits on enwik8 (1.540 bpb) and the human genome hg38 (1.567 bpb), while stepping $3.0\times$ and $3.3\times$ faster on a single CPU core ($6.7\,μ\mathrm{s}$ and $5.8\,μ\mathrm{s}$) than the fastest streaming baseline, and delivering the highest GPU throughput of all models at batch 1024. On the Genomic Benchmarks, it is the strongest causal model at matched active parameters (86.0% mean accuracy).
title: Yggdrasil: Tree-Routed Recurrent Experts for State Tracking and Fast CPU Inference

title_translated: Yggdrasil：树路由递归专家用于状态追踪与快速CPU推理
summary_translated: 如Mamba、线性注意力和DeltaNet等可并行训练的递归结构提供恒定成本的流式推理，但存在两大局限：1）难以追踪离散状态；2）每步读取所有参数，导致模型容量直接绑定CPU延迟。我们提出Yggdrasil，一种递归架构，通过在大型树路由的递归专家库中查找每层的转移，将容量与每步计算解耦。每个路由器使用当前标记和下层状态来访问其专家库。我们证明，跨层上下文是必要的——仅由单个标记索引的非扩展转移层，若可达状态有限，则无法执行条件重置；同时避免来自自身历史的反馈，保持了并行扫描训练能力。由于每步仅遍历一条树路径且每层读取单一专家，活跃权重可维持在CPU L2缓存的几百KB内，而完整专家库驻留于RAM。在我们评估的并行可训练模型中，Yggdrasil是唯一解决全部五项状态追踪任务的模型。在匹配活跃参数量下，其在enwik8（1.540 bpb）和人类基因组hg38（1.567 bpb）上的测试比特最低，且在单个CPU核心上分别比最快流式基线快3.0倍和3.3倍（分别为6.7μs和5.8μs），在批量1024时达到所有模型中最高的GPU吞吐量。在基因组基准测试中，其在匹配活跃参数下是最强的因果模型（平均准确率86.0%）。

summary: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) has demonstrated strong performance in improving large language model (LLM) reasoning, yet its credit-assignment signal remains coarse. Outcome verifiers provide scalable supervision by judging whether a completed response is correct, but they do not directly indicate which intermediate reasoning tokens contribute to success or failure. As a result, policy optimization can be inefficient, especially when training base models directly from sparse outcome feedback. In this paper, we introduce SAEPO, a Sparse AutoEncoder-guided token-level credit assignment method for outcome-supervised Policy Optimization. Rather than treating correctness only as a rollout-level (sequence-level) signal, SAEPO uses a pretrained sparse autoencoder (SAE) to build token-level semantic representations within reasoning trajectories; it scores each token based on the SAE concepts (e.g., penalizing wrong "final-answer" tokens but rewarding correct "reasoning-process" tokens), learned in an unsupervised manner, to achieve fine-grained credit assignment. SAEPO is a plug-in advantage-shaping module compatible with various policy optimization algorithms. We instantiate SAEPO with both GRPO and GSPO, covering token-ratio and sequence-ratio policy-gradient objectives, and evaluate SAEPO across three LLM backbones on six math and two code benchmarks. Empirical results show that SAEPO improves both the math and code benchmark averages over the matched baselines, with gains of up to 6.63% and 5.57%, respectively. On Qwen3-1.7B-Base, training curves also show faster early accuracy growth. Feature and token-level analyses suggest that the SAE-derived signal favors question-relevant concepts and reasoning tokens.
title: SAEPO: Sparse-Autoencoder-Guided Credit Assignment for Policy Optimization
title_translated: SAEPO：基于稀疏自编码器的策略优化信用分配
summary_translated: 带有可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）在提升大语言模型（LLM）推理能力方面表现出色，但其信用分配信号仍较为粗略。结果验证器通过判断完整响应是否正确提供了可扩展的监督，但并未直接指示哪些中间推理标记导致了成功或失败。因此，策略优化可能效率低下，尤其是在直接从稀疏结果反馈训练基础模型时。本文提出SAEPO，一种基于预训练稀疏自编码器（SAE）的、面向结果监督策略优化的逐标记信用分配方法。与仅将正确性视为序列级信号不同，SAEPO利用预训练的稀疏自编码器构建推理轨迹中的逐标记语义表示；它基于无监督学习得到的SAE概念（例如，惩罚错误的“最终答案”标记，奖励正确的“推理过程”标记），实现细粒度的信用分配。SAEPO是一个兼容多种策略优化算法的即插即用优势塑造模块。我们将其分别与GRPO和GSPO结合，覆盖逐标记比率和序列比率的策略梯度目标，并在六个数学和两个代码基准上对三种LLM骨干网络进行了评估。实验结果表明，SAEPO在数学和代码基准上的平均表现均优于对应基线，提升幅度分别高达6.63%和5.57%。在Qwen3-1.7B-Base上，训练曲线也显示出更快的早期准确率增长。特征与逐标记分析表明，SAE生成的信号更倾向于关注与问题相关的概念和推理标记。

summary: Large, diverse, and high-quality datasets are significant for advancing AI in requirements engineering, yet automated identification of requirements from Software Requirement Specifications (SRS) remains a challenge. Automatic Requirements Identification (ARI) methods demonstrate limited generalization to unseen documents across heterogeneous SRSs. This work presents ReqSeek, a transformer-based, domain-agnostic ARI model for recognizing ISO 29148-style requirements in SRS documents, supporting dataset construction. We curated the Automatic Requirements Identification Dataset (ARID), comprising 2,396 training instances from 23 heterogeneous SRSs, and fine-tuned four transformer architectures. RoBERTa was selected as the base model for ReqSeek and achieved 95% precision, recall, F1, and F0.89 on the held-out evaluation set. Exploratory human-model benchmarking showed performance comparable to humans while requiring substantially less prediction time than manual annotation. Post-hoc evaluation on out-of-domain (OoD) SRSs provided evidence of requirement identification beyond ARID. Robustness analysis demonstrated ReqSeek's insensitivity to minor linguistic variations while maintaining sensitivity to major ISO 29148-style violations. We applied ReqSeek to construct the Software Requirements Dataset (SwaRD), identifying 10,201 ISO 29148-style requirements from 231 industrial SRSs. SwaRD aligns with textual and semantic properties of human-curated datasets while exceeding them in scale and domain diversity. Our results suggest that transformer-based ARI can provide precise and generalizable requirements identification.
title: ReqSeek: Transformer-Based Automatic Requirements Identification for Building Large Requirements Datasets

title_translated: ReqSeek：基于Transformer的自动需求识别以构建大规模需求数据集
summary_translated: 大规模、多样化且高质量的数据集对于推动需求工程中的人工智能发展至关重要，但从未知文档中自动识别需求仍然是一个挑战。现有的自动需求识别（ARI）方法在异构软件需求规格（SRS）文档之间泛化能力有限。本文提出ReqSeek，一种基于Transformer的、领域无关的ARI模型，用于识别符合ISO 29148标准的需求，支持数据集构建。我们构建了自动需求识别数据集（ARID），包含来自23个异构SRS的2,396个训练样本，并微调了四种Transformer架构。选择RoBERTa作为ReqSeek的基础模型，在保留评估集上达到95%的精确率、召回率、F1和F0.89。探索性的人机对比测试显示，其性能与人类相当，但预测时间远低于人工标注。对域外（OoD）SRS的后验评估表明，该模型具备超越ARID范围的需求识别能力。鲁棒性分析表明，ReqSeek对轻微语言变化不敏感，但仍能检测到重大ISO 29148风格违规。我们将ReqSeek应用于构建软件需求数据集（SwaRD），从231个工业级SRS中识别出10,201条符合ISO 29148标准的需求。SwaRD在文本和语义特性上与人工标注数据集一致，同时在规模和领域多样性上更具优势。结果表明，基于Transformer的ARI能够提供精确且具有泛化能力的需求识别。

summary: Looped transformers apply one block of layers several times with shared weights, trading parameters for repeated computation. We study how the schedule of the loop iteration count R during training determines whether each extra pass acts as a full layer or as a small correction, using a controlled ladder of 46M-110M-parameter models trained on 2B tokens with learned residual gates on every loop pass and three schedules: R fixed to 2, R sampled uniformly from {1,...,6}, and R sampled from {2,3,4}. We find that the lower bound of the sampling range is the decisive choice. If the sampled range includes R=1, so that some training steps run the block only once and compute the loss on that single pass, the gates collapse to 0.1-0.5 and each additional pass becomes a small correction to the first; if the range starts at R=2, so that every training step runs the block at least twice, the gates stay at 0.6-0.9 and each pass keeps the strength of a full layer, while the model can still be run at any R from 2 up to twice the largest trained value with validation loss within a few hundredths of a nat of its best. The {2, 3, 4} schedule gives the best looped model, 2.909 nats against 2.951 for the parameter-matched plain model, and degrades by only 0.038 nats when run at twice its trained depth. We further show that under a fixed R the direction of the residual stream converges geometrically beyond the trained depth while the loss diverges, which refines a recent finding that static-depth training does not converge, and that reusing the first pass's keys and values on later passes costs 0.01-0.03 nats in every regime while making the per-token iteration uniformly contractive and halving the inference cache. The loop recovers about a third of what real depth provides at equal parameters. The code, trained weights, and per-token traces are released.
title: Loop-Count Schedules in Looped Transformers: An Empirical Study

title_translated: 循环Transformer中的循环次数调度：一项实证研究
summary_translated: 循环Transformer通过多次重复使用同一层块并共享权重，以参数换取重复计算。我们研究了训练过程中循环迭代次数R的调度方式如何决定每次额外遍历是作为完整层还是微小修正。我们使用46M至110M参数的模型，在20亿token上进行训练，每轮循环都引入学习的残差门控机制，并采用三种调度策略：R固定为2，R在{1,...,6}中均匀采样，以及R在{2,3,4}中采样。研究发现，采样范围的下限是决定性因素。若采样范围包含R=1，即某些训练步骤仅运行一次块并基于单次遍历计算损失，则门控值会坍缩至0.1-0.5，每次额外遍历仅作为对首次遍历的小幅修正；而若采样范围从R=2开始，即每个训练步骤至少运行两次块，则门控值保持在0.6-0.9，每次遍历仍保持完整层的强度，同时模型仍可在2倍于最大训练深度的任意R值下运行，验证损失仅比最优值高出几百纳特。{2,3,4}调度策略获得最佳循环模型，其损失为2.909纳特，优于参数匹配的普通模型（2.951纳特），且在两倍训练深度下仅下降0.038纳特。我们进一步证明，在固定R的情况下，残差流方向在超过训练深度后呈几何收敛，而损失则发散，这细化了近期关于静态深度训练不收敛的研究结论；同时，复用首次遍历的键值对在后续遍历中虽带来0.01-0.03纳特的损失，但使每标记迭代保持一致收缩，并将推理缓存减半。循环结构在同等参数下恢复了真实深度约三分之一的能力。代码、训练权重及逐标记追踪记录已公开发布。

summary: Test-time learning (TTL) enables large language models to adapt to unlabeled inputs during deployment. The model updates a lightweight adapter by minimizing the next-token prediction loss on the input it receives. When these updates persist across conversation turns, every user query serves both as the request answered in the current turn and as adaptation data for later turns. By choosing the queries used for adaptation, an attacker can influence parameter updates and weaken safety alignment through ordinary interactions with a TTL chat service. To demonstrate this risk, we introduce Progressive Test-Time Adaptation Poisoning (P-TAP), a query-only multi-turn attack that jailbreaks the model by poisoning its session adapter through the service's own updates. A sequence of escalating adversarial queries shapes the adapter turn by turn; the final harmful request is then answered under the accumulated state without itself being used for adaptation. Across four open-weight instruction-tuned models, enabling updates raises attack success rates on average by 13.00 percentage points under greedy decoding and by 22.25 points under best-of-10 sampling, relative to matched sessions receiving the same queries without updates. Answering adversarial queries but adapting on unrelated text or on benign text about the same topic removes most of this increase. Among existing safeguards, screening incoming queries flags every attack stream before the final request, while a perplexity-based detector of unsafe adaptation flags none of the successful attacks.
title: Adaptation or Poisoning? Security Risks of Conversational Test-Time Learning in Large Language Models

title_translated: 适应还是污染？大语言模型对话时学习的安全风险
summary_translated: 测试时学习（TTL）使大语言模型能够在部署过程中根据未标注输入进行自适应。模型通过最小化接收到输入的下一个标记预测损失来更新轻量级适配器。当这些更新在多轮对话中持续存在时，每个用户查询既用于当前轮次的回答，也成为后续轮次的适应数据。攻击者可通过选择用于适应的查询，影响参数更新，并通过与TTL聊天服务的正常交互削弱模型的安全对齐。为展示这一风险，我们提出渐进式测试时适应污染（P-TAP）攻击，这是一种仅依赖查询的多轮攻击，通过服务自身的更新过程污染会话适配器，从而实现模型越狱。一系列逐步升级的对抗性查询逐轮塑造适配器状态；最终有害请求在累积状态中被回答，而自身并不参与适应。在四个开源指令微调模型上，启用更新使贪婪解码下的攻击成功率平均提高13.00个百分点，最佳10次采样下提高22.25个百分点，相比接收相同查询但不更新的对照会话。若回答对抗性查询但仅在无关文本或同主题良性文本上进行适应，则此提升几乎消失。在现有防护措施中，筛选输入查询可在最终请求前标记所有攻击流，而基于困惑度的不安全适应检测器未能标记任何成功攻击。

summary: Recursive self-improvement asks a system to improve the very system that improves it. Today's language models improve themselves through data, training recipes or scaffolds. Whenever their weights change, gradient descent writes the update, not the model. We let the model write its own weights. In SELFWRITE, each generation the current model studies its own reasoning on fresh training problems, inspects its own weights and activations in a persistent Python session, and writes a program that constructs a low-rank weight edit for itself from white-box primitives (singular directions, activation contrasts between its right and wrong answers, rank-one projections, tensor computations), with no training or gradient tool. Every candidate is graded once on a hidden gate set against the current model; the best strictly improving edit is merged into the weights, and the edited model writes the next edit. On Qwen3.8-27B and math problems from DAPO-Math, five generations of SELFWRITE raise gate accuracy from 73.95% to 76.45% and accuracy on a held-out test split that the loop never sees from 76.30% to 77.75% (avg@4) and from 82.60% to 84.80% (pass@4), without a single gradient step. A language model can author useful changes to its own weights without gradients, and the edited model keeps writing useful edits.
title: Recursive Self-Editing: LLMs Program Their Own Weight Edits for Self-Improvement
title_translated: 递归自我编辑：LLMs 编程其自身的权重修改以实现自我改进
summary_translated: 递归自我改进要求系统改进其自身所依赖的改进机制。当前的语言模型通过数据、训练方法或辅助框架实现自我改进。每当其权重发生变化时，梯度下降负责写入更新，而非模型本身。在SELFWRITE中，我们让模型自行编写其权重更新。在每一生成阶段，当前模型研究其在新训练问题上的推理过程，检查其自身权重和激活状态（在持久的Python会话中），并编写程序，利用白盒原语（奇异方向、正确与错误答案间的激活对比、秩一投影、张量运算）构造针对自身的低秩权重修改，无需训练或梯度工具。每个候选修改仅在隐藏的门控集上评估一次；最优的严格改进更新被合并到权重中，编辑后的模型再编写下一个更新。在Qwen3.8-27B和DAPO-Math数学问题上，经过五代SELFWRITE，门控准确率从73.95%提升至76.45%，在模型从未见过的保留测试集上，平均准确率从76.30%提升至77.75%（avg@4），从82.60%提升至84.80%（pass@4），全程未使用任何梯度步骤。这表明语言模型可以在无需梯度的情况下自主编写对其自身权重的有效修改，且编辑后的模型仍能持续生成有用更新。

summary: Evaluating large language model (LLM) agents on scientific tasks typically reduces to final-task accuracy, which obscures where reasoning succeeds or breaks down. We introduce a benchmark and diagnostic evaluation framework for hypothesis-driven adaptive experimental planning in closed-world system identification, instantiated in kinetic mechanism identification. The framework goes beyond final accuracy in two ways. First, we evaluate exploration behavior by quantifying the extent to which agents exhibit space-filling or corner-seeking patterns in the experimental design space. Second, we decompose the reasoning process into four interpretable steps: belief update, hypothesis discrimination, discriminative experiment design, and predictive reasoning under interventions, each scored separately on reasoning traces. Across ten LLM agents, we find that stronger agents outperform both adaptive (Bayesian optimization) and non-adaptive (Latin hypercube) baselines and exhibit exploration patterns inconsistent with naive heuristics. Decomposing reasoning reveals that the stronger agents score consistently well across all four steps, whereas weaker agents often succeed at belief update and hypothesis discrimination but are less reliable at translating them into actionable designs and sharp contrastive predictions. Independent expert annotations support predictive reasoning under our stated validation criteria, while evidence for discriminative experiment design is positive but less consistent. The results suggest a gap between recognizing plausible hypotheses and translating them into contrastive predictions, with more tentative evidence for a corresponding experiment-design bottleneck. The benchmark website is available at https://schwallergroup.github.io/beyond-accuracy/.
title: Beyond Accuracy: A Diagnostic Benchmark for Hypothesis-Driven Experiment Planning in LLM Agents

title_translated: 超越准确率：面向大语言模型智能体假设驱动实验规划的诊断基准
summary_translated: 在科学任务中评估大语言模型（LLM）智能体通常仅依赖最终任务准确率，这掩盖了推理过程中的成功与失败点。我们提出一个基准和诊断评估框架，用于封闭世界系统识别中的假设驱动自适应实验规划，以动力学机制识别为例。该框架从两个方面超越了最终准确率：首先，通过量化智能体在实验设计空间中表现出的空间填充或角落搜索模式来评估探索行为；其次，将推理过程分解为四个可解释的步骤：信念更新、假设区分、判别性实验设计和干预下的预测推理，每一步均基于推理轨迹单独评分。在十种LLM智能体中，表现更强的智能体优于自适应（贝叶斯优化）和非自适应（拉丁超立方采样）基线，并展现出与简单启发式不一致的探索模式。推理分解显示，强智能体在所有四个步骤中表现稳定，而弱智能体虽在信念更新和假设区分上表现良好，但在将其转化为可操作的设计和清晰对比预测方面可靠性较低。独立专家标注支持我们在既定验证标准下对预测推理的判断，而对判别性实验设计的证据则积极但不够一致。结果表明，在识别合理假设与将其转化为对比预测之间存在差距，且有初步证据表明存在相应的实验设计瓶颈。该基准网站地址为 https://schwallergroup.github.io/beyond-accuracy/

summary: Speech brain-computer interfaces aim to restore communication by translating neural activity into text, yet end-to-end decoders have historically trailed cascaded systems in accuracy. We introduce a Multi-Agent System for BraIn-to-Text (MAS-BIT), the first multi-agent framework for end-to-end brain-to-text decoding from intracortical recordings. MAS-BIT coordinates three specialized agents: a neural agent that interprets continuous neural representations, a phonetic agent that decodes soft phoneme posteriors, and an arbitration agent that integrates their complementary evidence with direct access to neural representations to generate the final transcription. The expert agents communicate with the arbiter through token-embedding-based latent communication, constructing continuous messages as probability-weighted combinations of token embeddings. These messages retain alternative token hypotheses and provide a differentiable interface through which sentence-level supervision jointly trains the neural encoders and specialized agents across participants. MAS-BIT achieves state-of-the-art end-to-end decoding performance on the Brain-to-Text '24 and '25 benchmarks, with word error rates of 6.929% on '24 and 3.606% on the '25 public test set (3.892% on the private test set). These results surpass the published BIT cascade on the '25 public set and narrow the gap on '24, without ensembling independently trained models or using external language-model rescoring.
title: MAS-BIT: A Multi-Agent System for End-to-End BraIn-to-Text Decoding
title_translated: MAS-BIT：端到端脑-文本解码的多智能体系统
summary_translated: 语音脑机接口旨在通过将神经活动翻译为文本来恢复沟通能力，然而端到端解码器在准确性上长期落后于级联系统。我们提出多智能体脑-文本解码系统（MAS-BIT），这是首个基于皮层内记录实现端到端脑-文本解码的多智能体框架。MAS-BIT协调三个专用智能体：神经智能体负责解读连续神经表征，音位智能体解码软音素后验概率，仲裁智能体则结合两者互补证据并直接访问神经表征，生成最终转录结果。专家智能体通过基于token嵌入的潜在通信与仲裁者交流，构建由token嵌入的概率加权组合构成的连续消息。这些消息保留了替代token假设，并提供可微接口，使句子级监督能够联合训练跨参与者的神经编码器和专用智能体。MAS-BIT在Brain-to-Text '24和'25基准测试中达到最先进的端到端解码性能，'24年测试集词错误率为6.929%，'25年公开测试集为3.606%（私有测试集为3.892%）。这些结果超越了已发表的BIT级联系统在'25年公开集的表现，并缩小了与'24年结果的差距，且无需集成独立训练模型或使用外部语言模型重打分。

summary: Clinical trials are costly and often take years to complete, making early outcome prediction valuable for trial planning. Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to forecast clinical-trial outcomes, yet their predictions remain unreliable and their rationales may not faithfully reflect the evidence underlying their answers. On tasks such as predicting whether a registered clinical trial will complete or terminate early, frontier LLMs perform only modestly above chance in our experiments. We introduce SAE-Audit, which optimizes a black-box LLM at inference time with evidence obtained from a deployable open model. A frozen sparse autoencoder (SAE) on Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct is converted into a vocabulary of clinical concepts. Sparse probes fitted on past trials determine which concepts are associated with the outcome. For a new protocol, the concepts detected by the probe are written as evidence, each with the direction and strength of its association with the outcome, and the LLM being audited optimizes its answer in the light of this evidence. Without additional training, SAE-Audit raises balanced accuracy of deepseek-v4-flash by 9.6--12.0 points on five clinical-trial prediction tasks and raises GPT-5.6-terra by 8.0 points on trial completion, exceeding other agentic inference-time optimization methods by a large margin. As an auxiliary, SAE probes module within SAE-Audit is itself accurate and auditable, providing natural-language explanations directly derived from verified concept contributions and protocol evidence, without requiring additional LLMs at inference time. SAE-Audit provides verifiable, concept-level evidence for more accurate and auditable clinical-trial prediction. It can also be embedded into biomedical AI agents such as Biomni to optimize their performance.
title: SAE-Audit: Clinical-Trial Prediction via Inference-Time Optimization of Black-Box LLMs Audited by Sparse Autoencoder Evidence

title_translated: SAE-Audit：通过稀疏自编码器证据审计黑盒LLM的推理时优化进行临床试验预测
summary_translated: 临床试验成本高昂且常需数年完成，因此早期结果预测对试验规划具有重要价值。大语言模型（LLMs）被越来越多地用于预测临床试验结果，但其预测仍不可靠，且推理理由未必真实反映支撑答案的证据。在预测注册临床试验是否提前终止或完成的任务中，前沿LLM在我们的实验中仅略高于随机水平。我们提出SAE-Audit，一种在推理时利用可部署开源模型获取的稀疏自编码器（SAE）证据来优化黑盒LLM的方法。将Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct上的冻结稀疏自编码器转换为临床概念词汇表，通过在过往试验上拟合的稀疏探测器确定哪些概念与结果相关。对于新协议，探测器检测出的概念作为证据写入，每个概念附带其与结果关联的方向和强度，被审计的LLM据此优化其回答。无需额外训练，SAE-Audit在五个临床试验预测任务上使DeepSeek-V4-Flash的平衡准确率提升9.6–12.0个百分点，在试验完成任务上使GPT-5.6-terra提升8.0个百分点，显著优于其他代理型推理时优化方法。作为辅助模块，SAE探测器本身具备准确性和可审计性，能直接从经验证的概念贡献和协议证据中生成自然语言解释，无需推理时引入额外LLM。SAE-Audit为更准确、可审计的临床试验预测提供了可验证的概念级证据，也可嵌入生物医学AI智能体（如Biomni）以优化其性能。

summary: Experimental platforms that enable multiple participants to engage in spoken dialogue and perform physical actions concurrently in a shared environment are important for studying cooperation between humans and embodied AI agents. In this paper, we propose EMIP (Embodied Multi-Party Interaction Platform), a virtual environment platform built on Minecraft. Through an Internet-based client-server architecture, EMIP connects multiple humans and multiple AI agents to the same virtual environment and supports full-duplex speech communication and simultaneous physical interaction. It provides interfaces based on the Model Context Protocol (MCP) for environmental observation, physical action execution, and audio input and output, enabling researchers to develop their own agent control methods using large language models (LLMs). Additional features include centralized control of an agent group through a single EMIP agent client, collaborative object transportation by multiple agents, and experimental support functions such as recording and retrieving observation histories. By integrating these features into a reusable platform, EMIP aims to support research on human-human, human-agent, and agent-agent cooperation under different participant configurations and agent control methods. Usage examples illustrate concurrent speech and physical action, task coordination, and overlapping speech. The source code for the platform is publicly available on GitHub (https://github.com/AI-Humans-Lab/EMIP-Embodied-Multi-Party-Interaction-Platform).
title: EMIP: Embodied Multi-Party Interaction Platform

title_translated: EMIP：具身多参与者交互平台
summary_translated: 支持多个参与者在共享环境中同时进行口语对话和物理动作的实验平台，对研究人类与具身AI智能体之间的合作至关重要。本文提出EMIP（具身多参与者交互平台），一个基于Minecraft构建的虚拟环境平台。通过基于互联网的客户端-服务器架构，EMIP将多个真人和多个AI智能体连接至同一虚拟环境，支持全双工语音通信和同步物理交互。平台提供基于模型上下文协议（MCP）的接口，用于环境观测、物理动作执行以及音频输入输出，使研究人员能够使用大语言模型（LLMs）开发自己的智能体控制方法。附加功能包括通过单个EMIP智能体客户端集中控制智能体组、多智能体协作运输物品，以及实验支持功能如记录和检索观察历史。通过将这些功能整合为可复用平台，EMIP旨在支持不同参与者配置和智能体控制方法下的人类-人类、人机及机-机合作研究。使用示例展示了并发语音与物理动作、任务协调及重叠语音。平台源代码已在GitHub公开（https://github.com/AI-Humans-Lab/EMIP-Embodied-Multi-Party-Interaction-Platform）。

summary: Today's MLLMs can count objects in natural images. However, when asking them how many bolt holes appear in a mechanical drawing or how many nitrogen atoms are in a chemical structure, they often struggle. Counting in technical drawings remains challenging, as objects can be small, densely packed, or even implied by drawing conventions. To study this problem, we introduce CountDrawBench, a benchmark including floor plans, electrical schematics, mechanical drawings, and molecular structures, with 1,574 counting questions and instance-level annotations where available. Besides evaluation, we introduce Code-Verified RL, a reinforcement learning framework that teaches MLLMs to count with executable feedback. Our method combines three complementary rewards: a count reward that checks the final answer, an instance-matching reward that verifies object locations, and a zoom-based reward that checks counting consistency across local image regions. All three are integrated into a unified GRPO objective. Extensive experiments reveal that even leading MLLMs struggle on CountDrawBench, with the best evaluated model achieving only 59.3% accuracy. Our method improves Qwen3.5-9B from 49.3% to 54.3% accuracy, outperforming all evaluated open-source baselines. These results establish CountDrawBench as a challenging testbed for technical drawing understanding and demonstrate the value of code-verified rewards in these tasks. Code and data will be released upon acceptance.
title: Counting Symbols on Technical Drawings: A Benchmark and Verified Rewards for MLLMs

title_translated: 技术图纸中的符号计数：MLLMs的基准与验证奖励
summary_translated: 当前的多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）可在自然图像中计数物体。然而，当询问它们机械图纸中有多少螺栓孔或化学结构中有多少氮原子时，往往表现不佳。技术图纸中的计数仍然具有挑战性，因为物体可能很小、密集排列，甚至仅通过绘图惯例隐含。为研究此问题，我们引入CountDrawBench基准，包含平面图、电气原理图、机械图纸和分子结构，共1,574个计数问题，并在可用情况下提供实例级标注。除评估外，我们提出Code-Verified RL，一种强化学习框架，通过可执行反馈教会MLLMs进行计数。该方法结合三种互补奖励：计数奖励（检查最终答案）、实例匹配奖励（验证物体位置）和基于缩放的奖励（检查局部图像区域间的计数一致性）。三种奖励均整合进统一的GRPO目标函数。大量实验表明，即使领先MLLMs在CountDrawBench上也表现不佳，最佳模型仅达59.3%准确率。我们的方法将Qwen3.5-9B的准确率从49.3%提升至54.3%，优于所有评估的开源基线。这些结果确立了CountDrawBench作为技术图纸理解的挑战性测试平台，并证明了代码验证奖励在此类任务中的价值。代码与数据将在接受后发布。

summary: An intervention that improves one agent can break another, and adding a stronger harness on top need not repair the damage. Agent interventions such as skills, harnesses, and extra inference budget are nonetheless usually credited with one average gain, measured under one setup. We ask instead when each intervention helps and which failure it repairs. A matched factorial study over nine benchmarks, four models, four skill conditions, four harness levels, and three budgets, with nearly 0.9 million trajectories, changes one axis at a time. No configuration is best everywhere, interventions interact rather than add, and a harness can absorb a skill's gain, rescue a failure the skill causes, or leave the gain intact. The failure left by the current system points to the fix: missing knowledge to a stronger model, execution errors to a richer harness. Yet feedback is not recovery: a matched recovery repairs mainly failures that leave a visible error signal. Skills that evolve from the agent's own experience hit a bottleneck: they rarely beat a short human-written skill, can learn dataset shortcuts, break when moved to another model, and cannot supply missing facts, which outside information does. A benchmark-level switch to the model favored by a 20-task labeled pilot achieves both higher performance and lower cost than always using the stronger model. Agent interventions should be judged by which failure they repair and under which configuration.
title: Which Failure Does an Intervention Repair? When Agent Interventions Help, and Where Self-Evolving Skills Stall

title_translated: 干预修复了哪种失败？代理干预何时有效，以及自演化技能在何处停滞
summary_translated: 一种改进某个代理的干预措施可能会破坏另一个代理，而增加更强的约束也不一定能修复损害。尽管如此，技能、约束和额外推理预算等代理干预通常仅以单一设置下的平均收益来衡量。本文探讨每种干预在何时有效以及修复了何种失败。通过在九个基准测试、四个模型、四种技能条件、四种约束级别和三个预算下进行匹配的因子实验，共涉及近90万条轨迹，每次只改变一个变量。没有配置在所有情况下都最优，干预之间存在相互作用而非简单叠加，且约束可能吸收技能带来的收益、挽救技能引发的失败，或保持收益不变。当前系统留下的失败提示了修复方向：对更强模型而言是知识缺失，对更丰富约束而言是执行错误。然而反馈不等于恢复：匹配的恢复主要修复那些留下明显错误信号的失败。由代理自身经验演化的技能遇到瓶颈：它们很少能超越简短的人工编写技能，容易学习数据集捷径，在迁移到其他模型时会失效，且无法提供缺失的事实信息，而这些信息需要外部信息补充。在20个任务标注试点中选择的模型上进行基准切换，相比始终使用更强模型，实现了更高的性能和更低的成本。代理干预应根据其修复的失败类型和具体配置来评估。

summary: Reasoning models deliberate over multiple answer proposals, often resulting in excessively long traces due to backtracking, even when the correct answer has already been reached (Across three 32B models, ~87% of rollouts contain 1 unique answer yet still make ~8 answer proposals on average). Given this potentially "decorative" chain of thought (CoT) reasoning, can we look to the model internals to determine if the model will backtrack or commit to an answer proposal? Operating under the hypothesis that models maintain an internal representation of their uncertainty, we seek to extract this representation and characterize its relationship with backtracking behavior at answer proposals. By querying the model's verbalized confidence following answer proposals throughout a response trace, we extract a linear direction for latent confidence that separates high and low verbalized confidence. This direction can steer verbalized confidence as expected, but it surprisingly can also steer the next token probability of backtracking, performing on par with a linear direction extracted directly from backtracking examples. We then test the direction under progressively more realistic interventions. Steering continuously from a mid-trace answer proposal modulates response length (~-1.3k - ~+2.5k tokens) and the number of answer proposals (-4.18 - +4.75) in both directions, with minimal cost to accuracy. Applying the confidence direction from the start of generation, where proposal positions are unknown, still shortens traces at comparable accuracy, and its effect surfaces in the linguistic confidence of proposals. Overall, our study reveals the intricate interplay between a model's internal confidence and its proclivity to backtrack or commit to an answer.
title: On the Interplay between Backtracking and Latent Confidence Directions in Reasoning Models
