title_translated: 回溯与潜在置信度方向在推理模型中的相互作用
summary_translated: 推理模型会反复考虑多个答案提案，即使正确答案已得出，仍可能导致过长的推理轨迹（在三个32B模型中，约87%的生成序列包含唯一正确答案，但平均仍提出约8个答案）。鉴于这种可能“装饰性”的思维链（CoT）推理，我们能否从模型内部判断其是否会回溯或坚持某个答案？基于模型维持内部不确定性表示的假设，我们尝试提取该表示，并分析其与答案提案处回溯行为的关系。通过查询响应轨迹中每个答案提案后的模型口头置信度，我们提取出一个分离高/低口头置信度的潜在置信度方向。该方向不仅能按预期调节口头置信度，还意外地能调节下一个词的概率以实现回溯，表现与直接从回溯样本中提取的方向相当。随后我们在逐步更真实的干预条件下测试该方向：从轨迹中途的答案提案开始持续调节，可显著影响响应长度（约-1.3k至+2.5k token）和答案提案数量（-4.18至+4.75），且对准确率影响极小。从生成起点应用该置信度方向（此时提案位置未知），仍能在保持相近准确率的情况下缩短轨迹，其效果也体现在提案的语言置信度上。总体而言，本研究揭示了模型内部置信度与其回溯或坚持倾向之间的复杂互动。

summary: With the growing demand for large language model (LLM) services, optimizing LLM serving systems is becoming increasingly complex, and the bottleneck is no longer predicting how a given configuration will perform. The harder problem is deciding what to investigate: which mechanisms matter for a workload, which configurations are worth testing, and what evidence a decision still needs. In this work, we present NoeVera, an agentic Second Brain that goes beyond just one-shot retrieval by turning papers, code, benchmarks, and experimental results into a persistent, provenance-preserving knowledge base with three planes: source evidence, reusable synthesis, and agent memory. Decision-aware retrieval assembles compact evidence packs, role-specific agents reason over them and invoke a simulator (Vidur or GAUSS) whenever quantitative support is needed, and every finding is written back as a scoped evidence record, so knowledge guides experiments and experiments refine knowledge. In configuration search over four serving scenarios, NoeVera comes within 5% of the optimum in a median of 6-7 simulator calls, versus 9 for Bayesian optimization and 15 for a knowledge-free agent with the same tools; on A100 GPUs, its representative configurations deliver ~1.30x vLLM-default throughput and meet every scenario's latency objective. When reused, provenance-preserving evidence records over-generalize on only 8% of applicability traps, versus 28% for a general-purpose agent memory. On the held-out 48-task split of a 72-task benchmark, NoeVera scores 29% higher than an equally equipped agent and 36% higher than its single-call retrieval counterpart (0.80 vs. 0.62 and 0.59), and even when baselines receive NoeVera's own prompts, a statistically significant part of its evidence-evolution advantage remains.
title: NoeVera: Can Knowledge Guide Experiments and Experiments Refine Knowledge?
comment: 20 pages, 2 figures
title_translated: NoeVera：知识能否指导实验，实验能否优化知识？
summary_translated: 随着对大语言模型（LLM）服务需求的增长，优化LLM服务系统变得日益复杂，瓶颈已不再是预测特定配置的表现，而是决定该调查什么：哪些机制对工作负载重要，哪些配置值得测试，以及决策仍需哪些证据。本文提出NoeVera，一个超越单次检索的智能体式‘第二大脑’，将论文、代码、基准测试和实验结果转化为持久、可追溯的知识库，包含三个层面：原始证据、可复用的综合成果和代理记忆。决策感知的检索构建紧凑的证据包，角色特异的代理在其上推理，并在需要量化支持时调用模拟器（Vidur或GAUSS），每个发现均以限定范围的证据记录形式写回，实现知识指导实验、实验反哺知识。在四个服务场景的配置搜索中，NoeVera在中位数6-7次模拟调用内达到最优值的95%以内，优于贝叶斯优化（9次）和同等工具下无知识的代理（15次）；在A100 GPU上，其代表性配置实现约1.30倍于vLLM默认配置的吞吐量，并满足所有场景的延迟目标。当重复使用时，保留溯源的证据记录在仅8%的应用陷阱中过度泛化，而通用代理记忆则为28%。在72个任务基准的预留48个任务子集上，NoeVera得分比同等能力代理高出29%，比单次检索基线高出36%（0.80 vs. 0.62 和 0.59），即使基线使用NoeVera自身的提示，其证据演化优势仍有统计显著部分留存。

summary: AI-driven game development holds the potential to transform diverse human inspirations into interactive experiences. However, existing systems and benchmarks primarily focus on explicit development specifications, with limited support for adapting multimodal references and evaluating actual gameplay experiences. We introduce GameAnything, an open-source agentic platform that transforms multimodal inspirations into playable extensions of existing games through iterative development. GameAnything integrates coding agents with an independent playtesting critic, persistent development state, and reusable experience memory to support continuous refinement. We further present GameAnything-Bench, a benchmark spanning diverse reference modalities, game creation objectives, and gaming environments, with exploratory gameplay testing to assess both functional correctness and gameplay quality. Evaluations of nine coding agent configurations reveal that current agents can adapt reference content but still struggle with playable interactions and precise modifications. Moreover, multimodal references improve content fidelity, while iterative refinement yields substantial but varying improvements across agents. These findings highlight both the potential and remaining challenges of inspiration-driven game development.
title: GameAnything: From Any Inspirations to Playable Game Worlds
title_translated: GameAnything：从任意灵感到可玩的游戏世界
summary_translated: AI驱动的游戏开发有望将多样化的用户灵感转化为交互体验。然而，现有系统和基准主要聚焦于明确的开发规范，对多模态参考的支持有限，且缺乏对实际游戏体验的评估。我们提出GameAnything，一个开源的智能体平台，通过迭代开发将多模态灵感转化为现有游戏的可玩扩展。GameAnything整合了编码智能体与独立的游戏测试评价者、持久的开发状态和可复用的经验记忆，支持持续优化。我们进一步提出GameAnything-Bench，一个涵盖多种参考模态、游戏创建目标和游戏环境的基准，包含探索性游戏测试，用于评估功能正确性和游戏质量。对九种编码智能体配置的评估显示，当前智能体虽能适应参考内容，但在可玩交互和精确修改方面仍存在困难。此外，多模态参考提升了内容保真度，而迭代优化带来了显著但各智能体差异较大的改进。这些发现凸显了灵感驱动游戏开发的潜力与现存挑战。

summary: Music creation is inherently iterative, yet many symbolic generation systems still center on producing or regenerating isolated outputs. We present IteraSong, an interactive web-based Digital Audio Workstation (DAW) for LLM-guided iterative symbolic music creation. Unlike one-shot generation systems, IteraSong supports a generate-audition-edit-refine loop over a persistent multi-track project. Users initialize a fully labeled pop draft, then progressively refine it through natural-language instructions. The LLM maps requests to a hierarchical action space of editing primitives exposed via Model Context Protocol (MCP) tools, spanning global, track, section, and bar/note scopes. The demo enables attendees to edit multi-track compositions in natural language, apply deterministic and generative edits, and undo/redo changes in real time.
title: IteraSong: LLM-Guided Iterative Symbolic Music Creation in a Web DAW
comment: AAAI 2027 Demonstration Program (accepted). Extended version with appendix
title_translated: IteraSong：基于LLM的Web DAW中迭代符号音乐创作
summary_translated: 音乐创作本质上是迭代过程，但许多符号生成系统仍以一次性产出或重新生成孤立输出为中心。我们提出IteraSong，一个基于Web的交互式数字音频工作站（DAW），支持LLM引导的迭代符号音乐创作。与一次性生成系统不同，IteraSong支持在持久的多轨项目上进行‘生成-试听-编辑-优化’循环。用户初始化一个完全标注的流行乐草稿，然后通过自然语言指令逐步优化。LLM将请求映射到通过模型上下文协议（MCP）工具暴露的分层操作空间，涵盖全局、轨道、段落及小节/音符层级。演示允许参会者以自然语言编辑多轨作品，应用确定性和生成性编辑，并实时撤销/重做更改。

summary: AI coding agents generate, modify, and validate code through multi-turn interactions. Existing reinforcement learning methods often rely on sparse terminal rewards, making it difficult to assess how intermediate decisions affect task outcomes, and group-relative methods also require repeated sampling for each task. We propose Direct Feedback Policy Optimization (DFPO), a single-trajectory reinforcement learning algorithm that trains directly from a single trajectory. DFPO achieves higher task resolution rates than GSPO under matched base models and execution harnesses.
title: Direct Feedback Policy Optimization for AI Coding Agents
title_translated: 面向AI编程智能体的直接反馈策略优化
summary_translated: AI编程智能体通过多轮交互生成、修改和验证代码。现有的强化学习方法通常依赖稀疏的最终奖励，难以评估中间决策对任务结果的影响，而基于群体相对的方法也需为每个任务重复采样。我们提出直接反馈策略优化（DFPO），一种基于单条轨迹的强化学习算法，可直接从单条轨迹中进行训练。在相同基础模型和执行环境条件下，DFPO相较于GSPO实现了更高的任务完成率。

summary: Logical reasoning derives conclusions from premises through explicit intermediate inference steps, providing a natural basis for process-level verification and supervision. However, existing learning methods often rely on response-level outcome signals, which overlook heterogeneous correctness within the reasoning trace: a correct answer may contain invalid reasoning, while valid intermediate steps may also appear in an incorrect response. To address this issue, we introduce Reinforcement Learning on Verifiable Logical Reasoning (VeriLogic), which turns internal reasoning traces into explicit and verifiable learning objects. Rather than treating a response as an indivisible learning unit, VeriLogic decomposes logical reasoning into explicit intermediate judgments, proofs, and final decisions, and organizes them into a unified "Grounding - Optimization - Refinement" pipeline: (1) Verification-Grounded Reasoning Environment Construction grounds logical reasoning into explicit intermediate states and formally checkable proof obligations, making the internal reasoning process accessible to verification and learning; (2) Logical Structured Policy Optimization learns from verifier feedback through complementary global and local rewards, jointly optimizing the overall reasoning outcome while providing targeted optimization signals to different intermediate reasoning paths; and (3) Verifier-Guided Iterative Refinement acts on verifier feedback by leveraging proof states and error messages to iteratively diagnose and repair failed reasoning. Experiments on six logical reasoning benchmarks show consistent gains over strong baselines, with average improvements of 6.39% and 5.00% on Qwen3 and Llama-3.1. These results highlight the value of making logical reasoning traces verifiable, learnable, and refinable beyond final-answer supervision.
title: VeriLogic: Reinforcement Learning over Verifiable Logical Reasoning Traces
title_translated: 可验证逻辑推理轨迹上的强化学习：VeriLogic
summary_translated: 逻辑推理通过明确的中间推导步骤从前提得出结论，为过程级验证与监督提供了天然基础。然而，现有学习方法常依赖于响应级别的结果信号，忽略了推理轨迹内部正确性的异质性：一个正确的答案可能包含无效的推理过程，而有效的中间步骤也可能出现在错误的回答中。为此，我们提出在可验证逻辑推理上进行强化学习（VeriLogic），将内部推理轨迹转化为显式且可验证的学习对象。不同于将响应视为不可分割的学习单元，VeriLogic将逻辑推理分解为显式的中间判断、证明和最终决策，并组织成统一的“基础-优化-精炼”流程：(1) 验证基础的推理环境构建将逻辑推理固化为显式的中间状态，并形式化检查证明义务，使内部推理过程可被验证和学习；(2) 逻辑结构化策略优化通过互补的全局与局部奖励从验证器反馈中学习，联合优化整体推理结果，同时为不同中间推理路径提供针对性优化信号；(3) 验证器引导的迭代精炼利用证明状态和错误信息，根据验证器反馈迭代诊断并修复失败的推理。在六个逻辑推理基准上的实验表明，其性能持续优于强基线，Qwen3和Llama-3.1平均提升分别为6.39%和5.00%。这些结果凸显了使逻辑推理轨迹可验证、可学习、可精炼的价值，超越仅依赖最终答案的监督。

summary: Large language models can predict the outputs of small neural networks from raw weights, but success could reflect recognition of weight-space regularities (fingerprints) rather than computation, and function-preserving controls cannot tell these apart. We propose C2, a counterfactual that permutes the columns of a network's final linear readout: every other parameter, and the readout's singular values, norms and entry multiset, are unchanged, and the function can change in an exactly recomputable way; we verify that each evaluated permutation does. C2 separates fingerprinting from computation only under three conditions, which we state as an eligibility protocol: a strategy restricted to C2-invariant summaries must already predict the target; C2 must change a property specific to the rewiring; and the reader's identity must be attested. No natural setting we tested is eligible. On tiny MLPs a frontier reader route followed the rewired function on all 24 networks, but invariant baselines were near chance and its backend could not be attested. In two public CNN zoos the conditions traded off: weight statistics predicted CIFAR-10 accuracy in-distribution, but C2's effect on accuracy was not specific to the swap, while per-image targets were specific but not predictable from invariant summaries. On a constructed population where a planted fingerprint rule works, all conditions hold and C2 separates a rule-following reader from an executor. A self-hosted Qwen3.8-27B followed the rewired function rather than the shortcut, and showed no evidence of using the weights with thinking disabled. A registered replication on fresh networks confirmed both findings (tracking minus stuck 0.875, 95% interval [0.750, 1.000]), and DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-14B also followed the rewiring (tracking minus stuck 0.729 [0.552, 0.885]). The transforms, audits and raw records are available from the authors.
title: When Can a Rewiring Control Test LLM Weight Readers? C2 and an Eligibility Protocol
title_translated: 何时重连控制能测试LLM权重读取能力？C2与资格协议
summary_translated: 大型语言模型能够从原始权重预测小型神经网络的输出，但成功可能反映的是对权重空间规律（指纹）的识别而非计算本身；而保持函数不变的控制无法区分二者。我们提出C2，一种反事实方法，通过置换网络最后线性读出层的列来实现：每两个参数及读出层的奇异值、范数和元素多重集均保持不变，函数可精确重新计算；我们验证了每个评估的置换都满足此条件。C2仅在三个条件下能区分指纹识别与计算，我们将其归纳为一项资格协议：策略必须仅依赖C2不变的摘要就能预测目标；C2必须改变与重连相关的特定属性；读取者的身份必须可验证。我们在测试的所有自然场景中均未发现符合条件的情况。在小型MLP上，前沿读取路径在全部24个网络上遵循了重连后的函数，但不变基线接近随机水平，且其后端无法验证。在两个公开CNN数据集中，条件存在权衡：权重统计量可预测CIFAR-10的分布内准确率，但C2对准确率的影响并非特异于交换操作；而逐图像目标虽具特异性，却无法从不变摘要中预测。在一个构造的种群中，若存在预设的指纹规则，则所有条件均成立，C2成功区分了遵循规则的读取者与执行者。自托管的Qwen3.8-27B遵循重连函数而非捷径，且在禁用思维时无使用权重的证据。在新网络上的注册复现验证了两项发现（追踪减去卡住：0.875，95%置信区间[0.750, 1.000]），DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-14B同样遵循重连（追踪减去卡住：0.729 [0.552, 0.885]）。变换、审计和原始记录均可从作者处获取。

summary: Text-to-SQL systems built on large language models (LLMs) often aggregate over one-to-many and many-to-many joins, a classic trap: when the joined rows repeat an entity, a SUM or COUNT counts it more than once, yet the query runs and returns a plausible number. We characterize these fan-out errors by one condition on the relation an aggregate reads, which depends on two facts a schema does not show: each measure's grain, and how many rows a join on each key repeats. An audit that tests the condition on the data finds distorted gold answers for 4.2% of the dev questions of BIRD, a widely used benchmark, and BIRD's later, independent revision changed 44% of the answers the audit flags as definite fan-out, against 16% of unflagged ones. We release BIRD-FanOut, 486 BIRD questions with reviewed gold, and GrainTraps, synthetic questions that set this trap and related ones. Across eight LLM agents, functional dependencies (FDs) computed from the data help no more than per-column statistics on GrainTraps, but grain-aware FDs, which also state each measure's grain and the repetition per key, cut fan-out errors on BIRD from 18.4% of runs to about 13%, also on held-out questions and without LLM judges. Accuracy rises less, because most remaining errors are not fan-out and BIRD's hints often prescribe the over-count. Text-to-SQL models should be given the grain of the data, and benchmark gold should be audited on the data. Code, data and benchmarks are available at https://github.com/ahmed-mahran/misqal
title: Mind the Trap As LLMs Guess the Data Model: Grain-Aware Guards Against Fan-out in Text-to-SQL and Its Benchmarks
comment: 17 pages, 14 figures, 9 tables. Code, data and benchmarks: this https URL
title_translated: 注意陷阱：当LLM猜测数据模型时——针对文本到SQL及其基准中的扇出问题的粒度感知防护
summary_translated: 基于大语言模型（LLM）构建的文本到SQL系统常对一对多和多对多连接进行聚合，这是一个经典陷阱：当连接行重复某个实体时，SUM或COUNT会多次计数，但查询仍可运行并返回看似合理的数值。我们通过一个关于聚合所读关系的条件来刻画此类扇出错误，该条件依赖于模式未显示的两个事实：每个度量的粒度，以及每个键的连接重复行数。对数据进行的审计发现，BIRD这一广泛使用的基准中有4.2%的开发集问题存在扭曲的真实答案，而BIRD后续独立修订中，被审计标记为确定扇出的问题有44%的答案被更改，相比之下未标记问题仅16%被更改。我们发布BIRD-FanOut，包含486个经审核真实答案的BIRD问题，以及GrainTraps，一组设置此类陷阱及相关陷阱的合成问题。在八个LLM智能体上，从数据中计算的功能依赖（FDs）在GrainTraps上的帮助不高于每列统计量，但结合粒度信息的FDs（还包含每个度量的粒度和每键重复数）将BIRD上的扇出错误从18.4%降至约13%，且在保留样本上同样有效，无需LLM裁判。准确率提升有限，因为剩余错误大多非扇出问题，且BIRD提示常建议过度计数。文本到SQL模型应获得数据粒度信息，基准真实答案应在数据上进行审计。代码、数据和基准可在https://github.com/ahmed-mahran/misqal 获取。

summary: Conversational diagnosis prediction requires accurate, early, and stable predictions from ongoing clinical dialogue, yet dialogue-level labels do not specify when to commit. We propose a two-phase framework for learning deferral and diagnosis decisions. First, iterative commitment-boundary estimation constructs Defer/diagnosis supervision without annotated commitment times. Second, Defer-aware supervised fine-tuning initializes a policy, refined through reinforcement learning with trajectory-level rewards for timeliness, first-commit accuracy, and post-commit stability. On EMSDialog and MediTOD, DoC commits early, achieving the highest first-commit accuracy among post-trained methods (76.7%/51.2%) and the lowest post-commit error overall (16.4%/48.3%).
title: DoC: Learning to Defer or Commit for Timely, Accurate, and Stable Conversational Diagnosis Prediction
comment: 28 pages
title_translated: DoC：学习延迟或承诺以实现及时、准确且稳定的对话诊断预测
summary_translated: 对话式诊断预测需要从正在进行的临床对话中做出准确、早期且稳定的预测，但对话级标签并未说明何时应作出承诺。我们提出一种两阶段框架，用于学习延迟与诊断决策。首先，迭代承诺边界估计在无承诺时间标注的情况下构建延迟/诊断监督；其次，延迟感知的监督微调初始化一个策略，通过基于轨迹的奖励（包括及时性、首次承诺准确性及承诺后稳定性）进行强化学习优化。在EMSDialog和MediTOD数据集上，DoC实现早期承诺，作为后训练方法，在首次承诺准确性上达到最高（76.7%/51.2%），且承诺后错误最低（16.4%/48.3%）。

summary: Background. Verbalized confidence from a hosted medical vision-language model is usually treated as packaging around an unchanged prediction. Methods. We held a nine-class colorectal histopathology prompt fixed except for the requested response format and evaluated MedGemma-27b-it on 10,004 validation and 7,180 external-center PathMNIST patches, with preregistered endpoints, randomized ties, and random floors recomputed for each patch set. Results. Requesting probabilities over all nine classes instead of a ranked top-3 reduced accuracy by 14.8 points on validation, -0.1475 [-0.1594, -0.1353], and 13.4 at the external center, -0.1341 [-0.1484, -0.1196], against chance accuracy of 0.1111. The nine-class prompt uniquely forbade commentary, reasoning, and a chosen answer; removing that prohibition at matched cardinality and token budget recovered +0.1878 [+0.1623, +0.2134] and +0.1911 [+0.1648, +0.2181], while changing cardinality with the prohibition absent moved accuracy by -0.0013 [-0.0300, +0.0280] and -0.0214 [-0.0494, +0.0071]. The nine-class format returned no parseable distribution on 7.6 and 7.7 percent of patches, mostly zero vectors in the two least-textured classes, and deferring these failures first explained its measurable selective-prediction gain. Across four vision-capable models, accuracy did not grade the cost: two models matched on accuracy differed five- to sevenfold. First-token logit entropy routed better than any elicited signal, +0.1820 [+0.1722, +0.1974] versus +0.0493 [+0.0377, +0.0649] relative to each signal's random floor. Conclusions. Response format changes a medical vision-language classifier, and the operative component here was the instruction suppressing an answer. Use logits when available; otherwise request a short ranked list without prohibiting reasoning or a chosen answer.
title: Elicitation format changes zero-shot classification accuracy in a medical vision-language model: a two-center evaluation on colorectal histopathology
comment: 34 pages, 6 figures; Supplementary Table S1 and Supplementary Material S2 in ancillary files. Corrects one result reported in the companion preprint "Diagnosing Verbalized Confidence in a Medical Vision-Language Model for Selective Prediction on Colorectal Histopathology Patches" (Sinhal et al., arXiv, 2026)
title_translated: 响应格式变化对医学视觉-语言模型零样本分类准确率的影响：基于结直肠组织病理学的双中心评估
summary_translated: 背景：托管的医学视觉-语言模型中口头表达的置信度通常被视为不变预测的包装。方法：我们固定了一个九类结直肠组织病理学提示，仅改变请求的响应格式，并在10,004个验证集和7,180个外部中心PathMNIST图像块上评估MedGemma-27b-it模型，采用预先注册的终点、随机平局处理以及每组图像块重新计算的随机基线。结果：要求所有九类的概率分布而非排名前三位的输出，使验证集准确率下降14.8分，-0.1475 [-0.1594, -0.1353]，外部中心下降13.4分，-0.1341 [-0.1484, -0.1196]，而随机准确率为0.1111。九类提示唯一禁止评论、推理和选择答案；在保持类别数量和token预算匹配的情况下取消该限制，准确率分别恢复+0.1878 [+0.1623, +0.2134] 和 +0.1911 [+0.1648, +0.2181]；而在无禁止条件下改变类别数量则导致准确率变化为-0.0013 [-0.0300, +0.0280] 和 -0.0214 [-0.0494, +0.0071]。九类格式在7.6%和7.7%的图像块上无法解析出有效分布，主要出现在纹理最少的两类中，而将这些失败情况延迟处理首次解释了其可测量的选择性预测优势。在四个具备视觉能力的模型中，准确率并未反映成本差异：两个模型准确率相同，但性能相差五到七倍。首个token的logit熵优于任何被诱发的信号，+0.1820 [+0.1722, +0.1974] 相较于每个信号的随机基线，而后者仅为+0.0493 [+0.0377, +0.0649]。结论：响应格式会改变医学视觉-语言分类器的表现，此处起作用的关键是抑制回答的指令。当可用时应使用logits；否则请求一个简短的排序列表，且不要禁止推理或选择答案。

summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to simulate participants in social experiments. Existing research has primarily focused on aligning social knowledge and isolated responses, while overlooking whether simulations can reproduce the collective effects of social interventions. This distinction is critical due to a failure mechanism we call a $bias$ $cascade$: similar individual states can lead to different actions, while agreement on isolated actions can still produce divergent outcomes through dynamic interactions. As a result, models may produce accurate social judgments yet fail to reproduce the outcomes of classic human studies. To investigate this problem empirically, we introduce $REFLEX$ (Reproducing Effects of Foundational Literature EXperiments), a benchmark of 30 counterfactual social experiments grounded in classic human studies that compares knowledge judgment with effect simulation. Knowledge judgment directly predicts the direction of an intervention's effect, whereas effect simulation fixes the scenario and participants while varying one prespecified social factor, with agents generating actions from local observations that are aggregated into macro-level average treatment effects. Compared with human-study findings, the best-performing model achieves net directional scores of 0.847 for knowledge judgment and 0.453 for effect simulation. Moreover, longer causal chains are associated with poorer effect replication, consistent with the bias-cascade hypothesis. These findings reveal a substantial gap between knowledge alignment and effect replication, showing that current methods remain inadequate for reliably simulating collective human behavior.
title: Bias Cascade: Understanding the Gap Between Knowledge Alignment and Effect Replication in LLM-based Social Simulation
title_translated: 偏见级联：理解LLM社会模拟中知识对齐与效应复现之间的差距
summary_translated: 大型语言模型（LLMs）越来越多地用于模拟社会实验中的参与者。现有研究主要关注社会知识对齐和孤立反应，却忽视了模拟是否能再现社会干预的集体效应。这一区别至关重要，因为存在一种我们称之为“偏见级联”的失效机制：相似的个体状态可能导致不同行为，而即使对孤立行为达成一致，通过动态交互仍可能产生分歧结果。因此，模型可能做出准确的社会判断，却无法复现经典人类研究的结果。为实证研究此问题，我们引入REFLEX（基础文献实验效应复现），一个包含30个基于经典人类研究的反事实社会实验的基准，用于比较知识判断与效应模拟。知识判断直接预测干预效果方向，而效应模拟则固定场景和参与者，仅改变一个预设社会因素，由智能体根据局部观察生成行动，并聚合为宏观层面的平均处理效应。与人类研究发现相比，表现最佳的模型在知识判断上的净方向得分达到0.847，在效应模拟上仅为0.453。此外，更长的因果链与较差的效应复现相关，符合偏见级联假设。这些发现揭示了知识对齐与效应复现之间存在显著差距，表明当前方法仍不足以可靠模拟集体人类行为。

summary: Practical highway infrastructure inspection entails progressive diagnostic reasoning from visual perception to maintenance decisions, yet existing benchmarks remain confined to isolated tasks, leaving Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) insufficiently evaluated across sequential inspection stages. Meanwhile, current datasets focus primarily on highway pavement defects, falling short of real-world inspection across diverse infrastructure components such as highway pavements, guardrails, glare screens, and drainage systems. To address these gaps, we formulate the Highway Infrastructure Inspection Progression Chain (HIIP-Chain), spanning Anomaly Detection, Anomaly Recognition, Condition Analysis, and Maintenance Resolution, and introduce HighwayVerse. HighwayVerse comprises 14,143 real-world Ground and Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) inspection records spanning 100 and 17 anomaly categories, respectively, with 84,858 expert-reviewed question-answer pairs. We evaluate 12 open-source and closed-source MLLMs using the chained metric Final, which credits a correct maintenance decision only when all preceding diagnostic stages are completed correctly. Results show that although models achieve relatively high accuracy when initially judging whether an anomaly is present, their markedly lower Final scores expose struggles across downstream recognition, analysis, and decision-making. This discrepancy indicates that current MLLMs do not fully comprehend specific highway anomaly patterns beyond superficial initial judgments. Furthermore, we propose LaneRAG, a training-free retrieval-augmented framework that provides hierarchical reference guidance achieving consistent performance improvements across diverse MLLMs. Our dataset, evaluation benchmark, and source code will be publicly released.
title: HighwayVerse: A Chain-of-Inspection Benchmark for Highway Infrastructure Anomaly Understanding
title_translated: HighwayVerse：面向高速公路基础设施异常理解的链式检验基准
summary_translated: 实际的高速公路基础设施检测需要从视觉感知逐步推进至维护决策的渐进式诊断推理，但现有基准仍局限于孤立任务，导致多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在连续检测阶段的评估不足。同时，现有数据集主要聚焦于路面缺陷，未能涵盖包括路面、护栏、眩光屏和排水系统在内的多样化基础设施组件的真实检测场景。为弥补这些空白，我们提出高速公路基础设施检测进展链（HIIP-Chain），涵盖异常检测、异常识别、状况分析和维护解决四个阶段，并引入HighwayVerse。HighwayVerse包含14,143条真实世界地面与无人机（UAV）检测记录，分别覆盖100种和17种异常类别，共84,858对专家评审的问答对。我们使用链式指标Final评估12个开源与闭源MLLMs，该指标仅在所有前置诊断阶段均正确完成时才给予正确的维护决策评分。结果显示，尽管模型在初始判断异常是否存在时表现出较高准确率，但其Final得分显著偏低，暴露出在下游识别、分析和决策阶段的困难。这一差异表明，当前MLLMs尚未充分理解特定高速公路异常模式，仅停留在表面初步判断。此外，我们提出LaneRAG，一种无需训练的检索增强框架，通过提供分层参考指导，在多种MLLMs上实现一致的性能提升。我们的数据集、评估基准和源代码将公开发布。

summary: The deployment of large language models in operational settings demands evaluation of judgment under institutional constraint. We introduce DiscernBench, a benchmark for evaluating cooperative discernment: the ability of an agent to determine whether to comply with, refuse, or escalate a request in an institutional setting. DiscernBench comprises scenarios derived from real-world incident reports across domains such as aviation, law enforcement, and emergency management. We evaluate eight LLMs across three decision-making configurations and analyze both final decisions and the intermediate judgments produced during multi-agent deliberation. Under disagreement, Final Responders exhibit model- and role-dependent aggregation patterns in which a lone specialist recommendation can disproportionately influence the collective decision, a phenomenon we term Minority-Signal Override. Role-specialized multi-agent deliberation raises average over-escalation from 3.79% under direct single-agent judgment to 28.27%, with the direction and magnitude of minority-signal influence varying substantially across models and specialist roles. These results reveal distinct collective decision behaviors that are not captured by final-answer accuracy alone. Trustworthy multi-agent systems therefore require evaluating not only individual specialist reasoning, but also how conflicting judgments are transformed into collective decisions. Code and data are available at https://github.com/Disha1001/DiscernBench.
title: DiscernBench: Evaluating Cooperative Discernment of LLM Agents in Institutional Settings
comment: 33 pages, 11 figures. Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Interpreting Agent Behavior (IAB)
title_translated: DiscernBench：评估机构环境中LLM代理的协作判别能力
summary_translated: 大型语言模型在实际运营环境中的部署需要对其在制度约束下的判断能力进行评估。我们提出DiscernBench，一个用于评估协作判别能力的基准——即代理在机构环境中判断是否应遵守、拒绝或升级请求的能力。DiscernBench包含来自航空、执法和应急管理等领域的实际事件报告衍生的场景。我们在三种决策配置下评估了八个LLMs，并分析了多代理协商过程中产生的最终决策与中间判断。在意见不一致时，最终回应者表现出模型和角色依赖的聚合模式，其中单一专家建议可能过度影响集体决策，我们称此现象为“少数信号覆盖”。角色专业化多代理协商将平均过度升级率从直接单代理判断下的3.79%提升至28.27%，且少数信号的影响方向和程度在不同模型和专家角色间存在显著差异。这些结果揭示了集体决策行为的多样性，这些行为无法仅通过最终答案的准确性捕捉。因此，可信的多代理系统不仅需要评估个体专家的推理能力，还需评估冲突判断如何转化为集体决策。代码与数据可在https://github.com/Disha1001/DiscernBench获取。

summary: Large-scale redistributable symbolic pop-melody data remain scarce due to copyright restrictions, creating a bottleneck for both practical deployment and reproducible research in music generation. We present PopMelodyGen, a copyright-aware platform for controllable pop-melody generation that combines rule-based synthesis with neural generation. Our approach first uses an expert synthesizer to produce large-scale labeled synthetic melodies from explicit musical knowledge and templates, providing scalable pretraining data with auditable provenance. A neural model is then pretrained on this corpus and adapted with a small licensed real-pop corpus to improve melodic naturalness while preserving controllability. The platform supports interactive melody creation with accompaniment playback and export for creators, as well as batch construction of annotated symbolic datasets for researchers. PopMelodyGen demonstrates a practical training and deployment paradigm for creative AI when large-scale reusable real-world data are limited.
title: PopMelodyGen: A Copyright-Aware Platform for Controllable Pop-Melody Generation
comment: AAAI 2027 Demonstration Program (accepted); extended version with appendix
title_translated: PopMelodyGen：一种版权意识驱动的可控流行旋律生成平台
summary_translated: 由于版权限制，大规模可重用的符号化流行旋律数据仍然稀缺，这成为音乐生成领域实际部署和可重复研究的瓶颈。我们提出PopMelodyGen，一种具有版权意识的可控流行旋律生成平台，结合规则生成与神经生成方法。我们的方法首先利用专家合成器，基于明确的音乐知识和模板生成大规模带标签的合成旋律，提供可扩展且可审计来源的预训练数据。随后，神经模型在此语料库上进行预训练，并通过少量授权的真实流行曲目语料进行微调，以提升旋律自然度，同时保持可控性。该平台支持创作者进行交互式旋律创作，附带伴奏播放与导出功能，同时也支持研究人员批量构建带注释的符号化数据集。PopMelodyGen展示了在缺乏大规模可重用真实世界数据时，创意AI的实用训练与部署范式。

summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly employed for scientific computing across the Earth and environmental sciences, but problems in these fields often involve distinct physical regimes. LLMs may fail to recognize these regime-dependent constraints, applying formulas outside their domains of validity and producing plausible but physically incorrect results. We systematically investigate these failures through controlled experiments and assess whether post-training can improve regime-aware reasoning. Across 72 physical mechanisms, we find frontier LLMs frequently misapply formulas outside their regimes of validity, reducing accuracy by 13-57 percentage points. Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards enables Qwen3.5-9B to match DeepSeek V4 Flash (284B) on regime-dependent tasks, but its effectiveness is limited by the formulas available in the base model. Combining supervised fine-tuning on a few worked examples with reinforcement learning improves accuracy by 61 percentage points, while distillation from a teacher supplied with the correct formula raises accuracy from 0% to 71%.
title: Physical regime changes expose formula misuse in large language models
comment: 19 pages, 9 figures, 1 table; Supplementary Information appended. Code and data: this https URL
title_translated: 物理 regime变化暴露大语言模型中的公式误用
summary_translated: 大语言模型（LLMs）在地球与环境科学领域的科学计算中应用日益广泛，但这些领域的问题通常涉及不同的物理 regime。LLMs 可能无法识别这些依赖于 regime 的约束，在其有效范围之外应用公式，从而产生看似合理但物理上错误的结果。我们通过受控实验系统性地研究了这些失败，并评估了后训练是否能改善 regime-aware 推理。在72种物理机制中，我们发现前沿 LLMs 经常在无效范围内误用公式，导致准确率下降13-57个百分点。使用可验证奖励的强化学习使 Qwen3.5-9B 在依赖 regime 的任务上达到 DeepSeek V4 Flash (284B) 的水平，但其效果受限于基础模型中可用的公式。将少量示例的监督微调与强化学习结合，可使准确率提升61个百分点；而从提供正确公式的教师模型进行蒸馏，则使准确率从0%提升至71%。

summary: Asking a vision-language model (VLM) to think step by step often makes it worse at spatial questions, even though the image stays in context. We show that short chain-of-thought (CoT) turns a perception problem into a transcription problem. Once a VLM writes a spatial relation, its answer follows that sentence instead of the image, so whether CoT helps or hurts depends largely on whether the written relation is more accurate than answering directly. Studying 15 open VLMs (2B-38B) and six frontier closed models, we rule out token count, turn format, and visual forgetting in open models and trace the failure through three stages. First, writing re-weights visual cues, weakening a "lower is closer" shortcut in all 13 open models tested but also discarding valid cues, which produces false relations. Second, the written text takes over. With the model's own conclusion-removed rationale held fixed, swapping in an opposite-depth image moves the answer by 2-9 points on rendered twins (vs. up to 77 for direct answers) and by 3.0-3.4 points on average on natural photographs (vs. 20.5-69.6). Third, the concluding sentence can invert even a true relation, mainly on converse questions. Together, false relations and conclusion mis-mapping account for four in five CoT losses. Scale does not remove this bottleneck: Qwen3-VL-32B shows the same pattern. Frontier closed models are not hurt: they write relations as accurately as they answer, and three of six re-check the image after writing. The three queried with reasoning off lock in like open models, so re-grounding co-occurs with answer-turn reasoning; we identify answer-step re-grounding as the step open VLMs lack. In a single-model pilot, fine-tuning on fixed rationales with image-determined labels restores it on natural photographs. We open-sourced all our datasets and code at https://ming-zch.github.io/seeing-right-writing-wrong.
title: Seeing Right, Writing Wrong: Where Short Chain-of-Thought Breaks Spatial VQA
comment: 46 pages, 7 figures, 46 tables; Project page: this https URL
title_translated: 看得对，写得错：短链式思维为何在空间视觉问答中失效
summary_translated: 要求视觉语言模型（VLM）逐步思考，往往使其在空间问题上的表现更差，尽管图像始终在上下文中。我们发现，短链式思维（CoT）将感知问题转变为转录问题。一旦 VLM 写下空间关系，其答案便依据该句子而非图像，因此 CoT 是否有益取决于所写关系是否比直接回答更准确。我们研究了15个开源 VLM（2B-38B）和6个前沿闭源模型，排除了 token 数量、对话格式和开源模型中的视觉遗忘等因素，并追踪失败的三个阶段：第一，书写过程重新加权视觉线索，削弱了所有13个测试的开源模型中“越低越近”的捷径，但也丢弃了有效线索，导致错误关系；第二，书面文本接管判断。在固定模型自身结论移除的理由下，替换为相反深度的图像会使答案移动2-9分（相比直接回答最高达77分），在自然照片上平均移动3.0-3.4分（相比直接回答20.5-69.6分）；第三，结论句甚至可以反转真实关系，尤其在逆向问题中。错误关系和结论映射错误共同解释了五分之四的 CoT 损失。规模并未消除这一瓶颈：Qwen3-VL-32B 显示出相同模式。前沿闭源模型不受影响：它们书写关系的准确性与回答一致，且六种中有三种在书写后会重新检查图像。三种关闭推理的模型表现如开源模型，表明重新对齐与答案转向推理共现；我们识别出开放 VLM 缺失的关键步骤是答案步重对齐。在单模型初步实验中，使用由图像决定标签的固定理由进行微调，可在自然照片上恢复性能。所有数据集和代码已开源：https://ming-zch.github.io/seeing-right-writing-wrong。

summary: Spatial intelligence, the ability to reason about 3D space from visual observations, becomes essential as multimodal large language models (MLLMs) move into the physical world. Beyond perceiving each view, it rests on two cornerstones of human cognition: fusing multiple views into one coherent 3D scene and mentally transforming that scene to new viewpoints as reasoning unfolds. Yet our spatial probes reveal that MLLMs largely lack both capabilities, even after spatial fine-tuning. We therefore present S-Mind, which internalizes multi-view geometry within the MLLM through a compact set of spatial tokens. It supervises these tokens to hold the fused 3D scene and re-emits them to re-express this scene from every viewpoint the reasoning adopts. Across four spatial benchmarks, S-Mind improves its Qwen3.5 backbones by up to 22.26 points and surpasses frontier general models such as GPT-6-Astra (+0.45), Kimi-K3.1-Pro (+1.97), and GLM-5.3-Flash (+7.80) in average accuracy. Moreover, the same probes confirm that it acquires both capabilities, reaching fusion and transformation accuracies of 65.11% and 82.17%, against at most 16.02% and 37.28% for the baselines. At inference, S-Mind also runs about 100x faster than a tool-based agent on the same backbone. Instilled through these spatial tokens during training, spatial capability becomes intrinsic to the backbone and persists even when the tokens are withheld, offering a promising path toward spatial intelligence in MLLMs.
title: S-Mind: Internalizing Multi-View Geometry for Spatial Intelligence
title_translated: S-Mind：内化多视角几何以实现空间智能
summary_translated: 随着多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）进入物理世界，空间智能——即从视觉观察中推理三维空间的能力——变得至关重要。除了感知每个视角外，它还基于人类认知的两个核心：将多个视角融合成一个连贯的三维场景，并在推理过程中心理转换该场景至新视角。然而我们的空间探测显示，即使经过空间微调，MLLMs 仍严重缺乏这两种能力。因此我们提出 S-Mind，通过一组紧凑的空间 token 将多视角几何内化到 MLLM 中。这些 token 被监督以保持融合后的三维场景，并在推理时重新输出，以从推理采用的每个视角重新表达该场景。在四个空间基准测试中，S-Mind 使 Qwen3.5 基线模型的性能提升高达22.26分，并在平均准确率上超越 GPT-6-Astra (+0.45)、Kimi-K3.1-Pro (+1.97) 和 GLM-5.3-Flash (+7.80)。此外，相同的探测证实其获得了两种能力，融合与变换准确率分别达到65.11%和82.17%，而基线模型最高仅为16.02%和37.28%。推理时，S-Mind 的速度比同基线的工具型代理快约100倍。通过训练期间注入这些空间 token，空间能力成为基线模型的内在属性，即使在不提供 token 的情况下依然存在，为 MLLMs 实现空间智能提供了有前景的路径。

summary: Vision-language models frequently describe objects absent from the image because of language priors. Yet the model itself is already a strong judge of its own output: asked separately whether an object is present, it rejects 44%-62% of its hallucinations, and its yes probability reaches an AUROC of 0.90-0.95 without training. This judgment, however, is not directly usable: (1) its probabilities lack a common scale across models; (2) for the remaining 38%-56%, the model still answers yes with probabilities that overlap those of real objects, so no threshold separates them. We therefore propose CLOSE, a Calibrated Label-free Online Self-Evaluating verifier that enforces this judgment during generation. Its threshold is a quantile of a memory rather than a probability and thus depends only on ranks; the memory is cold-started from unlabeled images and updated online. A scorer self-trained on pseudo-labels from four hidden-state signals is fused with self-asking by rank to separate what self-asking leaves mixed. Refused objects are rolled back and banned through a laddered back-off, and a recognition table intercepts their reappearance under other wordings. On COCO, refusing 20% and 40% of object mentions reduces the CHAIRs of LLaVA-1.5-7B by 42% and 87% (F1 +1.9 and -6.1 points); refusing 20% and 35% reduces the reachable hallucinations of Qwen3-VL-8B (official counts minus CHAIR-script miscounts) by 79% and 96% (F1 +0.5 and -5.3). An external vocabulary further extends the check beyond the official vocabulary.
title: CLOSE: A Calibrated Label-free Online Self-Evaluating Verifier for Object Hallucination in Vision-Language Models
comment: 41 pages (8-page main text and appendix), 25 figures, 24 tables
title_translated: CLOSE：一种用于物体幻觉检测的校准无标签在线自评估验证器
summary_translated: 视觉语言模型经常因语言先验而描述图像中不存在的物体。然而，模型本身已是其输出的强大评判者：单独询问某物体是否存在时，它能拒绝44%-62%的幻觉，其‘是’的概率在未训练情况下 AUROC 达到0.90-0.95。但这种判断无法直接使用：(1) 不同模型间的概率缺乏统一尺度；(2) 对剩余38%-56%的幻觉，模型仍以与真实物体重叠的概率回答‘是’，因此无法通过阈值分离。为此，我们提出 CLOSE，一种校准的无标签在线自评估验证器，强制在生成过程中执行此判断。其阈值基于记忆中的分位数而非概率，因此仅依赖排名；记忆初始来自未标注图像并在线更新。一个由四个隐藏状态信号生成伪标签自训练的评分器，与按排名自问相结合，以分离自问未能区分的部分。被拒绝的物体通过分层回退机制回滚并禁止，同时识别表拦截其以其他措辞再次出现。在 COCO 上，拒绝20%和40%的物体提及，使 LLaVA-1.5-7B 的 CHAIRs 下降42%和87%（F1 分别+1.9和-6.1）；拒绝20%和35%的物体，使 Qwen3-VL-8B 的可访问幻觉减少79%和96%（F1 +0.5和-5.3）。外部词汇表进一步扩展了检查范围至官方词汇之外。

summary: Self-rewarding optimization (SRO) promises to improve language models by enabling them to generate their own reward signals. Yet when and how SRO succeeds or fails remains poorly understood. We reveal that SRO is fundamentally fragile: even seemingly benign perturbations to training prompts can corrupt the self-generated preference signal and trigger iterative collapse. We demonstrate this through two prompt-level attacks that serve as controlled stress tests: a Re-Ranking attack that concentrates training on prompts where self-reward diverges from an oracle, and a Preamble attack that learns short prefixes inflating self-reward without any gain in oracle quality. To explain why these attacks succeed, we introduce self-reward fidelity (SRF), a metric quantifying on-policy agreement between self-evaluated and oracle rewards. We show that SRF can serve as a diagnostic signal of self-supervision reliability, and that controlled SRF perturbations induce a phase-transition region: SRO improves when SRF remains sufficiently high, but collapses once SRF drops below a model- and task-dependent threshold. This analysis motivates Projection Decoupling Defense, which suppresses SRO update components along directions to which the reward generator is locally sensitive, improving SRO robustness under adversarial conditions. This work sheds light on the fragility of SRO and charts promising directions toward making it more robust.
title: Understanding and Mitigating the Fragility of Self-Rewarding Optimization
comment: 35 pages, 32 figures
title_translated: 理解并缓解自奖励优化的脆弱性
summary_translated: 自奖励优化（SRO）有望通过让模型生成自己的奖励信号来提升语言模型性能。然而，SRO 成功或失败的时机与机制仍不清楚。我们揭示 SRO 本质上具有脆弱性：即使对训练提示进行看似无害的扰动，也可能污染自生成的偏好信号并引发迭代崩溃。我们通过两种提示级攻击作为受控压力测试予以证明：重排序攻击集中训练于自奖励与理想奖励分歧较大的提示；前缀攻击则学习短前缀以提高自奖励而不提升理想质量。为解释这些攻击为何成功，我们引入自奖励保真度（SRF），一个量化自评估与理想奖励之间策略内一致性的指标。我们表明 SRF 可作为自监督可靠性诊断信号，且可控的 SRF 扰动会引发相变区域：当 SRF 保持足够高时，SRO 提升性能；但一旦低于模型和任务相关的阈值，SRO 即崩溃。该分析启发了投影解耦防御方法，通过抑制奖励生成器局部敏感方向上的更新成分，提升 SRO 在对抗条件下的鲁棒性。本工作揭示了 SRO 的脆弱性，并指明了使其更稳健的有希望方向。

summary: Whole-slide pathology report generation has advanced through stronger slide encoders, retrieved knowledge, and, recently, slide-level multimodal LLMs. However, these generators leave every report-level choice to the decoder: how long the report is, how it is organised, and which findings it states and where. On the standard PathText-BRCA benchmark, we find that these choices dominate n-gram overlap, as reports from the query's hospital selected without learning approach the state of the art, while decoders under-generate and fall back to the most frequent findings. We present CLASP, a decide-then-decode generator that makes these choices explicitly, once per slide. Before decoding, an Exemplar Structure Prior (ESP) takes the sentence plan and length from reports of image-similar cases, a Calibrated Claim Decision (CCD) selects the findings from calibrated slide posteriors, and a Claim-to-Sentence Placement (CSP) assigns each finding to a planned sentence. A Plan-Conditioned Decoder (PCD), refined by structure-anchored sequence training, then writes the report under these decisions. With 35M parameters, CLASP outperforms retrained report generators and slide-level LLMs of up to 7B parameters, matches the strongest published results, and generalises to lung cancer from unseen hospitals. Its decisions change what the reports state, not only their length, transfer to an LLM decoder, and can withhold what H&E cannot show: withholding receptor status leaves 23% fewer contradictions with clinical records than the same network without decisions.
title: CLASP: Deciding Structure and Claims Before Decoding for Whole-Slide Pathology Report Generation
title_translated: CLASP：在解码前决定结构与声明，用于全切片病理报告生成
summary_translated: 全切片病理报告生成已通过更强的切片编码器、检索知识以及最近的切片级多模态大语言模型取得进展。然而，这些生成器将每个报告层面的选择完全交由解码器决定：报告长度、组织方式以及陈述哪些发现及其位置。在标准的PathText-BRCA基准上，我们发现这些选择主导了n-gram重叠度，因为来自查询医院且未经过学习的报告已接近当前最先进水平，而解码器则存在欠生成现象，退化为最常见的发现。我们提出CLASP，一种先决策后解码的生成器，每张切片仅需明确做出一次决策。在解码前，示例结构先验（ESP）从图像相似病例的报告中获取句子计划和长度，校准的声明决策（CCD）基于校准后的切片后验选择发现，声明到句子的放置（CSP）将每个发现分配至预定的句子中。随后，基于结构锚定序列训练优化的计划条件解码器（PCD）在这些决策下撰写报告。CLASP仅含3500万参数，优于重新训练的报告生成器及高达70亿参数的切片级大语言模型，达到最强公开结果，并能泛化至未见医院的肺癌数据。其决策不仅影响报告内容，还转移至大语言模型解码器，且可隐藏H&E无法显示的信息：不披露受体状态使报告与临床记录之间的矛盾减少23%。

summary: Long-context LLM inference is bottlenecked by the memory demands of the key-value (KV) cache, whose size scales linearly with context length. Dynamic sparse attention reduces this bottleneck by fetching and attending only to a critical subset of tokens. The dominant primitive in dynamic sparse attention research and deployment is fixed-budget top-$k$ selection, which is favored because its deterministic block count aligns with the static memory allocation that systems like vLLM rely on. Top-$k$ uses a fixed budget regardless of how attention mass is distributed across heads, layers, and decode steps, leading to either wasted bandwidth on heads with peaky attention or dropped context on heads with diffuse attention. Top-$p$ (nucleus) selection adapts naturally to this variation but has seen limited adoption in production serving systems due to two system-level challenges: variable block counts that break deterministic block allocation and computationally expensive selection kernels that exceed the cost of attention itself. We present DisSparse, a serving system that integrates top-$p$ sparse attention into vLLM end-to-end. DisSparse decouples block selection from the scheduler's critical path, hides selection latency behind layer computation via a two-stream pipeline, and introduces a single-pass histogram-based top-$p$ kernel. We further observe intra-block sparsity, the inflation of selection budgets caused by mixing high- and low-importance tokens within fixed-size KV cache blocks, and address it with a token relocation kernel guided by accumulated prefill attention scores. Across long- and medium-context benchmarks on multiple models, DisSparse achieves 1.17x to 1.80x speedup in sparsity analysis (block selection) over state-of-the-art top-$p$ methods with negligible accuracy loss and supports up to 8x larger maximum batch sizes than dense vLLM under the same memory budget.
title: DisSparse: Pipelined Top-$p$ Sparse Attention for Long-Context LLM Serving

title_translated: DisSparse：面向长上下文大语言模型服务的流水线式Top-$p$稀疏注意力
summary_translated: 长上下文大语言模型推理受限于键值（KV）缓存的内存需求，其大小随上下文长度线性增长。动态稀疏注意力通过仅获取并关注关键token子集来缓解这一瓶颈。目前动态稀疏注意力研究与部署中的主流方法是固定预算的Top-$k$选择，因其确定性的块数量与vLLM等系统依赖的静态内存分配相匹配而受到青睐。然而，Top-$k$无论注意力在头、层和解码步骤间如何分布均使用固定预算，导致某些注意力集中头部出现带宽浪费，而注意力分散头部则丢失上下文。Top-$p$（核）选择能自然适应这种变化，但因两个系统级挑战在生产服务中应用有限：可变块数量破坏确定性块分配，以及计算开销大的选择内核超过注意力本身的成本。我们提出DisSparse，一个将Top-$p$稀疏注意力无缝集成到vLLM的端到端服务系统。DisSparse将块选择与调度器的关键路径解耦，通过双流流水线在层计算期间隐藏选择延迟，并引入单次遍历的基于直方图的Top-$p$内核。我们进一步观察到块内稀疏性——由于在固定大小的KV缓存块中混合高、低重要性token导致选择预算膨胀的问题，并通过基于累积预填充注意力得分引导的token重定位内核加以解决。在多个模型的长、中等上下文基准测试中，DisSparse在稀疏性分析（块选择）上相比最先进的Top-$p$方法实现1.17倍至1.80倍加速，精度损失可忽略，且在相同内存预算下支持高达8倍更大的最大批处理规模。

summary: We show that an AI agent can write new capabilities into a pretrained language model by adding gated attention heads and MLP neurons inside its existing layers, without backpropagation and without fitting any weight to the answers of task examples. It has a budget of 50 model passes and sees no validation or test instance. Composed in one model, its modules for six BIG-Bench Hard (BBH) subtasks raise the normalized BBH score of Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct from 19.95 to 41.05 (Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct: at most 35.01) and that of Gemma-3-1B-it from 10.25 to 32.86. Against the unmodified model at the same precision, both composites leave the next-token distribution on 1,023,000 WikiText tokens unchanged (KL exactly 0), give identical answers on 15,845 items of five other Leaderboard tests and identical scores on the other 18 BBH subtasks. The agent also writes exact multiplication up to 20 digits, running the model only up to 6 (100.0% on the absent lengths of the sealed test in both models; a LoRA with the same budget: at most 2.1%). Sets, rules and report sentences were sealed in git before the first session (manifests timestamped in Bitcoin), with dated amendments listed in Appendix D; a frozen evaluator ran the sealed test once. Verdicts (H5: tracking; H6: composite; H8: one pass vs. chain of thought; H9: fresh and rewritten instances; H10: side effects; H12: multiplication), on the preregistered sealed test, Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct: H5 success, H6 success, H8 (web_of_lies) success, H9 success, H10 (composite) success on (i) to (iii), (iv) confirmed, H12 success; Gemma-3-1B-it (H7: H5, H6, H8 and H9 in this model): H5 success, H6 success, H8 (web_of_lies) success, H8 (tracking 3) success, H9 partial, H10 (composite) success on (i) to (iii), (iv) confirmed, H12 success. Not everything worked: 4 of 45 single modules show small side effects and 5 of 50 sessions hit the 12-hour limit without a module.
title: Don't Train It, Write It: An AI Agent Writes New Capabilities into Language Model Weights
comment: 28 pages, 5 figures
title_translated: 不要训练它，写进去：一个AI智能体将新能力写入语言模型权重
summary_translated: 我们展示了一个AI智能体可通过在现有层中添加门控注意力头和MLP神经元的方式，向预训练语言模型注入新能力，无需反向传播，也无需对任务示例答案进行权重拟合。该智能体仅有50次模型运行预算，且未见过任何验证或测试实例。在一个模型中组合的六个BIG-Bench Hard（BBH）子任务模块，使Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct的归一化BBH得分从19.95提升至41.05（Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct：最高达35.01），Gemma-3-1B-it的得分从10.25提升至32.86。与原始模型在相同精度下相比，两个复合体在1,023,000个WikiText词元上的下一个词分布完全不变（KL精确为0），在五个其他排行榜测试的15,845项中给出完全相同的答案，且在其余18个BBH子任务上得分一致。该智能体还实现了精确乘法运算，最多支持20位数字，仅运行模型最多6次（在两个模型的密封测试缺失长度上准确率100.0%；相同预算的LoRA：最高仅2.1%）。集合、规则和报告句子在首次会话前即封存于git中（时间戳记录于比特币），附录D列出了日期修订；冻结评估器仅运行一次密封测试。预注册密封测试的结论（H5：追踪；H6：复合体；H8：单步vs.思维链；H9：新实例与重写实例；H10：副作用；H12：乘法）显示：Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct：H5成功，H6成功，H8（web_of_lies）成功，H9成功，H10（复合体）在(i)至(iii)上成功，(iv)确认，H12成功；Gemma-3-1B-it（H7：H5、H6、H8和H9在此模型中）：H5成功，H6成功，H8（web_of_lies）成功，H8（追踪3）成功，H9部分成功，H10（复合体）在(i)至(iii)上成功，(iv)确认，H12成功。并非所有模块都成功：4/45个独立模块显示微小副作用，5/50次会话因超时12小时未完成模块。

summary: Language models and AI agents are increasingly described in psychiatric terms, such as anxious, depressed, addicted or helpless. A recent study even proposed language models as experimental systems for psychiatry and as a platform for piloting psychological treatments. We ask when an experiment on an AI agent can provide evidence about a specified human psychiatric process. A claim to such evidence has three parts. Something changed in the agent, and the agent's history caused the change. Nothing other than a process shared with people explains that change. The change matches one theory of the human process and not that theory's rivals. Psychiatry and its neighbouring fields have an evidence standard for each part, from the diagnostic manuals' rule for induced states, from clinical test scores and from animal models. We translate each standard into a criterion that a machine study can meet. For a language model the most critical alternative to a shared process is extrapolation from its training text, which already contains descriptions of how people respond to trauma and how they answer questionnaires. We show how to probe that alternative. Further, we audited forty-three published studies that apply psychiatric terms to a machine or induce a comparable state in one. Most compared the machine with an identical copy that had not gone through the history that induced the state. None excluded extrapolation from training text. Three tested a psychiatric theory against its rivals, and none of the three tests was conclusive. Until better evidence exists, a treatment pilot on a language model is best read as the model's forecast of patient response, and not as an experiment on a model organism. Evidence for a model organism will come from states induced by what happens to the machine, from experiments on its internal workings, and from tests on which rival theories disagree.
title: When Can an AI Agent Serve as a Model of Human Psychopathology?
title_translated: 当AI智能体何时可作为人类心理病理学的模型？
summary_translated: 语言模型和AI智能体正越来越多地被以精神病学术语描述，如焦虑、抑郁、成瘾或无助。最近一项研究甚至提出将语言模型作为精神病学的实验系统，并作为心理治疗试点的平台。我们探讨在何种条件下，对AI智能体的实验可以为特定的人类精神疾病过程提供证据。此类证据主张包含三个部分：智能体发生了某种变化，且其历史导致了该变化；除与人类共享的过程外，无其他因素可解释该变化；该变化符合某一人类过程理论，而非其竞争理论。精神病学及其相关领域对每一部分均有证据标准，包括诊断手册中关于诱发状态的规则、临床测试评分以及动物模型。我们将每项标准转化为机器研究可满足的标准。对于语言模型而言，最关键的替代解释是其训练文本的外推，其中已包含人们对创伤的反应描述及问卷回答方式。我们展示了如何探测这一替代解释。此外，我们审计了43篇将精神病学术语应用于机器或诱导类似状态的研究。大多数研究将机器与其未经历诱发状态历史的相同副本进行比较，均未排除训练文本的外推。仅有三篇测试了精神病理学理论与其竞争理论，但三者测试均未得出确凿结论。在更优证据出现之前，对语言模型的心理治疗试点应视为模型对未来患者反应的预测，而非对模式生物的实验。模式生物的证据将来自机器自身经历的状态、对其内部机制的实验，以及在竞争理论分歧处的测试。

summary: Tool-using LLM agents must recover when a tool call fails, by retrying, switching tools, or revising their plan. We study how agents fail when tools fail, using RetryRealistic, a sandboxed yet realistic testbed for controlled fault injection in which agents operate on a real OS filesystem with genuine permission enforcement, SQLite databases, a deterministic local HTTP server, and a constrained shell, across 8 tools, 9 fault types with controlled persistence, and 30 multi-step tasks. Evaluating four agents over 2,100 faulted runs against ground truth, we find that recovery is unreliable (19-68% correct) and frequently silent: 6-26% of runs end in a confident fabrication, a wrong answer asserted as fact. The failure mode is governed more by the fault type than by the model: faults that return partial data drive fabrication (up to 38%), while hard denials drive honest failure. The mechanism is what we call silent ingestion: the agent accepts faulted data as valid on first contact without retrying or flagging the problem, then builds a fabricated answer on top of it. We show that fabrication is reducible: a verification-first Monitor, grounding checks in structured tool outputs and issuing corrective directives rather than hard blocks, raises correct recovery from 45.6% to 56.3% and cuts fabrication from 17.3% to 10.8%. Removing chain-of-thought increases fabrication (+8.3pp), so deliberation guards against silent ingestion. We release RetryRealistic, the fault-injection toolkit, and all annotated traces at https://github.com/Kingsford-Group/RetryRealistic
title: When Tools Fail, Agents Fabricate: Silent Failure and Verification-First Oversight in Tool-Using LLM Agents
comment: NeurIPS 2026 Workshop: Who Verifies the Agents? Toward Reliable Agent Development. 12 pages, 3 figures, 7 tables
title_translated: 当工具失效时，智能体伪造：工具使用型LLM智能体中的沉默失败与验证优先监督
summary_translated: 使用工具的LLM智能体必须在工具调用失败时恢复，例如重试、切换工具或修改计划。我们研究了智能体在工具失败时的失效情况，采用RetryRealistic——一个沙盒化但真实的测试环境，用于可控故障注入。在该环境中，智能体在真实操作系统文件系统、真实权限控制、SQLite数据库、确定性本地HTTP服务器和受限shell上运行，覆盖8种工具、9种故障类型（具有可控持久性）和30个复杂多步任务。在2100次故障运行中评估四个智能体与真实情况的对比，发现恢复不可靠（正确率19%-68%），且常表现为沉默失败：6%-26%的运行以自信的伪造结束，即错误答案被当作事实陈述。失败模式更多由故障类型决定而非模型本身：返回部分数据的故障会引发伪造（最高达38%），而硬性拒绝则导致诚实失败。其机制是我们称之为“沉默摄入”的现象：智能体在首次接触故障数据时即接受其有效性，不重试也不标记问题，随后在其基础上构建伪造答案。我们证明伪造行为可被缓解：采用验证优先的Monitor，基于结构化工具输出进行检查并发出纠正指令而非强制阻断，可将正确恢复率从45.6%提升至56.3%，并将伪造率从17.3%降至10.8%。去除思维链会增加伪造率（+8.3个百分点），说明深思熟虑有助于防范沉默摄入。我们发布RetryRealistic故障注入工具包及所有标注轨迹至https://github.com/Kingsford-Group/RetryRealistic。

summary: Abliteration is a widely used white-box attack against the safety alignment of large language models (LLMs). It elicits harmful behavior by estimating a refusal direction in the model's activation space and projecting that direction out of the residual-stream write-out matrices. We propose INSEP, a defense that fine-tunes the model to reduce the separability of harmful and benign activations along the refusal direction. Abliteration estimates this direction as a difference in class means and projects it out. Reducing separability weakens the signal the attack relies on. An adversarial eigendecomposition selects the most separable prompt subsets. A low-rank adapter reduces their separation along that direction. Behavioral losses preserve the base model's refusal and the quality of its benign responses during training. We benchmark INSEP against six published defenses under five attacks, across eight LLMs from 1B to 14B parameters and several model families. Beyond response harm, we measure coherence, directness, over-refusal, and MMLU, to distinguish robust refusal from low harm produced by evasive or degraded responses. INSEP ranks first on the mean composite score across all eight base models while retaining utility, in the largest abliteration-defense evaluation reported to date.
title: INSEP: Refusal-Direction Inseparability as a Defense Against Abliteration
comment: 39 pages, 2 figures, 42 tables
title_translated: INSEP：拒绝方向不可分离性作为对抗消解攻击的防御机制
summary_translated: 消解攻击是一种广泛用于针对大语言模型（LLMs）安全对齐的白盒攻击。该攻击通过估计模型激活空间中的拒绝方向，并将其从残差流写入矩阵中投影出去，从而引发有害行为。我们提出INSEP，一种通过微调模型来降低有害与良性激活在拒绝方向上的可分离性的防御方法。消解攻击将该方向视为类别均值之差并进行投影。降低可分离性会削弱攻击所依赖的信号。对抗性特征分解用于选择最可分离的提示子集，低秩适配器则减少其在该方向上的分离度。行为损失在训练过程中保留了基础模型的拒绝能力及其良性响应质量。我们在八个参数规模从1B到14B的LLM及多个模型家族上，对INSEP与六种已发表的防御方法进行了五种攻击下的基准测试。除了评估响应危害外，还测量了连贯性、直接性、过度拒绝和MMLU，以区分稳健的拒绝与因规避或退化响应导致的低危害。INSEP在迄今为止最大规模的消解-防御评估中，在所有八种基础模型上的平均综合得分排名第一，同时保持了实用性。

summary: Contribution: This study has shown that a shared prompt-refinement procedure, guided by distinct affective and cognitive feedback signals, can improve held-out reference agreement and multi-label classification while reducing affective-generation variability without executor parameter updates. Background: Industry 4.0 has increased demand for personalized technical education across interconnected computing and engineering domains, while prompt sensitivity and generation variability have complicated dependable interpretation of instructional dialogue and learning outcomes. Research Questions: The study has examined whether task-specific feedback can improve affective-reference agreement, generation consistency, and cognitive classification without updating executor parameters. Methodology: A secondary language model has revised executor prompts using executor-output discrepancies against model-generated affective references for four dialogues and annotated Bloom labels for 70 learning outcomes; separate sets of 100 EduTalk conversations and 1,000 outcomes have supported held-out comparisons. Small refinement sets, unvalidated affective references, and absent learner-outcome measures have constrained interpretation. Findings: Affective mean absolute error has decreased from 0.742 to 0.702 and mean generation standard deviation from 0.307 to 0.238, while Bloom micro-F1 has increased from 0.687 to 0.893 and exact-match subset accuracy from 0.418 to 0.636. These findings have supported prompt refinement as a candidate approach for developing adaptive technical instruction, while its effects on workforce learning remain to be established.
title: Feedback-Driven Prompt Refinement for Educational AI: Affective Trajectory Estimation and Bloom's Taxonomy Classification
title_translated: 面向教育AI的反馈驱动提示优化：情感轨迹估计与布卢姆分类学分类
summary_translated: 贡献：本研究表明，基于不同情感与认知反馈信号的共享提示优化过程，可在不更新执行器参数的情况下提升保留参考一致性与多标签分类性能，同时降低情感生成的变异性。背景：工业4.0推动了跨互联计算与工程领域个性化技术教育的需求增长，但提示敏感性和生成变异性使得教学对话与学习成果的可靠解释变得复杂。研究问题：本研究探讨了特定任务反馈是否能在不更新执行器参数的前提下，改善情感参考一致性、生成一致性与认知分类表现。方法：一个次级语言模型利用执行器输出与模型生成的情感参考之间的差异，对四个对话的执行器提示进行修订，并为70个学习成果标注布卢姆标签；另有独立的100次EduTalk对话和1000个学习成果用于保留比较。小规模优化集、未经验证的情感参考以及缺乏学习者-成果度量限制了结果解释。发现：情感平均绝对误差从0.742降至0.702，平均生成标准差从0.307降至0.238，布卢姆微F1从0.687升至0.893，精确匹配子集准确率从0.418升至0.636。这些发现支持提示优化作为发展自适应技术教学的一种候选方法，但其对劳动力学习的影响仍有待确立。

summary: Effective prosody modeling is essential in natural speech generation applications, but complications arise in speaker anonymization, since speaker attributes are present in acoustic correlates of prosody. Our work aims to improve previous reported tradeoffs between effective speaker obfuscation and preservation of prosodic content. To this end, we integrate an existing pretrained privacy-preserving prosody encoder into a speech synthesis model, enabling prosody-preserving speaker anonymization. By conditioning speech generation on prosody features, we find that human subjects more reliably perceive intended prosodic meaning, while anonymization performance is competitive with previous work.
title: Preserving Prosody in Speaker Anonymization
comment: Submitted to ICASSP 2027
title_translated: 语音匿名化中的韵律保持
summary_translated: 有效的韵律建模对于自然语音生成应用至关重要，但在语音匿名化中面临挑战，因为说话人属性存在于韵律的声学相关特征中。我们的工作旨在改进以往在有效说话人混淆与韵律内容保持之间的权衡。为此，我们将一个现有的预训练隐私保护韵律编码器集成到语音合成模型中，实现了保持韵律的说话人匿名化。通过以韵律特征为条件进行语音生成，我们发现人类受试者更可靠地感知到预期的韵律含义，同时匿名化性能与先前工作相当。

summary: Video verifiers judge whether a candidate answer or trajectory agrees with a video, and are themselves chosen by a score. We show that this score depends on two choices in the test, the type of negative and the judgment interface, strongly enough to reverse conclusions about what a model can do and which verifier to deploy. We separate the two with controlled constructions that have exact truth conditions: endpoint-matched negatives, wrong only in their internal states, and a truth-switch test, in which the same two candidates swap correctness between two videos. Under direct judgment, where the verdict is read from answer scores, models that reject a visibly wrong start fall to near chance against endpoint-matched negatives. When the frames disclose each event, writing out reasoning before the answer lifts three of four models from under 10% to 70-100% on the truth-switch test, and staged inputs trace the direct failure to one step, composing events into states. But when the event must first be found, on human-validated natural video, the same change brings no significant gain under a protocol common to all models and can lower accuracy if one candidate denies that the event occurs. The negative type also changes which verifier is selected: one chosen on event-denial negatives is 8.9 points less accurate against negatives that keep the event and change a detail, the errors a generator mostly makes, and recovers about half as much accuracy when it reranks that generator's answers. A verifier should be evaluated on the errors it will face, and neither a low direct score nor a gain from reasoning should be read as a property of the model alone.
title: When Video Verifier Scores Mislead: Capability Assessment and Verifier Selection
comment: 55 pages, including appendices
title_translated: 当视频验证器评分产生误导时：能力评估与验证器选择
summary_translated: 视频验证器判断候选答案或推理路径是否与视频一致，而验证器本身又由一个评分决定。我们发现，该评分强烈依赖于测试中的两个选择：负例类型和判断界面，足以逆转关于模型能力以及应部署哪个验证器的结论。我们通过受控构造分离这两个因素：端点匹配的负例（仅内部状态错误）、真值切换测试（同一对候选答案在两个视频间交换正确性）。在直接判断中（根据答案得分读取判决），模型在面对明显错误起始点时，对端点匹配负例的正确率接近随机水平。当帧揭示事件细节时，在给出答案前写出推理过程，使四类模型中有三类的正确率从不足10%提升至70%-100%，且分步输入揭示了直接失败源于一步错误——将事件组合为状态。然而，当事件必须先被发现时，在经人工验证的自然视频上，相同改变在所有模型通用的协议下未带来显著提升，甚至可能因一个候选否认事件发生而降低准确率。负例类型也影响验证器选择：在事件否认型负例上表现优异的验证器，在保留事件但改变细节的负例上准确率低8.9分，而这正是生成器常犯的错误；当重新排序该生成器的答案时，其准确率恢复约一半。验证器应在其将面临的错误上进行评估，既不应将低直接得分，也不应将推理带来的增益，误认为是模型本身的属性。

summary: Standard autoregressive large language models attend to the growing history of generated tokens, making the key-value (KV) cache a central memory and throughput bottleneck in long-chain reasoning and multi-branch sampling. Yet an important class of reasoning problems is naturally first-order Markovian: the next step depends on a sufficient representation of the current state, rather than on the raw sequence of all earlier steps. We develop a unified design paradigm for Markovian-reasoning specialized large language models. At the cache level, the Markovian state interface transforms history-dependent KV storage into constant-size state transfer with respect to the number of reasoning steps. At the learning level, we reformulate long-chain prediction as independently trainable one-step transition objectives, with explicit state bottlenecks, distillation, invariance, and drift-consistency losses. At the architectural level, we introduce a dual-loop Transformer: an outer loop advances the reasoning state, while an inner recurrent-depth loop allocates adaptive computation to each transition through shared weights and explicit memory tokens or recurrent matrix states. We connect this architecture to a three-region cache, step-relative positions, truncated backpropagation, branch-aware checkpoints, and a transition-centric evaluation protocol. The organizing principle is simple: the optimal reasoning system need not remember everything; it must carry forward exactly what the future needs. This principle opens a path toward specialized reasoning engines whose memory footprint is decoupled from reasoning-chain length.
title: Specialized Large Language Models for Markovian Reasoning: Structural Cache Compression, Transition Pretraining, and Dual-Loop Transformers
comment: 21 pages, 2 figures. Preprint
title_translated: 面向马尔可夫推理的专用大语言模型：结构缓存压缩、转移预训练与双循环Transformer
summary_translated: 标准自回归大语言模型会关注不断增长的生成标记历史，导致键值（KV）缓存成为长链推理与多分支采样中的核心记忆瓶颈。然而，一类重要的推理问题本质上是一阶马尔可夫的：下一步仅依赖于当前状态的充分表示，而非所有先前步骤的原始序列。我们提出了一种统一的设计范式，用于专用于马尔可夫推理的大语言模型。在缓存层面，马尔可夫状态接口将依赖历史的KV存储转换为与推理步数无关的固定大小状态传递。在学习层面，我们将长链预测重构为可独立训练的一步转移目标，引入显式的状态瓶颈、知识蒸馏、不变性与漂移一致性损失。在架构层面，我们引入双循环Transformer：外层循环推进推理状态，内层递归深度循环通过共享权重和显式记忆标记或递归矩阵状态，为每个转移分配自适应计算。我们还将该架构与三区域缓存、相对步位置、截断反向传播、分支感知检查点及以转移为中心的评估协议相连接。核心原则简单明了：最优推理系统无需记住一切；它只需携带未来所需的内容。这一原则为构建内存占用与推理链长度解耦的专用推理引擎开辟了道路。

summary: Coding agents can translate 3D measurements into CAD geometry, but reconstructing engineering models for the built environment demands semantic interpretation and consistent construction constraints beyond surface fitting. We formulate scene-level Scan-to-BIM (Building Information Modeling) as an agentic 3D coding task and introduce S2Bench, comprising public and proprietary scans of 128 real-world scenes across five domains, paired with expert-curated reference models spanning diverse spatial scales. A shared framework lets agents measure scans in Python, build class-labeled components in a live CAD/BIM kernel, and iteratively refine their code. We also propose parallel asynchronous collaboration, where a lead delegates versioned tasks, continues modeling while workers execute, and integrates revision-bound proposals. Evaluating five agents and a collaborative team across 1,028 reconstructions shows that scan-to-model residuals directly guide geometric repair, whereas inferring semantic classes and construction relations requires joint geometric, visual, and engineering reasoning that agents struggle to ground and verify. Consequently, the leading agent fits scan geometry closely ($96\%$ coverage within $5\,\text{cm}$) yet reaches only $63\%$ mIoU, and no agent passes all engineering checks on more than $38\%$ of scenes. Coverage and engineering conformance drop with scene scale, whereas running a smaller model as a team improves all three axes with greater coverage gains on larger scenes. The project page is available at https://tumcms.github.io/S2Bench.github.io/
title: From Point Clouds to Engineering Models: Benchmarking Agentic 3D Reconstruction in the Built Environment
title_translated: 从点云到工程模型：建筑环境中的智能体3D重建基准测试
summary_translated: 编码智能体可以将3D测量转换为CAD几何结构，但重建建筑环境的工程模型需要超越表面拟合的语义解释和一致的构造约束。我们将场景级扫描转BIM（建筑信息建模）定义为一项智能体3D编码任务，并引入S2Bench，包含来自五个领域共128个真实场景的公开与专有扫描数据，以及涵盖不同空间尺度的专家精心标注参考模型。一个共享框架使智能体能够用Python测量扫描数据，在实时CAD/BIM内核中构建带类别标签的组件，并迭代优化代码。我们还提出了并行异步协作机制：由主智能体分配版本化任务，同时其他工作智能体执行任务，主智能体持续建模并整合修订建议。在1028次重建中评估五种智能体及协作团队的表现显示，扫描到模型的残差可直接指导几何修复，而推断语义类别和构造关系则需要联合几何、视觉与工程推理，智能体难以准确建立和验证。因此，领先智能体虽能紧密匹配扫描几何（5cm内覆盖率96%），但mIoU仅达63%，且无一智能体在超过38%的场景中通过所有工程检查。随着场景规模增大，覆盖率和工程合规性下降；而以较小模型作为团队运行时，三项指标均得到提升，尤其在大场景中覆盖率增益更显著。项目页面见 https://tumcms.github.io/S2Bench.github.io/

summary: Language model agents are increasingly asked to run ongoing multi-day operations rather than finish isolated single-turn tasks. In daily operations, today's choices reshape later observations and cash constraints because empty shelves hide lost walk-in demand, short-shipped customers quietly shrink future orders weeks later, and emergency buying drains working capital. We introduce SMB Bench, a calibrated 90-day wholesale simulator with 18 causally paired tasks and an 859-run frontier trace dataset, to ask what experience and learning signal make an agent better at noticing, attributing, and acting on the delayed consequences of its own decisions in unseen businesses. Across 16 frontier models, only 3 outperform a fixed buying rule; models often record a relevant diagnosis in their notes without changing later purchases in time, showing that diagnosing a problem, changing behavior, and improving a business are separate achievements. To study how experience improves those failures in an open model (Qwen3.8-27B), we used training-business records to identify operational rules and archived frontier quarters as starting states to continue from rather than transcripts to copy. On an unseen test business under identical evaluation instructions, the trained policy followed customer-protection commitments more consistently and reduced severe-loss quarters, while the additional profit benefit remained uncertain. Carrying those commitments through the quarter exposed the cost of fulfilling them, as early-quarter stocking habits left the buyer relying on emergency supply and a deteriorating supplier. The results separate recognizing a delayed effect, acting on it consistently, and coordinating surrounding decisions so that the response improves profit. SMB Bench connects these observations to a learning method by turning archived decisions and their consequences into reusable training experience.
title: Measuring and Teaching Language Model Agents to Act on Delayed Consequences
comment: 19 pages, 7 figures. Benchmark report: this https URL ; dataset: this https URL
title_translated: 衡量与教授语言模型智能体应对延迟后果的行为
summary_translated: 语言模型智能体正被要求执行持续多日的运营任务，而非完成孤立的单轮任务。在日常运营中，当下的决策会重塑后续观察结果和现金流状况：空货架隐藏了流失的现场需求，订单短缺的客户数周后悄然减少未来订单，紧急采购则耗尽营运资本。我们提出SMB Bench，一个经过校准的90天批发商模拟器，包含18个因果关联任务和859次前沿运行轨迹数据集，旨在探究何种经验与学习信号能使智能体更好地察觉、归因并行动于自身决策在未见过业务中的延迟后果。在16个前沿模型中，仅有3个表现优于固定采购规则；模型常在笔记中记录相关诊断，却未能及时调整后续采购，表明诊断问题、改变行为与改善业务是独立的能力。为研究经验如何改善开放模型（Qwen3.8-27B）中的这些失败，我们使用训练期业务记录识别操作规则，并以存档的前沿季度作为起始状态继续推进，而非复制对话文本。在相同评估指令下对一个未见过的测试业务进行评估，训练后的策略更一致地履行客户保护承诺，并减少了严重亏损季度，但额外利润收益仍不确定。将这些承诺贯穿整个季度暴露了履行成本：初期囤货习惯导致买家依赖紧急供应，供应商状况恶化。结果揭示了识别延迟效应、持续采取行动以及协调周边决策以提升利润之间的区别。SMB Bench通过将存档决策及其后果转化为可复用的训练经验，将这些观察与学习方法相连接。

summary: A defense that disrupts hidden messages may still provide little protection if its detector rarely triggers an intervention. We present StegoGuard-LM, a controlled framework for evaluating defenses against covert messages in large language model outputs. We examine token-rank and synonym channels, with Unicode concealment as a structural control, and track messages through detection, intervention, and recovery. Deterministic rewriting prevented full recovery of 103 of 104 synonym-encoded messages when applied unconditionally, but only one when intervention depended on a detector set to limit false alarms. In a four-round replay on a 48-response subset, an attacker selecting from a fixed catalog recovered more bits by switching channels, although paired gains were not statistically significant after correction for multiple comparisons. Randomized rewriting showed no sustained advantage in this pilot. A more sensitive detector improved protection but modified about one-third of clean responses. These findings show how uneven detection can undermine effective rewriting and why protection must be evaluated alongside attacker adaptation and intervention on legitimate text.
title: STEGOGUARD-LM: Evaluating End-to-End Protection Against LLM Covert Channels
comment: 25 pages, including references and appendices. Preprint; not peer-reviewed
title_translated: STEGOGUARD-LM：评估针对大语言模型隐蔽信道的端到端防护能力
summary_translated: 若防御措施的检测器极少触发干预，即使其破坏隐藏信息也难以提供有效保护。我们提出StegoGuard-LM，一个用于评估大语言模型输出中隐蔽消息防御能力的受控框架。我们考察了词元排名通道和同义词通道，以Unicode隐藏作为结构控制，并追踪消息在检测、干预与恢复过程中的表现。无条件应用确定性重写可阻止104条同义词编码消息中的103条完全恢复，但当干预依赖于设定以限制误报率的检测器时，仅有一条无法恢复。在48条响应子集上的四轮重播实验中，攻击者从固定目录中切换通道可恢复更多比特，尽管经多重比较校正后配对增益不具统计显著性。随机重写在此初步实验中未表现出持续优势。更敏感的检测器提升了防护效果，但修改了约三分之一的正常响应。这些发现表明，检测不均衡可能削弱有效重写的效果，且防护能力必须与攻击者适应性和对合法文本的干预一同评估。

summary: Text-to-video generators differ by two orders of magnitude in price, and a cheap configuration of a strong model is often good enough for a prompt. Routing prompts across such arms (model x sampling configuration) should buy quality at fixed budget, but no dataset supports studying it: public video-preference sets contain only closed models, one configuration each.   We release VidRouteBench: 16 arms from 7 open families spanning 121x in measured cost ($0.0025-$0.298 per clip), 27,110 clips (1,421 A800-hours) over 1,625 grouped prompts, a quality score frozen after calibration against human preferences (68.7% CV accuracy vs 66.2% for the best single scorer), per-clip scores on 9 identifiable quality dimensions, repeated seeds, an encrypted test split, and a sealed newest family for cold start. The evaluator compares a router against the best prompt-agnostic mixture of arms, not the best single arm. Per-prompt specialisation here is real and predictable (oracle gap 0.642, 47% reproducible across seeds, prompt-arm interaction F=4.47 at p=1.6e-63), unlike LLM-routing arms, where the same pipeline finds none.   We then propose OPMU (one probe, many utilities): label a new arm on K probe prompts, predict its 9 dimensions once, and serve any scenario utility by scalarising afterwards. Over 215 utility directions OPMU Pareto-dominates the prompt-agnostic baseline for 94% of directions versus 90% for per-scenario routers, with no per-scenario retraining. Three baselines fail instructively: bag-of-words features lose almost all routing gain in the low-data regime (0.009 vs 0.168); crediting a new arm with its probe average is harmful (-3.32 recovery) although it is the strong baseline on RewardBench-style arms (0.786); Chebyshev scalarisation does not help, our cost-utility front being convex.
title: VidRouteBench: A Benchmark for Budgeted Video-Generation Routing
title_translated: VidRouteBench：面向预算约束视频生成路由的基准测试
summary_translated: 文本到视频生成器的价格差异可达两个数量级，而强模型的廉价配置通常足以满足多数提示需求。在不同模型与采样配置之间路由提示应能在固定预算下实现质量提升，但目前尚无数据集支持此类研究：公开的视频偏好集仅包含封闭模型，每种配置仅一个。我们发布VidRouteBench：涵盖7个开源系列的16种配置，实测成本相差121倍（每片段0.0025至0.298美元），共27,110个视频片段（1,421 A800小时），覆盖1,625组提示，质量评分在与人类偏好校准后冻结（交叉验证准确率68.7%，优于最佳单一评分器的66.2%），每个片段在9个可识别质量维度上均有评分，重复种子设置，加密测试集，以及一个用于冷启动的新家族。评估器将路由器与最佳无提示依赖的配置混合体对比，而非最佳单一配置。此处提示特化具有真实且可预测性（最优差距0.642，47%在种子间可重现，提示-配置交互F=4.47，p=1.6e-63），不同于LLM路由配置中同一管道无法发现任何特化的情况。随后我们提出OPMU（一次探测，多种用途）：在K个探测提示上标注新配置，一次性预测其9个维度，再通过标量化解码服务于任意场景目标。在215个目标方向上，OPMU在94%的方向上优于无提示依赖基线，而逐场景路由器仅在90%方向上胜出，且无需逐场景重新训练。三种基线表现令人警醒：词袋特征在低数据环境下几乎丧失全部路由收益（0.009 vs 0.168）；将新配置归功于其探测平均值有害（-3.32恢复率），尽管它在RewardBench式配置中是强基线（0.786）；切比雪夫标量化无助于提升性能，因我们的成本-效用前沿呈凸形。

summary: Co-creating layouts such as websites and slides is a useful testbed for evaluating multi-turn instruction following of LLM systems. Since an intended layout's appearance cannot be well expressed in a single turn, the user must wait for the LLM to generate a layout then iteratively refine it with the LLM over multiple turns. We present a small-scale, exploratory (n=6) study of this multi-turn process to compare the differences of human-AI and AI-AI teams on the same layout-generation task. Given a reference wire-frame layout, a participant or a language model 'speaker' issues natural-language instructions to a fixed 'listener' LLM over multiple turns until the speaker is satisfied. Rather than an LLM as the judge, we fit a scoring function over geometric layout features using curated human preference data (n=19). We find that LLMs tend to encode the entire layout in the first turn, while humans iterate over many turns on average, writing much shorter instructions. We also find that human-AI teams consistently scored lower than AI-AI teams. This gap is driven by a limiter of human participants in specifying precise sizes and positions (e.g. 42 pixels to the right). Humans perform almost at par with language models on other features like ordering the elements into nested structures. We then perform interventions on the speaker LLMs to make them more human-like, and find it difficult. This raises the challenge of using LLMs as user models to evaluate multi-turn co-creation tasks.
title: Measuring Human-AI and AI-AI Teams in Multi-turn Layout Creation
comment: 17 pages, 11 figures. NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Human-AI Coevolution: Measuring Human-Agent Teams in the Agentic Era
title_translated: 多轮布局创建中的人机与机机团队协作评估
summary_translated: 共同创建如网站和幻灯片等布局，是评估大语言模型系统多轮指令遵循能力的有效测试平台。由于目标布局的外观难以在单轮中充分表达，用户需等待LLM生成布局后，再通过多轮与LLM迭代优化。我们开展了一项小规模探索性研究（n=6），比较人机与机机团队在相同布局生成任务中的差异。给定参考线框布局，参与者或语言模型‘发言者’在多轮中向固定‘听者’LLM发出自然语言指令，直至发言者满意为止。不同于使用LLM作为评判者，我们基于人工偏好数据（n=19）拟合了一个基于几何布局特征的评分函数。研究发现，LLM倾向于在第一轮中编码整个布局，而人类平均需多轮迭代，且指令更短。此外，人机团队得分始终低于机机团队。这一差距主要源于人类参与者在精确指定尺寸和位置（如向右42像素）方面的局限。在其他如元素嵌套结构排序方面，人类表现几乎与语言模型相当。随后我们对发言者LLM进行干预以使其更接近人类行为，但发现该过程极为困难。这凸显了使用LLM作为用户模型来评估多轮协同创作任务所面临的挑战。

summary: LLM-simulated users stand in for people in multi-turn evaluations, on the assumption that they react to what the assistant says. We test this for pushback. From WildChat, we take conversations in which the assistant explicitly challenges or endorses a position the user stated, and compare the real next user turn with simulated turns from the same prefix. Among users who replied, real users push back more after a challenge than after an endorsement (20.5% vs. 8.2%); a GPT-based simulator does not (27.1% vs. 27.1%): stance gap D = -0.12 [-0.17, -0.08]. After a challenge the simulator instead often re-states or re-interprets its request ("I meant ..."); about half of these turns are disguised insistence, which puts D between -0.08 and -0.05. What drives the simulator's disputing is whether the assistant's position is judged correct (21% vs. 49% after challenges; 16% vs. 58% after endorsements), while real users change little (19% vs. 24%; 7% vs. 12%), under every outcome definition we tried. Real same-stance examples do not fix this, and another GPT-based simulator and two Claude simulators show stance effects close to real users. Stance sensitivity should be measured for each simulator, not assumed.
title: Do Simulated Users Push Back Like Real Users? Correctness vs. Stance
title_translated: 模拟用户会像真实用户一样反驳吗？正确性与立场的关系
summary_translated: 大型语言模型（LLM）模拟的用户在多轮评估中被用作真人替代，假设其会对助手的回应作出反应。本文测试了这种假设在反驳行为上的有效性。基于WildChat数据集，我们选取了助手明确挑战或支持用户立场的对话片段，并将真实用户的下一轮回应与同一前缀下的模拟回应进行对比。结果显示，在受到挑战后，真实用户比受到支持后的反驳率更高（20.5% vs. 8.2%）；而基于GPT的模拟器则无此差异（27.1% vs. 27.1%），存在显著的立场差距（D = -0.12 [-0.17, -0.08]）。在受到挑战后，模拟器更倾向于重复或重新解释其请求（如“I meant...”），其中约一半为伪装的坚持，使差距缩小至-0.08到-0.05之间。模拟器是否反驳主要取决于助手立场是否被判定为正确（挑战后21% vs. 49%；支持后16% vs. 58%），而真实用户则变化不大（挑战后19% vs. 24%；支持后7% vs. 12%），在所有评估标准下均如此。即使使用相同立场的真实样本也无法修复这一问题，且其他基于GPT和Claude的模拟器表现出接近真实用户的立场敏感性。因此，应针对每个模拟器单独测量其立场敏感性，而非默认假设。

summary: Deploying large language models on commodity CPUs is often constrained not only by computational throughput but also by the resident memory required to execute quantized models within fixed system budgets. We present MemVanta, an experimental C++20 inference runtime for quantized GGUF language models that treats memory residency as a first-class systems objective. MemVanta combines memory-mapped model access, bounded tensor caching, quantized execution paths, paged key-value state, and explicit memory-pressure validation. We evaluate MemVanta against a pinned llama.cpp baseline using the same OpenLLaMA 7B v2 Q4_0 GGUF under CPU-only execution. Across five measured runs following warm-up, MemVanta records a peak resident set size of 3,983,412 KiB compared with 7,586,960 KiB for llama.cpp, corresponding to a 47.50 percent reduction in peak RSS. This memory reduction involves a substantial throughput trade-off: MemVanta achieves 3.15 +/- 0.04 tokens/s for prompt processing and 1.52 +/- 0.02 tokens/s for token generation, compared with 45.82 +/- 0.96 and 7.76 +/- 0.09 tokens/s, respectively, for llama.cpp. In a separate Linux cgroup-v2 experiment with swap disabled, MemVanta completes execution at a tested 3584 MiB memory ceiling, while llama.cpp is OOM-killed at that ceiling and first succeeds at the tested 3840 MiB level. These results position MemVanta as a memory-efficiency research prototype rather than a throughput competitor. We analyze the architectural mechanisms underlying this trade-off and discuss reproducibility, correctness, limitations, and opportunities for memory-constrained CPU and edge inference.
title: MemVanta: Memory-Efficient CPU Inference for Quantized GGUF Language Models
